verses.textZh: 奉神旨意作基督耶稣使徒的保罗，和提摩太弟兄，写信给在哥林多神的教会，和全亚该亚所有的圣徒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 奉神旨意作基督耶稣使徒的保罗，和提摩太弟兄，写信给在哥林多神的教会，和全亚该亚所有的圣徒。
verses.textZhCuv: 奉神旨意作基督耶稣使徒的保罗和兄弟提摩太，写信给在哥林多神的教会，并亚该亚遍处的众圣徒。
verses.textEnNiv: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, To the church of God in Corinth, together with all his holy people throughout Achaia:
verses.textEnEsv: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, To the church of God that is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:
verses.textEnNkjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, To the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in all Achaia:
verses.textEnNlt: This letter is from Paul, chosen by the will of God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from our brother Timothy. I am writing to God’s church in Corinth and to all of his holy people throughout Greece.
verses.textEnNasb: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and our brother Timothy, To the church of God which is at Corinth with all the saints who are throughout Achaia:
verses.textEn: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, To the church of God in Corinth, together with all his holy people throughout Achaia:

verses.textZh: 愿恩惠平安从我们的父神和主耶稣基督临到你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿恩惠平安从我们的父神和主耶稣基督临到你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿恩惠、平安从神我们的父和主耶稣基督归与你们！
verses.textEnNiv: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.
verses.textEnNasb: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 我们主耶稣基督的父神是应当称颂的。他是满有怜悯的父，赐各样安慰的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们主耶稣基督的父神是应当称颂的。他是满有怜悯的父，赐各样安慰的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿颂赞归与我们的主耶稣基督的父神，就是发慈悲的父，赐各样安慰的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort,
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,
verses.textEnNlt: All praise to God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is our merciful Father and the source of all comfort.
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,
verses.textEn: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort,

verses.textZh: 我们在一切患难中，神都安慰我们，使我们能用他所赐的安慰，去安慰那些在各样患难中的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们在一切患难中，神都安慰我们，使我们能用他所赐的安慰，去安慰那些在各样患难中的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们在一切患难中，他就安慰我们，叫我们能用神所赐的安慰去安慰那遭各样患难的人。
verses.textEnNiv: who comforts us in all our troubles, so that we can comfort those in any trouble with the comfort we ourselves receive from God.
verses.textEnEsv: who comforts us in all our affliction, so that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, with the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
verses.textEnNkjv: who comforts us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any trouble, with the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
verses.textEnNlt: He comforts us in all our troubles so that we can comfort others. When they are troubled, we will be able to give them the same comfort God has given us.
verses.textEnNasb: who comforts us in all our affliction so that we will be able to comfort those who are in any affliction with the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
verses.textEn: who comforts us in all our troubles, so that we can comfort those in any trouble with the comfort we ourselves receive from God.

verses.textZh: 我们既然多受基督所受的痛苦，就靠着基督多得安慰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们既然多受基督所受的痛苦，就靠着基督多得安慰。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们既多受基督的苦楚，就靠基督多得安慰。
verses.textEnNiv: For just as we share abundantly in the sufferings of Christ, so also our comfort abounds through Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: For as we share abundantly in Christ’s sufferings, so through Christ we share abundantly in comfort too.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also abounds through Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: For the more we suffer for Christ, the more God will shower us with his comfort through Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: For just as the sufferings of Christ are ours in abundance, so also our comfort is abundant through Christ.
verses.textEn: For just as we share abundantly in the sufferings of Christ, so also our comfort abounds through Christ.

verses.textZh: 如果我们遭遇患难，那是要使你们得着安慰，得着拯救；如果我们得到安慰，也是要使你们得到安慰。这安慰使你们能够忍受我们所受那样的痛苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我们遭遇患难，那是要使你们得着安慰，得着拯救；如果我们得到安慰，也是要使你们得到安慰。这安慰使你们能够忍受我们所受那样的痛苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们受患难呢，是为叫你们得安慰，得拯救；我们得安慰呢，也是为叫你们得安慰；这安慰能叫你们忍受我们所受的那样苦楚。
verses.textEnNiv: If we are distressed, it is for your comfort and salvation; if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you patient endurance of the same sufferings we suffer.
verses.textEnEsv: If we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; and if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which you experience when you patiently endure the same sufferings that we suffer.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now if we are afflicted, itis for your consolation and salvation, which is effective for enduring the same sufferings which we also suffer. Or if we are comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: Even when we are weighed down with troubles, it is for your comfort and salvation! For when we ourselves are comforted, we will certainly comfort you. Then you can patiently endure the same things we suffer.
verses.textEnNasb: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; or if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which is effective in the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer;
verses.textEn: If we are distressed, it is for your comfort and salvation; if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you patient endurance of the same sufferings we suffer.

verses.textZh: 我们对你们的盼望是坚定的，因为知道你们既然一同受痛苦，也必照样同得安慰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们对你们的盼望是坚定的，因为知道你们既然一同受痛苦，也必照样同得安慰。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们为你们所存的盼望是确定的，因为知道你们既是同受苦楚，也必同得安慰。
verses.textEnNiv: And our hope for you is firm, because we know that just as you share in our sufferings, so also you share in our comfort.
verses.textEnEsv: Our hope for you is unshaken, for we know that as you share in our sufferings, you will also share in our comfort.
verses.textEnNkjv: And our hope for you is steadfast, because we know that as you are partakers of the sufferings, so also youwillpartake of the consolation.
verses.textEnNlt: We are confident that as you share in our sufferings, you will also share in the comfort God gives us.
verses.textEnNasb: and our hope for you is firmly grounded, knowing that as you are partners in our sufferings, so also you are in our comfort.
verses.textEn: And our hope for you is firm, because we know that just as you share in our sufferings, so also you share in our comfort.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我们在亚西亚遭受的患难，我们很想让你们知道。那时我们受到了过于我们所能忍受的压力，甚至活下去的希望都没有了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我们在亚西亚遭受的患难，我们很想让你们知道。那时我们受到了过于我们所能忍受的压力，甚至活下去的希望都没有了，
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我们不要你们不晓得，我们从前在亚细亚遭遇苦难，被压太重，力不能胜，甚至连活命的指望都绝了；
verses.textEnNiv: We do not want you to be uninformed, brothers and sisters, about the troubles we experienced in the province of Asia. We were under great pressure, far beyond our ability to endure, so that we despaired of life itself.
verses.textEnEsv: For we do not want you to be unaware, brothers, of the affliction we experienced in Asia. For we were so utterly burdened beyond our strength that we despaired of life itself.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we do not want you to be ignorant, brethren, of our trouble which came to us in Asia: that we were burdened beyond measure, above strength, so that we despaired even of life.
verses.textEnNlt: We think you ought to know, dear brothers and sisters, about the trouble we went through in the province of Asia. We were crushed and overwhelmed beyond our ability to endure, and we thought we would never live through it.
verses.textEnNasb: For we do not want you to be unaware, brothers and sisters, of our affliction which occurred in Asia, that we were burdened excessively, beyond our strength, so that we despaired even of life.
verses.textEn: We do not want you to be uninformed, brothers and sisters, about the troubles we experienced in the province of Asia. We were under great pressure, far beyond our ability to endure, so that we despaired of life itself.

verses.textZh: 而且断定自己是必死的了；然而，这正是要我们不倚靠自己，只倚靠那叫死人复活的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 而且断定自己是必死的了；然而，这正是要我们不倚靠自己，只倚靠那叫死人复活的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 自己心里也断定是必死的，叫我们不靠自己，只靠叫死人复活的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Indeed, we felt we had received the sentence of death. But this happened that we might not rely on ourselves but on God, who raises the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: Indeed, we felt that we had received the sentence of death. But that was to make us rely not on ourselves but on God who raises the dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves but in God who raises the dead,
verses.textEnNlt: In fact, we expected to die. But as a result, we stopped relying on ourselves and learned to rely only on God, who raises the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, we had the sentence of death within ourselves so that we would not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,
verses.textEn: Indeed, we felt we had received the sentence of death. But this happened that we might not rely on ourselves but on God, who raises the dead.

verses.textZh: 他救我们脱离了那极大的死亡，而且他还要救我们，我们希望他将来仍要救我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他救我们脱离了那极大的死亡，而且他还要救我们，我们希望他将来仍要救我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他曾救我们脱离那极大的死亡，现在仍要救我们，并且我们指望他将来还要救我们。
verses.textEnNiv: He has delivered us from such a deadly peril, and he will deliver us again. On him we have set our hope that he will continue to deliver us,
verses.textEnEsv: He delivered us from such a deadly peril, and he will deliver us. On him we have set our hope that he will deliver us again.
verses.textEnNkjv: who delivered us from so great a death, and does deliver us; in whom we trust that He will still deliver us,
verses.textEnNlt: And he did rescue us from mortal danger, and he will rescue us again. We have placed our confidence in him, and he will continue to rescue us.
verses.textEnNasb: who rescued us from so great a danger of death, and will rescue us, He on whom we have set our hope. And He will yet deliver us,
verses.textEn: He has delivered us from such a deadly peril, and he will deliver us again. On him we have set our hope that he will continue to deliver us,

verses.textZh: 请你们一同用祷告支持我们，好使许多人为着我们所蒙的恩献上感谢。这恩是借着许多人的代求而得到的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 请你们一同用祷告支持我们，好使许多人为着我们所蒙的恩献上感谢。这恩是借着许多人的代求而得到的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们以祈祷帮助我们，好叫许多人为我们谢恩，就是为我们因许多人所得的恩。
verses.textEnNiv: as you help us by your prayers. Then many will give thanks on our behalf for the gracious favor granted us in answer to the prayers of many.
verses.textEnEsv: You also must help us by prayer, so that many will give thanks on our behalf for the blessing granted us through the prayers of many.
verses.textEnNkjv: you also helping together in prayer for us, that thanks may be given by many persons on our behalf for the gift granted to us through many.
verses.textEnNlt: And you are helping us by praying for us. Then many people will give thanks because God has graciously answered so many prayers for our safety.
verses.textEnNasb: if you also join in helping us through your prayers, so that thanks may be given by many persons in our behalf for the favor granted to us through the prayers of many.
verses.textEn: as you help us by your prayers. Then many will give thanks on our behalf for the gracious favor granted us in answer to the prayers of many.

verses.textZh: 我们引以为荣的，就是我们处世为人，是本着神的圣洁和真诚，不是靠着人的聪明，而是靠着神的恩典，对你们更是这样，这是我们的良心可以作证的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们引以为荣的，就是我们处世为人，是本着神的圣洁和真诚，不是靠着人的聪明，而是靠着神的恩典，对你们更是这样，这是我们的良心可以作证的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们所夸的是自己的良心，见证我们凭着神的圣洁和诚实；在世为人不靠人的聪明，乃靠神的恩惠，向你们更是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: Now this is our boast: Our conscience testifies that we have conducted ourselves in the world, and especially in our relations with you, with integrity and godly sincerity. We have done so, relying not on worldly wisdom but on God’s grace.
verses.textEnEsv: For our boast is this, the testimony of our conscience, that we behaved in the world with simplicity and godly sincerity, not by earthly wisdom but by the grace of God, and supremely so toward you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that we conducted ourselves in the world in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom but by the grace of God, and more abundantly toward you.
verses.textEnNlt: We can say with confidence and a clear conscience that we have lived with a God-given holiness and sincerity in all our dealings. We have depended on God’s grace, not on our own human wisdom. That is how we have conducted ourselves before the world, and especially toward you.
verses.textEnNasb: For our proud confidence is this: the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and godly sincerity, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we have conducted ourselves in the world, and especially toward you.
verses.textEn: Now this is our boast: Our conscience testifies that we have conducted ourselves in the world, and especially in our relations with you, with integrity and godly sincerity. We have done so, relying not on worldly wisdom but on God’s grace.

verses.textZh: 我们现在写给你们的，不外是你们可以宣读、可以明白的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们现在写给你们的，不外是你们可以宣读、可以明白的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们现在写给你们的话，并不外乎你们所念的、所认识的，我也盼望你们到底还是要认识；
verses.textEnNiv: For we do not write you anything you cannot read or understand. And I hope that,
verses.textEnEsv: For we are not writing to you anything other than what you read and understand and I hope you will fully understand—
verses.textEnNkjv: For we are not writing any other things to you than what you read or understand. Now I trust you will understand, even to the end
verses.textEnNlt: Our letters have been straightforward, and there is nothing written between the lines and nothing you can’t understand. I hope someday you will fully understand us,
verses.textEnNasb: For we write nothing else to you than what you read and understand, and I hope you will understand until the end;
verses.textEn: For we do not write you anything you cannot read or understand. And I hope that,

verses.textZh: 正如你们对我们已经有些认识，我盼望你们可以彻底明白：在我们的主耶稣的日子，我们是你们的光荣，你们也是我们的光荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正如你们对我们已经有些认识，我盼望你们可以彻底明白：在我们的主耶稣的日子，我们是你们的光荣，你们也是我们的光荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 正如你们已经有几分认识我们，以我们夸口，好像我们在我们主耶稣的日子以你们夸口一样。
verses.textEnNiv: as you have understood us in part, you will come to understand fully that you can boast of us just as we will boast of you in the day of the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: just as you did partially understand us—that on the day of our Lord Jesus you will boast of us as we will boast of you.
verses.textEnNkjv: (as also you have understood us in part), that we are your boast as you also are ours, in the day of the Lord Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: even if you don’t understand us now. Then on the day when the Lord Jesus returns, you will be proud of us in the same way we are proud of you.
verses.textEnNasb: just as you also partially did understand us, that we are your reason to be proud as you also are ours, on the day of our Lord Jesus.
verses.textEn: as you have understood us in part, you will come to understand fully that you can boast of us just as we will boast of you in the day of the Lord Jesus.

verses.textZh: 我既然有这样的信念，就打算先到你们那里，使你们再一次得到恩惠，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我既然有这样的信念，就打算先到你们那里，使你们再一次得到恩惠，
verses.textZhCuv: 我既然这样深信，就早有意到你们那里去，叫你们再得益处；
verses.textEnNiv: Because I was confident of this, I wanted to visit you first so that you might benefit twice.
verses.textEnEsv: Because I was sure of this, I wanted to come to you first, so that you might have a second experience of grace.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in this confidence I intended to come to you before, that you might have a second benefit—
verses.textEnNlt: Since I was so sure of your understanding and trust, I wanted to give you a double blessing by visiting you twice—
verses.textEnNasb: In this confidence I intended at first to come to you, so that you might twice receive a blessing;
verses.textEn: Because I was confident of this, I wanted to visit you first so that you might benefit twice.

verses.textZh: 然后经过你们那里，往马其顿去，再从马其顿回到你们中间，让你们给我送行往犹太去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后经过你们那里，往马其顿去，再从马其顿回到你们中间，让你们给我送行往犹太去。
verses.textZhCuv: 也要从你们那里经过，往马其顿去，再从马其顿回到你们那里，叫你们给我送行往犹太去。
verses.textEnNiv: I wanted to visit you on my way to Macedonia and to come back to you from Macedonia, and then to have you send me on my way to Judea.
verses.textEnEsv: I wanted to visit you on my way to Macedonia, and to come back to you from Macedonia and have you send me on my way to Judea.
verses.textEnNkjv: to pass by way of you to Macedonia, to come again from Macedonia to you, and be helped by you on my way to Judea.
verses.textEnNlt: first on my way to Macedonia and again when I returned from Macedonia. Then you could send me on my way to Judea.
verses.textEnNasb: that is, to pass your way into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and by you to be helped on my journey to Judea.
verses.textEn: I wanted to visit you on my way to Macedonia and to come back to you from Macedonia, and then to have you send me on my way to Judea.

verses.textZh: 我这样决定，难道是反复不定吗？我所决定的，难道是体贴肉体而定，使我忽是忽非吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我这样决定，难道是反复不定吗？我所决定的，难道是体贴肉体而定，使我忽是忽非吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我有此意，岂是反复不定吗？我所起的意，岂是从情欲起的，叫我忽是忽非吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Was I fickle when I intended to do this? Or do I make my plans in a worldly manner so that in the same breath I say both "Yes, yes" and "No, no"?
verses.textEnEsv: Was I vacillating when I wanted to do this? Do I make my plans according to the flesh, ready to say "Yes, yes" and "No, no" at the same time?
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, when I was planning this, did I do it lightly? Or the things I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, that with me there should be Yes, Yes, and No, No?
verses.textEnNlt: You may be asking why I changed my plan. Do you think I make my plans carelessly? Do you think I am like people of the world who say "Yes" when they really mean "No"?
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, I was not vacillating when I intended to do this, was I? Or what I decide, do I decide according to the flesh, so that with me there will be yes, yes and no, no at the same time?
verses.textEn: Was I fickle when I intended to do this? Or do I make my plans in a worldly manner so that in the same breath I say both "Yes, yes" and "No, no"?

verses.textZh: 神是信实的，我们向你们所传的道并不是"是"而又"非"的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 神是信实的，我们向你们所传的道并不是"是"而又"非"的，
verses.textZhCuv: 我指着信实的神说，我们向你们所传的道，并没有是而又非的。
verses.textEnNiv: But as surely as God is faithful, our message to you is not "Yes" and "No."
verses.textEnEsv: As surely as God is faithful, our word to you has not been Yes and No.
verses.textEnNkjv: But as God is faithful, our word to you was not Yes and No.
verses.textEnNlt: As surely as God is faithful, our word to you does not waver between "Yes" and "No."
verses.textEnNasb: But as God is faithful, our word to you is not yes and no.
verses.textEn: But as surely as God is faithful, our message to you is not "Yes" and "No."

verses.textZh: 因为我、西拉和提摩太，在你们中间所宣扬的耶稣基督，神的儿子，并不是"是"而又"非"的，在他总是"是"的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我、西拉和提摩太，在你们中间所宣扬的耶稣基督，神的儿子，并不是"是"而又"非"的，在他总是"是"的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我和西拉并提摩太，在你们中间所传神的儿子耶稣基督，总没有是而又非的，在他只有一是。
verses.textEnNiv: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me and Silas and Timothy—was not "Yes" and "No," but in him it has always been "Yes."
verses.textEnEsv: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, whom we proclaimed among you, Silvanus and Timothy and I, was not Yes and No, but in him it is always Yes.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not Yes and No, but in Him was Yes.
verses.textEnNlt: For Jesus Christ, the Son of God, does not waver between "Yes" and "No." He is the one whom Silas, Timothy, and I preached to you, and as God’s ultimate "Yes," he always does what he says.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Son of God, Christ Jesus, who was preached among you by us—by me and Silvanus and Timothy—was not yes and no, but has been yes in Him.
verses.textEn: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me and Silas and Timothy—was not "Yes" and "No," but in him it has always been "Yes."

verses.textZh: 因为神的一切应许，在基督里都是"是"的，为此我们借着他说"阿们"，使荣耀归于神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神的一切应许，在基督里都是"是"的，为此我们借着他说"阿们"，使荣耀归于神。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的应许，不论有多少，在基督都是是的。所以藉着他也都是实在 的，叫神因我们得荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: For no matter how many promises God has made, they are "Yes" in Christ. And so through him the "Amen" is spoken by us to the glory of God.
verses.textEnEsv: For all the promises of God find their Yes in him. That is why it is through him that we utter our Amen to God for his glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: For all the promises of God in Him are Yes, and in Him Amen, to the glory of God through us.
verses.textEnNlt: For all of God’s promises have been fulfilled in Christ with a resounding "Yes!" And through Christ, our "Amen" (which means "Yes") ascends to God for his glory.
verses.textEnNasb: For as many as the promises of God are, in Him they are yes; therefore through Him also is our Amen to the glory of God through us.
verses.textEn: For no matter how many promises God has made, they are "Yes" in Christ. And so through him the "Amen" is spoken by us to the glory of God.

verses.textZh: 那在基督里坚定我们和你们，又膏抹我们的，就是神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那在基督里坚定我们和你们，又膏抹我们的，就是神。
verses.textZhCuv: 那在基督里坚固我们和你们，并且膏我们的就是神。
verses.textEnNiv: Now it is God who makes both us and you stand firm in Christ. He anointed us,
verses.textEnEsv: And it is God who establishes us with you in Christ, and has anointed us,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now He who establishes us with you in Christ and has anointed us is God,
verses.textEnNlt: It is God who enables us, along with you, to stand firm for Christ. He has commissioned us,
verses.textEnNasb: Now He who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,
verses.textEn: Now it is God who makes both us and you stand firm in Christ. He anointed us,

verses.textZh: 他在我们身上盖了印，就是赐圣灵在我们心里作凭据。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在我们身上盖了印，就是赐圣灵在我们心里作凭据。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又用印印了我们，并赐圣灵在我们心里作凭据 。
verses.textEnNiv: set his seal of ownership on us, and put his Spirit in our hearts as a deposit, guaranteeing what is to come.
verses.textEnEsv: and who has also put his seal on us and given us his Spirit in our hearts as a guarantee.
verses.textEnNkjv: who also has sealed us and given us the Spirit in our hearts as a guarantee.
verses.textEnNlt: and he has identified us as his own by placing the Holy Spirit in our hearts as the first installment that guarantees everything he has promised us.
verses.textEnNasb: who also sealed us and gave us the Spirit in our hearts as a pledge.
verses.textEn: set his seal of ownership on us, and put his Spirit in our hearts as a deposit, guaranteeing what is to come.

verses.textZh: 我呼求神给我作证，我没有再到哥林多来，是要宽容你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我呼求神给我作证，我没有再到哥林多来，是要宽容你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我呼吁神给我的心作见证，我没有往哥林多去是为要宽容你们。
verses.textEnNiv: I call God as my witness—and I stake my life on it—that it was in order to spare you that I did not return to Corinth.
verses.textEnEsv: But I call God to witness against me—it was to spare you that I refrained from coming again to Corinth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover I call God as witness against my soul, that to spare you I came no more to Corinth.
verses.textEnNlt: Now I call upon God as my witness that I am telling the truth. The reason I didn’t return to Corinth was to spare you from a severe rebuke.
verses.textEnNasb: But I call God as witness to my soul, that it was to spare you that I did not come again to Corinth.
verses.textEn: I call God as my witness—and I stake my life on it—that it was in order to spare you that I did not return to Corinth.

verses.textZh: 我们并不是要辖制你们的信仰，而是要作你们的同工，使你们喜乐，因为你们在信仰上已经站稳了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们并不是要辖制你们的信仰，而是要作你们的同工，使你们喜乐，因为你们在信仰上已经站稳了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们并不是辖管你们的信心，乃是帮助你们的快乐，因为你们凭信才站立得住。
verses.textEnNiv: Not that we lord it over your faith, but we work with you for your joy, because it is by faith you stand firm.
verses.textEnEsv: Not that we lord it over your faith, but we work with you for your joy, for you stand firm in your faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: Not that we have dominion over your faith, but are fellow workers for your joy; for by faith you stand.
verses.textEnNlt: But that does not mean we want to dominate you by telling you how to put your faith into practice. We want to work together with you so you will be full of joy, for it is by your own faith that you stand firm.
verses.textEnNasb: Not that we domineer over your faith, but we are workers with you for your joy; for in your faith you are standing firm.
verses.textEn: Not that we lord it over your faith, but we work with you for your joy, because it is by faith you stand firm.

verses.textZh: 我自己决定了，到你们那里去的时候，不再是忧愁的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我自己决定了，到你们那里去的时候，不再是忧愁的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我自己定了主意再到你们那里去，必须大家没有忧愁。
verses.textEnNiv: So I made up my mind that I would not make another painful visit to you.
verses.textEnEsv: For I made up my mind not to make another painful visit to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I determined this within myself, that I would not come again to you in sorrow.
verses.textEnNlt: So I decided that I would not bring you grief with another painful visit.
verses.textEnNasb: But I decided this for my own sake, that I would not come to you in sorrow again.
verses.textEn: So I made up my mind that I would not make another painful visit to you.

verses.textZh: 如果我使你们忧愁，除了那因我而忧愁的人以外，谁能使我快乐呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我使你们忧愁，除了那因我而忧愁的人以外，谁能使我快乐呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若我叫你们忧愁，除了我叫那忧愁的人以外，谁能叫我快乐呢？
verses.textEnNiv: For if I grieve you, who is left to make me glad but you whom I have grieved?
verses.textEnEsv: For if I cause you pain, who is there to make me glad but the one whom I have pained?
verses.textEnNkjv: For if I make you sorrowful, then who is he who makes me glad but the one who is made sorrowful by me?
verses.textEnNlt: For if I cause you grief, who will make me glad? Certainly not someone I have grieved.
verses.textEnNasb: For if I cause you sorrow, who then will be the one making me glad but the one who is made sorrowful by me?
verses.textEn: For if I grieve you, who is left to make me glad but you whom I have grieved?

verses.textZh: 我写了这样的信，免得我来的时候，应该使我快乐的人反而使我忧愁；我深信你们众人都以我的喜乐为你们的喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我写了这样的信，免得我来的时候，应该使我快乐的人反而使我忧愁；我深信你们众人都以我的喜乐为你们的喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 我曾把这事写给你们，恐怕我到的时候，应该叫我快乐的那些人，反倒叫我忧愁。我也深信，你们众人都以我的快乐为自己的快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: I wrote as I did, so that when I came I would not be distressed by those who should have made me rejoice. I had confidence in all of you, that you would all share my joy.
verses.textEnEsv: And I wrote as I did, so that when I came I might not suffer pain from those who should have made me rejoice, for I felt sure of all of you, that my joy would be the joy of you all.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I wrote this very thing to you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow over those from whom I ought to have joy, having confidence in you all that my joy is thejoy of you all.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why I wrote to you as I did, so that when I do come, I won’t be grieved by the very ones who ought to give me the greatest joy. Surely you all know that my joy comes from your being joyful.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the very thing I wrote you, so that when I came, I would not have sorrow from those who ought to make me rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy was the joy of you all.
verses.textEn: I wrote as I did, so that when I came I would not be distressed by those who should have made me rejoice. I had confidence in all of you, that you would all share my joy.

verses.textZh: 我从前心里痛苦难过，流着眼泪写信给你们，并不是要使你们忧愁，而是要你们知道我是多么爱你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我从前心里痛苦难过，流着眼泪写信给你们，并不是要使你们忧愁，而是要你们知道我是多么爱你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我先前心里难过痛苦，多多地流泪，写信给你们，不是叫你们忧愁，乃是叫你们知道我格外地疼爱你们。
verses.textEnNiv: For I wrote you out of great distress and anguish of heart and with many tears, not to grieve you but to let you know the depth of my love for you.
verses.textEnEsv: For I wrote to you out of much affliction and anguish of heart and with many tears, not to cause you pain but to let you know the abundant love that I have for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you, with many tears, not that you should be grieved, but that you might know the love which I have so abundantly for you.
verses.textEnNlt: I wrote that letter in great anguish, with a troubled heart and many tears. I didn’t want to grieve you, but I wanted to let you know how much love I have for you.
verses.textEnNasb: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears; not so that you would be made sorrowful, but that you might know the love which I have especially for you.
verses.textEn: For I wrote you out of great distress and anguish of heart and with many tears, not to grieve you but to let you know the depth of my love for you.

verses.textZh: 如果有人使人忧愁，他不是使我忧愁，而是使你们众人都有一点忧愁；我只说有一点，是避免说得过分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人使人忧愁，他不是使我忧愁，而是使你们众人都有一点忧愁；我只说有一点，是避免说得过分。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有叫人忧愁的，他不但叫我忧愁，也是叫你们众人有几分忧愁。我说几分，恐怕说得太重。
verses.textEnNiv: If anyone has caused grief, he has not so much grieved me as he has grieved all of you to some extent—not to put it too severely.
verses.textEnEsv: Now if anyone has caused pain, he has caused it not to me, but in some measure—not to put it too severely—to all of you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if anyone has caused grief, he has not grieved me, but all of you to some extent—not to be too severe.
verses.textEnNlt: I am not overstating it when I say that the man who caused all the trouble hurt all of you more than he hurt me.
verses.textEnNasb: But if anyone has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not for me, but in some degree— not to say too much—for all of you.
verses.textEn: If anyone has caused grief, he has not so much grieved me as he has grieved all of you to some extent—not to put it too severely.

verses.textZh: 这样的人受了许多人的责备，也就够了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样的人受了许多人的责备，也就够了，
verses.textZhCuv: 这样的人受了众人的责罚也就够了，
verses.textEnNiv: The punishment inflicted on him by the majority is sufficient.
verses.textEnEsv: For such a one, this punishment by the majority is enough,
verses.textEnNkjv: This punishment which wasinflicted by the majority is sufficient for such a man,
verses.textEnNlt: Most of you opposed him, and that was punishment enough.
verses.textEnNasb: Sufficient for such a person is this punishment which was imposed by the majority,
verses.textEn: The punishment inflicted on him by the majority is sufficient.

verses.textZh: 倒不如饶恕他，安慰他，免得他因忧愁过度而受不了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 倒不如饶恕他，安慰他，免得他因忧愁过度而受不了。
verses.textZhCuv: 倒不如赦免他，安慰他，免得他忧愁太过，甚至沉沦了。
verses.textEnNiv: Now instead, you ought to forgive and comfort him, so that he will not be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow.
verses.textEnEsv: so you should rather turn to forgive and comfort him, or he may be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow.
verses.textEnNkjv: so that, on the contrary, you ought rather to forgive and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one be swallowed up with too much sorrow.
verses.textEnNlt: Now, however, it is time to forgive and comfort him. Otherwise he may be overcome by discouragement.
verses.textEnNasb: so that on the other hand, you should rather forgive and comfort him, otherwise such a person might be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow.
verses.textEn: Now instead, you ought to forgive and comfort him, so that he will not be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow.

verses.textZh: 所以，我劝你们要向他确实显明你们的爱心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我劝你们要向他确实显明你们的爱心。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我劝你们，要向他显出坚定不移的爱心来。
verses.textEnNiv: I urge you, therefore, to reaffirm your love for him.
verses.textEnEsv: So I beg you to reaffirm your love for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I urge you to reaffirm your love to him.
verses.textEnNlt: So I urge you now to reaffirm your love for him.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I urge you to reaffirm your love for him.
verses.textEn: I urge you, therefore, to reaffirm your love for him.

verses.textZh: 为这缘故，我写了那封信，要考验你们是不是凡事都顺从。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为这缘故，我写了那封信，要考验你们是不是凡事都顺从。
verses.textZhCuv: 为此我先前也写信给你们，要试验你们，看你们凡事顺从不顺从。
verses.textEnNiv: Another reason I wrote you was to see if you would stand the test and be obedient in everything.
verses.textEnEsv: For this is why I wrote, that I might test you and know whether you are obedient in everything.
verses.textEnNkjv: For to this end I also wrote, that I might put you to the test, whether you are obedient in all things.
verses.textEnNlt: I wrote to you as I did to test you and see if you would fully comply with my instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: For to this end I also wrote, so that I might put you to the test, whether you are obedient in all things.
verses.textEn: Another reason I wrote you was to see if you would stand the test and be obedient in everything.

verses.textZh: 你们饶恕谁，我也饶恕谁；我所饶恕了的 ，是为了你们在基督面前饶恕的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们饶恕谁，我也饶恕谁；我所饶恕了的 ，是为了你们在基督面前饶恕的，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们赦免谁，我也赦免谁。我若有所赦免的，是在基督面前为你们赦免的，
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone you forgive, I also forgive. And what I have forgiven—if there was anything to forgive—I have forgiven in the sight of Christ for your sake,
verses.textEnEsv: Anyone whom you forgive, I also forgive. Indeed, what I have forgiven, if I have forgiven anything, has been for your sake in the presence of Christ,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now whom you forgive anything, I also forgive. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,
verses.textEnNlt: When you forgive this man, I forgive him, too. And when I forgive whatever needs to be forgiven, I do so with Christ’s authority for your benefit,
verses.textEnNasb: But one whom you forgive anything, I also forgive; for indeed what I have forgiven, if I have forgiven anything, I did so for your sakes in the presence of Christ,
verses.textEn: Anyone you forgive, I also forgive. And what I have forgiven—if there was anything to forgive—I have forgiven in the sight of Christ for your sake,

verses.textZh: 免得撒但有机可乘，因为我们并不是不晓得他的诡计。
verses.textZhCnvs: 免得撒但有机可乘，因为我们并不是不晓得他的诡计。
verses.textZhCuv: 免得撒但趁着机会胜过我们，因我们并非不晓得他的诡计。
verses.textEnNiv: in order that Satan might not outwit us. For we are not unaware of his schemes.
verses.textEnEsv: so that we would not be outwitted by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his designs.
verses.textEnNkjv: lest Satan should take advantage of us; for we are not ignorant of his devices.
verses.textEnNlt: so that Satan will not outsmart us. For we are familiar with his evil schemes.
verses.textEnNasb: so that no advantage would be taken of us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.
verses.textEn: in order that Satan might not outwit us. For we are not unaware of his schemes.

verses.textZh: 从前我为基督的福音到了特罗亚，虽然主给我开了门，
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前我为基督的福音到了特罗亚，虽然主给我开了门，
verses.textZhCuv: 我从前为基督的福音到了特罗亚，主也给我开了门。
verses.textEnNiv: Now when I went to Troas to preach the gospel of Christ and found that the Lord had opened a door for me,
verses.textEnEsv: When I came to Troas to preach the gospel of Christ, even though a door was opened for me in the Lord,
verses.textEnNkjv: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ’s gospel, and a door was opened to me by the Lord,
verses.textEnNlt: When I came to the city of Troas to preach the Good News of Christ, the Lord opened a door of opportunity for me.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when I came to Troas for the gospel of Christ and when a door was opened for me in the Lord,
verses.textEn: Now when I went to Troas to preach the gospel of Christ and found that the Lord had opened a door for me,

verses.textZh: 我心里仍然没有安宁，因为见不到提多弟兄。于是我辞别了那里的人，到马其顿去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我心里仍然没有安宁，因为见不到提多弟兄。于是我辞别了那里的人，到马其顿去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，因为没有遇见兄弟提多，我心里不安，便辞别那里的人往马其顿去了。
verses.textEnNiv: I still had no peace of mind, because I did not find my brother Titus there. So I said goodbye to them and went on to Macedonia.
verses.textEnEsv: my spirit was not at rest because I did not find my brother Titus there. So I took leave of them and went on to Macedonia.
verses.textEnNkjv: I had no rest in my spirit, because I did not find Titus my brother; but taking my leave of them, I departed for Macedonia.
verses.textEnNlt: But I had no peace of mind because my dear brother Titus hadn’t yet arrived with a report from you. So I said good-bye and went on to Macedonia to find him.
verses.textEnNasb: I had no rest for my spirit, not finding Titus my brother; but saying goodbye to them, I went on to Macedonia.
verses.textEn: I still had no peace of mind, because I did not find my brother Titus there. So I said goodbye to them and went on to Macedonia.

verses.textZh: 感谢神，他常常在基督里，使我们这些作俘虏的，列在凯旋的队伍当中，又借着我们在各地散播香气，就是使人认识基督。
verses.textZhCnvs: 感谢神，他常常在基督里，使我们这些作俘虏的，列在凯旋的队伍当中，又借着我们在各地散播香气，就是使人认识基督。
verses.textZhCuv: 感谢神！常率领我们在基督里夸胜，并藉着我们在各处显扬那因认识基督而有的香气。
verses.textEnNiv: But thanks be to God, who always leads us as captives in Christ’s triumphal procession and uses us to spread the aroma of the knowledge of him everywhere.
verses.textEnEsv: But thanks be to God, who in Christ always leads us in triumphal procession, and through us spreads the fragrance of the knowledge of him everywhere.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and through us diffuses the fragrance of His knowledge in every place.
verses.textEnNlt: But thank God! He has made us his captives and continues to lead us along in Christ’s triumphal procession. Now he uses us to spread the knowledge of Christ everywhere, like a sweet perfume.
verses.textEnNasb: But thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and through us reveals the fragrance of the knowledge of Him in every place.
verses.textEn: But thanks be to God, who always leads us as captives in Christ’s triumphal procession and uses us to spread the aroma of the knowledge of him everywhere.

verses.textZh: 因为无论在得救的人或灭亡的人中间，我们都是基督的馨香，是献给神的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为无论在得救的人或灭亡的人中间，我们都是基督的馨香，是献给神的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我们在神面前，无论在得救的人身上或灭亡的人身上，都有基督馨香之气。
verses.textEnNiv: For we are to God the pleasing aroma of Christ among those who are being saved and those who are perishing.
verses.textEnEsv: For we are the aroma of Christ to God among those who are being saved and among those who are perishing,
verses.textEnNkjv: For we are to God the fragrance of Christ among those who are being saved and among those who are perishing.
verses.textEnNlt: Our lives are a Christ-like fragrance rising up to God. But this fragrance is perceived differently by those who are being saved and by those who are perishing.
verses.textEnNasb: For we are a fragrance of Christ to God among those who are being saved and among those who are perishing:
verses.textEn: For we are to God the pleasing aroma of Christ among those who are being saved and those who are perishing.

verses.textZh: 对于灭亡的人，这是死亡的气味叫人死；对于得救的人，这却是生命的香气使人活。这些事谁够资格作呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 对于灭亡的人，这是死亡的气味叫人死；对于得救的人，这却是生命的香气使人活。这些事谁够资格作呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 在这等人，就作了死的香气叫他死；在那等人，就作了活的香气叫他活。这事谁能当得起呢？
verses.textEnNiv: To the one we are an aroma that brings death; to the other, an aroma that brings life. And who is equal to such a task?
verses.textEnEsv: to one a fragrance from death to death, to the other a fragrance from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?
verses.textEnNkjv: To the one weare the aroma of death leading to death, and to the other the aroma of life leading to life. And who is sufficient for these things?
verses.textEnNlt: To those who are perishing, we are a dreadful smell of death and doom. But to those who are being saved, we are a life-giving perfume. And who is adequate for such a task as this?
verses.textEnNasb: to the one an aroma from death to death, to the other an aroma from life to life. And who is adequate for these things?
verses.textEn: To the one we are an aroma that brings death; to the other, an aroma that brings life. And who is equal to such a task?

verses.textZh: 我们不像那许多的人，为了图利而谬讲神的道。相反地，我们讲话，是出于真诚，出于神，是在神面前、在基督里的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们不像那许多的人，为了图利而谬讲神的道。相反地，我们讲话，是出于真诚，出于神，是在神面前、在基督里的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们不像那许多人，为利混乱神的道；乃是由于诚实，由于神，在神面前凭着基督讲道。
verses.textEnNiv: Unlike so many, we do not peddle the word of God for profit. On the contrary, in Christ we speak before God with sincerity, as those sent from God.
verses.textEnEsv: For we are not, like so many, peddlers of God’s word, but as men of sincerity, as commissioned by God, in the sight of God we speak in Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we are not, as so many, peddling the word of God; but as of sincerity, but as from God, we speak in the sight of God in Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: You see, we are not like the many hucksters who preach for personal profit. We preach the word of God with sincerity and with Christ’s authority, knowing that God is watching us.
verses.textEnNasb: For we are not like the many, peddling the word of God, but as from sincerity, but as from God, we speak in Christ in the sight of God.
verses.textEn: Unlike so many, we do not peddle the word of God for profit. On the contrary, in Christ we speak before God with sincerity, as those sent from God.

verses.textZh: 难道我们又在自我推荐吗？难道我们像有些人，要拿荐信给你们，或向你们拿荐信吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道我们又在自我推荐吗？难道我们像有些人，要拿荐信给你们，或向你们拿荐信吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我们岂是又举荐自己吗？岂像别人用人的荐信给你们或用你们的荐信给人吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Or do we need, like some people, letters of recommendation to you or from you?
verses.textEnEsv: Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Or do we need, as some do, letters of recommendation to you, or from you?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as some others, epistles of commendation to you or letters of commendation from you?
verses.textEnNlt: Are we beginning to praise ourselves again? Are we like others, who need to bring you letters of recommendation, or who ask you to write such letters on their behalf? Surely not!
verses.textEnNasb: Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Or do we need, as some, letters of commendation to you or from you?
verses.textEn: Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Or do we need, like some people, letters of recommendation to you or from you?

verses.textZh: 你们就是我们的荐信，写在我们的心里，是众人所认识所诵读的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们就是我们的荐信，写在我们的心里，是众人所认识所诵读的，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们就是我们的荐信，写在我们的心里，被众人所知道所念诵的。
verses.textEnNiv: You yourselves are our letter, written on our hearts, known and read by everyone.
verses.textEnEsv: You yourselves are our letter of recommendation, written on our hearts, to be known and read by all.
verses.textEnNkjv: You are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read by all men;
verses.textEnNlt: The only letter of recommendation we need is you yourselves. Your lives are a letter written in our hearts; everyone can read it and recognize our good work among you.
verses.textEnNasb: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all people,
verses.textEn: You yourselves are our letter, written on our hearts, known and read by everyone.

verses.textZh: 显明你们自己是基督的书信，是借着我们写成的，不是用墨，而是用永活神的灵写的；不是写在石版上，而是写在心版上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 显明你们自己是基督的书信，是借着我们写成的，不是用墨，而是用永活神的灵写的；不是写在石版上，而是写在心版上。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们明显是基督的信，藉着我们修成的。不是用墨写的，乃是用永生神的灵写的；不是写在石版上，乃是写在心版上。
verses.textEnNiv: You show that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.
verses.textEnEsv: And you show that you are a letter from Christ delivered by us, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.
verses.textEnNkjv: clearly you are an epistle of Christ, ministered by us, written not with ink but by the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of flesh, thatis, of the heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Clearly, you are a letter from Christ showing the result of our ministry among you. This "letter" is written not with pen and ink, but with the Spirit of the living God. It is carved not on tablets of stone, but on human hearts.
verses.textEnNasb: revealing yourselves, that you are a letter of Christ, delivered by us, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.
verses.textEn: You show that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.

verses.textZh: 我们在神面前，借着基督才有这样的信心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们在神面前，借着基督才有这样的信心。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们因基督，所以在神面前才有这样的信心。
verses.textEnNiv: Such confidence we have through Christ before God.
verses.textEnEsv: Such is the confidence that we have through Christ toward God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And we have such trust through Christ toward God.
verses.textEnNlt: We are confident of all this because of our great trust in God through Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: Such is the confidence we have toward God through Christ.
verses.textEn: Such confidence we have through Christ before God.

verses.textZh: 我们不敢以为自己有资格作甚么，我们所能够作的是出于神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们不敢以为自己有资格作甚么，我们所能够作的是出于神。
verses.textZhCuv: 并不是我们凭自己能承担什么事；我们所能承担的，乃是出于神。
verses.textEnNiv: Not that we are competent in ourselves to claim anything for ourselves, but our competence comes from God.
verses.textEnEsv: Not that we are sufficient in ourselves to claim anything as coming from us, but our sufficiency is from God,
verses.textEnNkjv: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think of anything as being from ourselves, but our sufficiency is from God,
verses.textEnNlt: It is not that we think we are qualified to do anything on our own. Our qualification comes from God.
verses.textEnNasb: Not that we are adequate in ourselves so as to consider anything as having come from ourselves, but our adequacy is from God,
verses.textEn: Not that we are competent in ourselves to claim anything for ourselves, but our competence comes from God.

verses.textZh: 他使我们有资格作新约的仆役，这新约不是从仪文来的，而是从圣灵来的；因为仪文会使人死，而圣灵却使人活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他使我们有资格作新约的仆役，这新约不是从仪文来的，而是从圣灵来的；因为仪文会使人死，而圣灵却使人活。
verses.textZhCuv: 他叫我们能承当这新约的执事，不是凭着字句，乃是凭着精意；因为那字句是叫人死，精意 是叫人活。
verses.textEnNiv: He has made us competent as ministers of a new covenant—not of the letter but of the Spirit; for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
verses.textEnEsv: who has made us sufficient to be ministers of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
verses.textEnNkjv: who also made us sufficient as ministers of the new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit; for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
verses.textEnNlt: He has enabled us to be ministers of his new covenant. This is a covenant not of written laws, but of the Spirit. The old written covenant ends in death; but under the new covenant, the Spirit gives life.
verses.textEnNasb: who also made us adequate as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit; for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
verses.textEn: He has made us competent as ministers of a new covenant—not of the letter but of the Spirit; for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

verses.textZh: 如果那以文字刻在石上使人死的律法的工作，尚且带有荣光，以致以色列人因着摩西脸上短暂的荣光，不能注视他的脸，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果那以文字刻在石上使人死的律法的工作，尚且带有荣光，以致以色列人因着摩西脸上短暂的荣光，不能注视他的脸，
verses.textZhCuv: 那用字刻在石头上属死的职事尚且有荣光，甚至以色列人因摩西面上的荣光，不能定睛看他的脸；这荣光原是渐渐退去的，
verses.textEnNiv: Now if the ministry that brought death, which was engraved in letters on stone, came with glory, so that the Israelites could not look steadily at the face of Moses because of its glory, transitory though it was,
verses.textEnEsv: Now if the ministry of death, carved in letters on stone, came with such glory that the Israelites could not gaze at Moses’ face because of its glory, which was being brought to an end,
verses.textEnNkjv: But if the ministry of death, written and engraved on stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not look steadily at the face of Moses because of the glory of his countenance, which glory was passing away,
verses.textEnNlt: The old way, with laws etched in stone, led to death, though it began with such glory that the people of Israel could not bear to look at Moses’ face. For his face shone with the glory of God, even though the brightness was already fading away.
verses.textEnNasb: But if the ministry of death, engraved in letters on stones, came with glory so that the sons of Israel could not look intently at the face of Moses because of the glory of his face, fading as it was,
verses.textEn: Now if the ministry that brought death, which was engraved in letters on stone, came with glory, so that the Israelites could not look steadily at the face of Moses because of its glory, transitory though it was,

verses.textZh: 那出于圣灵的工作不是更有荣光吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 那出于圣灵的工作不是更有荣光吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 何况那属灵的职事岂不更有荣光吗？
verses.textEnNiv: will not the ministry of the Spirit be even more glorious?
verses.textEnEsv: will not the ministry of the Spirit have even more glory?
verses.textEnNkjv: how will the ministry of the Spirit not be more glorious?
verses.textEnNlt: Shouldn’t we expect far greater glory under the new way, now that the Holy Spirit is giving life?
verses.textEnNasb: how will the ministry of the Spirit fail to be even more with glory?
verses.textEn: will not the ministry of the Spirit be even more glorious?

verses.textZh: 如果那定人有罪的工作尚且有荣光，那使人称义的工作就更有荣光了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果那定人有罪的工作尚且有荣光，那使人称义的工作就更有荣光了！
verses.textZhCuv: 若是定罪的职事有荣光，那称义的职事荣光就越发大了。
verses.textEnNiv: If the ministry that brought condemnation was glorious, how much more glorious is the ministry that brings righteousness!
verses.textEnEsv: For if there was glory in the ministry of condemnation, the ministry of righteousness must far exceed it in glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if the ministry of condemnation had glory, the ministry of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.
verses.textEnNlt: If the old way, which brings condemnation, was glorious, how much more glorious is the new way, which makes us right with God!
verses.textEnNasb: For if the ministry of condemnation has glory, much more does the ministry of righteousness excel in glory.
verses.textEn: If the ministry that brought condemnation was glorious, how much more glorious is the ministry that brings righteousness!

verses.textZh: 那从前有荣光的，现在因那超越的荣光，就算不得有荣光；
verses.textZhCnvs: 那从前有荣光的，现在因那超越的荣光，就算不得有荣光；
verses.textZhCuv: 那从前有荣光的，因这极大的荣光就算不得有荣光了；
verses.textEnNiv: For what was glorious has no glory now in comparison with the surpassing glory.
verses.textEnEsv: Indeed, in this case, what once had glory has come to have no glory at all, because of the glory that surpasses it.
verses.textEnNkjv: For even what was made glorious had no glory in this respect, because of the glory that excels.
verses.textEnNlt: In fact, that first glory was not glorious at all compared with the overwhelming glory of the new way.
verses.textEnNasb: For indeed what had glory in this case has no glory, because of the glory that surpasses it.
verses.textEn: For what was glorious has no glory now in comparison with the surpassing glory.

verses.textZh: 如果那短暂的有荣光，那长存的就更有荣光了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果那短暂的有荣光，那长存的就更有荣光了。
verses.textZhCuv: 若那废掉的有荣光，这长存的就更有荣光了。
verses.textEnNiv: And if what was transitory came with glory, how much greater is the glory of that which lasts!
verses.textEnEsv: For if what was being brought to an end came with glory, much more will what is permanent have glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if what is passing away was glorious, what remains is much more glorious.
verses.textEnNlt: So if the old way, which has been replaced, was glorious, how much more glorious is the new, which remains forever!
verses.textEnNasb: For if that which fades away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.
verses.textEn: And if what was transitory came with glory, how much greater is the glory of that which lasts!

verses.textZh: 所以，我们既然有这样的盼望，就大大地放胆行事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我们既然有这样的盼望，就大大地放胆行事，
verses.textZhCuv: 我们既有这样的盼望，就大胆讲说，
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, since we have such a hope, we are very bold.
verses.textEnEsv: Since we have such a hope, we are very bold,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, since we have such hope, we use great boldness of speech—
verses.textEnNlt: Since this new way gives us such confidence, we can be very bold.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, having such a hope, we use great boldness in our speech,
verses.textEn: Therefore, since we have such a hope, we are very bold.

verses.textZh: 不像摩西那样，把帕子蒙在脸上，使以色列人看不见那短暂的荣光的结局。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不像摩西那样，把帕子蒙在脸上，使以色列人看不见那短暂的荣光的结局。
verses.textZhCuv: 不像摩西将帕子蒙在脸上，叫以色列人不能定睛看到那将废者的结局。
verses.textEnNiv: We are not like Moses, who would put a veil over his face to prevent the Israelites from seeing the end of what was passing away.
verses.textEnEsv: not like Moses, who would put a veil over his face so that the Israelites might not gaze at the outcome of what was being brought to an end.
verses.textEnNkjv: unlike Moses, who put a veil over his face so that the children of Israel could not look steadily at the end of what was passing away.
verses.textEnNlt: We are not like Moses, who put a veil over his face so the people of Israel would not see the glory, even though it was destined to fade away.
verses.textEnNasb: and we are not like Moses, who used to put a veil over his face so that the sons of Israel would not stare at the end of what was fading away.
verses.textEn: We are not like Moses, who would put a veil over his face to prevent the Israelites from seeing the end of what was passing away.

verses.textZh: 但是他们的心思迟钝，因为直到今日，他们诵读旧约的时候，这帕子仍然存在，没有揭开，唯有在基督里才能把这帕子废掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是他们的心思迟钝，因为直到今日，他们诵读旧约的时候，这帕子仍然存在，没有揭开，唯有在基督里才能把这帕子废掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 但他们的心地刚硬，直到今日诵读旧约的时候，这帕子还没有揭去。这帕子在基督里已经废去了。
verses.textEnNiv: But their minds were made dull, for to this day the same veil remains when the old covenant is read. It has not been removed, because only in Christ is it taken away.
verses.textEnEsv: But their minds were hardened. For to this day, when they read the old covenant, that same veil remains unlifted, because only through Christ is it taken away.
verses.textEnNkjv: But their minds were blinded. For until this day the same veil remains unlifted in the reading of the Old Testament, because the veil is taken away in Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: But the people’s minds were hardened, and to this day whenever the old covenant is being read, the same veil covers their minds so they cannot understand the truth. And this veil can be removed only by believing in Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: But their minds were hardened; for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains unlifted, because it is removed in Christ.
verses.textEn: But their minds were made dull, for to this day the same veil remains when the old covenant is read. It has not been removed, because only in Christ is it taken away.

verses.textZh: 可是直到今日，他们每逢诵读摩西的书的时候，这帕子还盖在他们的心上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是直到今日，他们每逢诵读摩西的书的时候，这帕子还盖在他们的心上。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而直到今日，每逢诵读摩西书的时候，帕子还在他们心上。
verses.textEnNiv: Even to this day when Moses is read, a veil covers their hearts.
verses.textEnEsv: Yes, to this day whenever Moses is read a veil lies over their hearts.
verses.textEnNkjv: But even to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, even today when they read Moses’ writings, their hearts are covered with that veil, and they do not understand.
verses.textEnNasb: But to this day whenever Moses is read, a veil lies over their hearts;
verses.textEn: Even to this day when Moses is read, a veil covers their hearts.

verses.textZh: 但他们甚么时候归向主，这帕子就甚么时候除掉了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们甚么时候归向主，这帕子就甚么时候除掉了。
verses.textZhCuv: 但他们的心几时归向主，帕子就几时除去了。
verses.textEnNiv: But whenever anyone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
verses.textEnEsv: But when one turns to the Lord, the veil is removed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless when one turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
verses.textEnNlt: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
verses.textEnNasb: but whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
verses.textEn: But whenever anyone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

verses.textZh: 主就是那灵；主的灵在哪里，哪里就有自由。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主就是那灵；主的灵在哪里，哪里就有自由。
verses.textZhCuv: 主就是那灵；主的灵在哪里，那里就得以自由。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord is the Spirit, and wherever the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.
verses.textEn: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.

verses.textZh: 我们众人脸上的帕子既然已经揭开，反映主的荣光 ，就变成主那样的形象，大有荣光。这是主所作成的，他就是那灵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们众人脸上的帕子既然已经揭开，反映主的荣光 ，就变成主那样的形象，大有荣光。这是主所作成的，他就是那灵。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们众人既然敞着脸得以看见主的荣光，好像从镜子里返照，就变成主的形状，荣上加荣，如同从主的灵变成的。
verses.textEnNiv: And we all, who with unveiled faces contemplate the Lord’s glory, are being transformed into his image with ever-increasing glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: And we all, with unveiled face, beholding the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into the same image from one degree of glory to another. For this comes from the Lord who is the Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: But we all, with unveiled face, beholding as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into the same image from glory to glory, just as by the Spirit of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So all of us who have had that veil removed can see and reflect the glory of the Lord. And the Lord—who is the Spirit—makes us more and more like him as we are changed into his glorious image.
verses.textEnNasb: But we all, with unveiled faces, looking as in a mirror at the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into the same image from glory to glory, just as from the Lord, the Spirit.
verses.textEn: And we all, who with unveiled faces contemplate the Lord’s glory, are being transformed into his image with ever-increasing glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.

verses.textZh: 所以，我们既然蒙了怜悯，得着这职分，就不沮丧，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我们既然蒙了怜悯，得着这职分，就不沮丧，
verses.textZhCuv: 我们既然蒙怜悯，受了这职分，就不丧胆，
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, since through God’s mercy we have this ministry, we do not lose heart.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, having this ministry by the mercy of God, we do not lose heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, since we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we do not lose heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, since God in his mercy has given us this new way, we never give up.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, since we have this ministry, as we received mercy, we do not lose heart,
verses.textEn: Therefore, since through God’s mercy we have this ministry, we do not lose heart.

verses.textZh: 却把暗昧可耻的事弃绝了；不行诡诈，不掺混神的道，反而借着显扬真理，在神面前把自己推荐给众人的良心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 却把暗昧可耻的事弃绝了；不行诡诈，不掺混神的道，反而借着显扬真理，在神面前把自己推荐给众人的良心。
verses.textZhCuv: 乃将那些暗昧可耻的事弃绝了；不行诡诈，不谬讲神的道理，只将真理表明出来，好在神面前把自己荐与各人的良心。
verses.textEnNiv: Rather, we have renounced secret and shameful ways; we do not use deception, nor do we distort the word of God. On the contrary, by setting forth the truth plainly we commend ourselves to everyone’s conscience in the sight of God.
verses.textEnEsv: But we have renounced disgraceful, underhanded ways. We refuse to practice cunning or to tamper with God’s word, but by the open statement of the truth we would commend ourselves to everyone’s conscience in the sight of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.
verses.textEnNlt: We reject all shameful deeds and underhanded methods. We don’t try to trick anyone or distort the word of God. We tell the truth before God, and all who are honest know this.
verses.textEnNasb: but we have renounced the things hidden because of shame, not walking in trickery nor distorting the word of God, but by the open proclamation of the truth commending ourselves to every person’s conscience in the sight of God.
verses.textEn: Rather, we have renounced secret and shameful ways; we do not use deception, nor do we distort the word of God. On the contrary, by setting forth the truth plainly we commend ourselves to everyone’s conscience in the sight of God.

verses.textZh: 如果我们的福音被蒙蔽了，那是对灭亡的人才蒙蔽的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我们的福音被蒙蔽了，那是对灭亡的人才蒙蔽的。
verses.textZhCuv: 如果我们的福音蒙蔽，就是蒙蔽在灭亡的人身上。
verses.textEnNiv: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing.
verses.textEnEsv: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing.
verses.textEnNkjv: But even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing,
verses.textEnNlt: If the Good News we preach is hidden behind a veil, it is hidden only from people who are perishing.
verses.textEnNasb: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing,
verses.textEn: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing.

verses.textZh: 这些不信的人被这世代的神弄瞎了他们的心眼，使他们看不见基督荣耀的福音的光；基督就是神的形象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些不信的人被这世代的神弄瞎了他们的心眼，使他们看不见基督荣耀的福音的光；基督就是神的形象。
verses.textZhCuv: 此等不信之人被这世界的神弄瞎了心眼，不叫基督荣耀福音的光照着他们。基督本是神的像。
verses.textEnNiv: The god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers, so that they cannot see the light of the gospel that displays the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.
verses.textEnEsv: In their case the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelievers, to keep them from seeing the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: whose minds the god of this age has blinded, who do not believe, lest the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine on them.
verses.textEnNlt: Satan, who is the god of this world, has blinded the minds of those who don’t believe. They are unable to see the glorious light of the Good News. They don’t understand this message about the glory of Christ, who is the exact likeness of God.
verses.textEnNasb: in whose case the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving so that they will not see the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.
verses.textEn: The god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers, so that they cannot see the light of the gospel that displays the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.

verses.textZh: 我们并不是传扬自己，而是传扬耶稣基督是主，并且为了耶稣的缘故成了你们的仆人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们并不是传扬自己，而是传扬耶稣基督是主，并且为了耶稣的缘故成了你们的仆人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们原不是传自己，乃是传基督耶稣为主，并且自己因耶稣作你们的仆人。
verses.textEnNiv: For what we preach is not ourselves, but Jesus Christ as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake.
verses.textEnEsv: For what we proclaim is not ourselves, but Jesus Christ as Lord, with ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we do not preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord, and ourselves your bondservants for Jesus’ sake.
verses.textEnNlt: You see, we don’t go around preaching about ourselves. We preach that Jesus Christ is Lord, and we ourselves are your servants for Jesus’ sake.
verses.textEnNasb: For we do not preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your bond-servants on account of Jesus.
verses.textEn: For what we preach is not ourselves, but Jesus Christ as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake.

verses.textZh: 因为那说"要有光从黑暗里照出来"的神，已经照在我们的心里，要我们把神的荣光照出去，就是使人可以认识那在基督脸上的荣光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为那说"要有光从黑暗里照出来"的神，已经照在我们的心里，要我们把神的荣光照出去，就是使人可以认识那在基督脸上的荣光。
verses.textZhCuv: 那吩咐光从黑暗里照出来的神，已经照在我们心里，叫我们得知神荣耀的光显在耶稣基督的面上。
verses.textEnNiv: For God, who said, "Let light shine out of darkness," made his light shine in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of God’s glory displayed in the face of Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: For God, who said, "Let light shine out of darkness," has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: For it is the God who commanded light to shine out of darkness, who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: For God, who said, "Let there be light in the darkness," has made this light shine in our hearts so we could know the glory of God that is seen in the face of Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: For God, who said, "Light shall shine out of darkness," is the One who has shone in our hearts to give the Light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Christ.
verses.textEn: For God, who said, "Let light shine out of darkness," made his light shine in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of God’s glory displayed in the face of Christ.

verses.textZh: 我们有这宝贝在瓦器里，是要显明这极大的能力是属于神，不是出于我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们有这宝贝在瓦器里，是要显明这极大的能力是属于神，不是出于我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们有这宝贝放在瓦器里，要显明这莫大的能力是出于神，不是出于我们。
verses.textEnNiv: But we have this treasure in jars of clay to show that this all-surpassing power is from God and not from us.
verses.textEnEsv: But we have this treasure in jars of clay, to show that the surpassing power belongs to God and not to us.
verses.textEnNkjv: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellence of the power may be of God and not of us.
verses.textEnNlt: We now have this light shining in our hearts, but we ourselves are like fragile clay jars containing this great treasure. This makes it clear that our great power is from God, not from ourselves.
verses.textEnNasb: But we have this treasure in earthen containers, so that the extraordinary greatness of the power will be of God and not from ourselves;
verses.textEn: But we have this treasure in jars of clay to show that this all-surpassing power is from God and not from us.

verses.textZh: 我们虽然四面受压，却没有压碎；心里作难，却不至绝望，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们虽然四面受压，却没有压碎；心里作难，却不至绝望，
verses.textZhCuv: 我们四面受敌，却不被困住；心里作难，却不至失望；
verses.textEnNiv: We are hard pressed on every side, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair;
verses.textEnEsv: We are afflicted in every way, but not crushed; perplexed, but not driven to despair;
verses.textEnNkjv: Weare hard-pressed on every side, yet not crushed; weare perplexed, but not in despair;
verses.textEnNlt: We are pressed on every side by troubles, but we are not crushed. We are perplexed, but not driven to despair.
verses.textEnNasb: we are afflicted in every way, but not crushed; perplexed, but not despairing;
verses.textEn: We are hard pressed on every side, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair;

verses.textZh: 受到迫害，却没有被丢弃；打倒了，却不至死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 受到迫害，却没有被丢弃；打倒了，却不至死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 遭逼迫，却不被丢弃；打倒了，却不至死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: persecuted, but not abandoned; struck down, but not destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: persecuted, but not forsaken; struck down, but not destroyed;
verses.textEnNkjv: persecuted, but not forsaken; struck down, but not destroyed—
verses.textEnNlt: We are hunted down, but never abandoned by God. We get knocked down, but we are not destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: persecuted, but not abandoned; struck down, but not destroyed;
verses.textEn: persecuted, but not abandoned; struck down, but not destroyed.

verses.textZh: 我们身上常常带着耶稣的死，好让耶稣的生也在我们的身上显明出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们身上常常带着耶稣的死，好让耶稣的生也在我们的身上显明出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 身上常带着耶稣的死，使耶稣的生也显明在我们身上。
verses.textEnNiv: We always carry around in our body the death of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.
verses.textEnEsv: always carrying in the body the death of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus also may be manifested in our bodies.
verses.textEnNkjv: always carrying about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus also may be manifested in our body.
verses.textEnNlt: Through suffering, our bodies continue to share in the death of Jesus so that the life of Jesus may also be seen in our bodies.
verses.textEnNasb: always carrying around in the body the dying of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.
verses.textEn: We always carry around in our body the death of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

verses.textZh: 我们这些活着的人，为耶稣的缘故常常被人置于死地，好让耶稣的生也在我们必死的身上显明出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们这些活着的人，为耶稣的缘故常常被人置于死地，好让耶稣的生也在我们必死的身上显明出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我们这活着的人是常为耶稣被交于死地，使耶稣的生在我们这必死的身上显明出来。
verses.textEnNiv: For we who are alive are always being given over to death for Jesus’ sake, so that his life may also be revealed in our mortal body.
verses.textEnEsv: For we who live are always being given over to death for Jesus’ sake, so that the life of Jesus also may be manifested in our mortal flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life of Jesus also may be manifested in our mortal flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, we live under constant danger of death because we serve Jesus, so that the life of Jesus will be evident in our dying bodies.
verses.textEnNasb: For we who live are constantly being handed over to death because of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our mortal flesh.
verses.textEn: For we who are alive are always being given over to death for Jesus’ sake, so that his life may also be revealed in our mortal body.

verses.textZh: 这样看来，死在我们身上运行，生却在你们的身上运行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样看来，死在我们身上运行，生却在你们的身上运行。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样看来，死是在我们身上发动，生却在你们身上发动。
verses.textEnNiv: So then, death is at work in us, but life is at work in you.
verses.textEnEsv: So death is at work in us, but life in you.
verses.textEnNkjv: So then death is working in us, but life in you.
verses.textEnNlt: So we live in the face of death, but this has resulted in eternal life for you.
verses.textEnNasb: So death works in us, but life in you.
verses.textEn: So then, death is at work in us, but life is at work in you.

verses.textZh: 经上记着说："我信，所以我说话。"我们既然有同样的信心 ，也就信，所以也说话，
verses.textZhCnvs: 经上记着说："我信，所以我说话。"我们既然有同样的信心 ，也就信，所以也说话，
verses.textZhCuv: 但我们既有信心，正如经上记着说：「我因信，所以如此说话。」我们也信，所以也说话。
verses.textEnNiv: It is written: "I believed; therefore I have spoken." Since we have that same spirit of faith, we also believe and therefore speak,
verses.textEnEsv: Since we have the same spirit of faith according to what has been written, "I believed, and so I spoke," we also believe, and so we also speak,
verses.textEnNkjv: And since we have the same spirit of faith, according to what is written, "I believed and therefore I spoke," we also believe and therefore speak,
verses.textEnNlt: But we continue to preach because we have the same kind of faith the psalmist had when he said, "I believed in God, so I spoke."
verses.textEnNasb: But having the same spirit of faith, according to what is written: "I believed, therefore I spoke," we also believe, therefore we also speak,
verses.textEn: It is written: "I believed; therefore I have spoken." Since we have that same spirit of faith, we also believe and therefore speak,

verses.textZh: 因为知道那使主耶稣复活的，也必定使我们与耶稣一同复活，并且把我们和你们呈献在他的面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为知道那使主耶稣复活的，也必定使我们与耶稣一同复活，并且把我们和你们呈献在他的面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 自己知道那叫主耶稣复活的，也必叫我们与耶稣一同复活，并且叫我们与你们一同站在他面前。
verses.textEnNiv: because we know that the one who raised the Lord Jesus from the dead will also raise us with Jesus and present us with you to himself.
verses.textEnEsv: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also with Jesus and bring us with you into his presence.
verses.textEnNkjv: knowing that He who raised up the Lord Jesus will also raise us up with Jesus, and will present us with you.
verses.textEnNlt: We know that God, who raised the Lord Jesus, will also raise us with Jesus and present us to himself together with you.
verses.textEnNasb: knowing that He who raised the Lord Jesus will also raise us with Jesus, and will present us with you.
verses.textEn: because we know that the one who raised the Lord Jesus from the dead will also raise us with Jesus and present us with you to himself.

verses.textZh: 这一切都是为了你们，好使恩惠既然因着许多人而增多，感恩的心也更加增多了，使荣耀归给神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这一切都是为了你们，好使恩惠既然因着许多人而增多，感恩的心也更加增多了，使荣耀归给神。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡事都是为你们，好叫恩惠因人多越发加增，感谢格外显多，以致荣耀归与神。
verses.textEnNiv: All this is for your benefit, so that the grace that is reaching more and more people may cause thanksgiving to overflow to the glory of God.
verses.textEnEsv: For it is all for your sake, so that as grace extends to more and more people it may increase thanksgiving, to the glory of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For all things are for your sakes, that grace, having spread through the many, may cause thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.
verses.textEnNlt: All of this is for your benefit. And as God’s grace reaches more and more people, there will be great thanksgiving, and God will receive more and more glory.
verses.textEnNasb: For all things are for your sakes, so that grace, having spread to more and more people, will cause thanksgiving to overflow to the glory of God.
verses.textEn: All this is for your benefit, so that the grace that is reaching more and more people may cause thanksgiving to overflow to the glory of God.

verses.textZh: 所以，我们并不沮丧，我们外面的人虽然渐渐朽坏，但里面的人却日日更新，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我们并不沮丧，我们外面的人虽然渐渐朽坏，但里面的人却日日更新，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我们不丧胆。外体虽然毁坏，内心却一天新似一天。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore we do not lose heart. Though outwardly we are wasting away, yet inwardly we are being renewed day by day.
verses.textEnEsv: So we do not lose heart. Though our outer self is wasting away, our inner self is being renewed day by day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore we do not lose heart. Even though our outward man is perishing, yet the inward man is being renewed day by day.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why we never give up. Though our bodies are dying, our spirits are being renewed every day.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore we do not lose heart, but though our outer person is decaying, yet our inner person is being renewed day by day.
verses.textEn: Therefore we do not lose heart. Though outwardly we are wasting away, yet inwardly we are being renewed day by day.

verses.textZh: 因为我们短暂轻微的患难，是要为我们成就极大无比、永远的荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我们短暂轻微的患难，是要为我们成就极大无比、永远的荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们这至暂至轻的苦楚，要为我们成就极重无比、永远的荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: For our light and momentary troubles are achieving for us an eternal glory that far outweighs them all.
verses.textEnEsv: For this light momentary affliction is preparing for us an eternal weight of glory beyond all comparison,
verses.textEnNkjv: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, is working for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory,
verses.textEnNlt: For our present troubles are small and won’t last very long. Yet they produce for us a glory that vastly outweighs them and will last forever!
verses.textEnNasb: For our momentary, light affliction is producing for us an eternal weight of glory far beyond all comparison,
verses.textEn: For our light and momentary troubles are achieving for us an eternal glory that far outweighs them all.

verses.textZh: 我们所顾念的，不是看得见的，而是看不见的；因为看得见的是暂时的，看不见的是永远的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们所顾念的，不是看得见的，而是看不见的；因为看得见的是暂时的，看不见的是永远的。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来我们不是顾念所见的，乃是顾念所不见的；因为所见的是暂时的，所不见的是永远的。
verses.textEnNiv: So we fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen, since what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.
verses.textEnEsv: as we look not to the things that are seen but to the things that are unseen. For the things that are seen are transient, but the things that are unseen are eternal.
verses.textEnNkjv: while we do not look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporary, but the things which are not seen are eternal.
verses.textEnNlt: So we don’t look at the troubles we can see now; rather, we fix our gaze on things that cannot be seen. For the things we see now will soon be gone, but the things we cannot see will last forever.
verses.textEnNasb: while we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen; for the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.
verses.textEn: So we fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen, since what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.

verses.textZh: 我们知道，如果我们在地上的帐棚拆毁了，我们必得着从神而来的居所。那不是人手所造的，而是天上永存的房屋。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们知道，如果我们在地上的帐棚拆毁了，我们必得着从神而来的居所。那不是人手所造的，而是天上永存的房屋。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们原知道，我们这地上的帐棚若拆毁了，必得神所造，不是人手所造，在天上永存的房屋。
verses.textEnNiv: For we know that if the earthly tent we live in is destroyed, we have a building from God, an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands.
verses.textEnEsv: For we know that if the tent that is our earthly home is destroyed, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we know that if our earthly house, this tent, is destroyed, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
verses.textEnNlt: For we know that when this earthly tent we live in is taken down (that is, when we die and leave this earthly body), we will have a house in heaven, an eternal body made for us by God himself and not by human hands.
verses.textEnNasb: For we know that if our earthly tent which is our house is torn down, we have a building from God, a house not made by hands, eternal in the heavens.
verses.textEn: For we know that if the earthly tent we live in is destroyed, we have a building from God, an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands.

verses.textZh: 我们现今在这帐棚里面叹息，渴望迁到那天上的住处，好象换上新的衣服；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们现今在这帐棚里面叹息，渴望迁到那天上的住处，好象换上新的衣服；
verses.textZhCuv: 我们在这帐棚里叹息，深想得那从天上来的房屋，好像穿上衣服；
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile we groan, longing to be clothed instead with our heavenly dwelling,
verses.textEnEsv: For in this tent we groan, longing to put on our heavenly dwelling,
verses.textEnNkjv: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,
verses.textEnNlt: We grow weary in our present bodies, and we long to put on our heavenly bodies like new clothing.
verses.textEnNasb: For indeed, in this tent we groan, longing to be clothed with our dwelling from heaven,
verses.textEn: Meanwhile we groan, longing to be clothed instead with our heavenly dwelling,

verses.textZh: 如果穿上了，就不会赤身出现了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果穿上了，就不会赤身出现了。
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若穿上，被遇见的时候就不至于赤身了。
verses.textEnNiv: because when we are clothed, we will not be found naked.
verses.textEnEsv: if indeed by putting it on we may not be found naked.
