verses.textEnNkjv: if indeed, having been clothed, we shall not be found naked.
verses.textEnNlt: For we will put on heavenly bodies; we will not be spirits without bodies.
verses.textEnNasb: since in fact after putting it on, we will not be found naked.
verses.textEn: because when we are clothed, we will not be found naked.

verses.textZh: 我们这些在帐棚里面的人，劳苦叹息，是由于不愿意脱去这个，却愿意穿上那个，使这必死的被生命吞灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们这些在帐棚里面的人，劳苦叹息，是由于不愿意脱去这个，却愿意穿上那个，使这必死的被生命吞灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们在这帐棚里叹息劳苦，并非愿意脱下这个，乃是愿意穿上那个，好叫这必死的被生命吞灭了。
verses.textEnNiv: For while we are in this tent, we groan and are burdened, because we do not wish to be unclothed but to be clothed instead with our heavenly dwelling, so that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.
verses.textEnEsv: For while we are still in this tent, we groan, being burdened—not that we would be unclothed, but that we would be further clothed, so that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we who are in this tent groan, being burdened, not because we want to be unclothed, but further clothed, that mortality may be swallowed up by life.
verses.textEnNlt: While we live in these earthly bodies, we groan and sigh, but it’s not that we want to die and get rid of these bodies that clothe us. Rather, we want to put on our new bodies so that these dying bodies will be swallowed up by life.
verses.textEnNasb: For indeed, we who are in this tent groan, being burdened, because we do not want to be unclothed but to be clothed, so that what is mortal will be swallowed up by life.
verses.textEn: For while we are in this tent, we groan and are burdened, because we do not wish to be unclothed but to be clothed instead with our heavenly dwelling, so that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

verses.textZh: 那在我们身上完成了工作，使我们达成这目标的，就是神。他已经把圣灵赐给我们作凭据。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那在我们身上完成了工作，使我们达成这目标的，就是神。他已经把圣灵赐给我们作凭据。
verses.textZhCuv: 为此，培植我们的就是神，他又赐给我们圣灵作凭据 。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the one who has fashioned us for this very purpose is God, who has given us the Spirit as a deposit, guaranteeing what is to come.
verses.textEnEsv: He who has prepared us for this very thing is God, who has given us the Spirit as a guarantee.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now He who has prepared us for this very thing is God, who also has given us the Spirit as a guarantee.
verses.textEnNlt: God himself has prepared us for this, and as a guarantee he has given us his Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: Now He who prepared us for this very purpose is God, who gave us the Spirit as a pledge.
verses.textEn: Now the one who has fashioned us for this very purpose is God, who has given us the Spirit as a deposit, guaranteeing what is to come.

verses.textZh: 我们既然一向都是坦然无惧的，又知道住在身内就是与主分开 ，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们既然一向都是坦然无惧的，又知道住在身内就是与主分开 ，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我们时常坦然无惧，并且晓得我们住在身内，便与主相离。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore we are always confident and know that as long as we are at home in the body we are away from the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: So we are always of good courage. We know that while we are at home in the body we are away from the Lord,
verses.textEnNkjv: So weare always confident, knowing that while we are at home in the body we are absent from the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So we are always confident, even though we know that as long as we live in these bodies we are not at home with the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, being always of good courage, and knowing that while we are at home in the body we are absent from the Lord—
verses.textEn: Therefore we are always confident and know that as long as we are at home in the body we are away from the Lord.

verses.textZh: 现在还是坦然无惧，宁愿与身体分开，与主同住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在还是坦然无惧，宁愿与身体分开，与主同住。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我们行事为人是凭着信心，不是凭着眼见。
verses.textEnNiv: For we live by faith, not by sight.
verses.textEnEsv: for we walk by faith, not by sight.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we walk by faith, not by sight.
verses.textEnNlt: For we live by believing and not by seeing.
verses.textEnNasb: for we walk by faith, not by sight—
verses.textEn: For we live by faith, not by sight.

verses.textZh: 因此，我们立定志向，无论住在身内或是与身体分开，都要讨主的喜悦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我们立定志向，无论住在身内或是与身体分开，都要讨主的喜悦。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们坦然无惧，是更愿意离开身体与主同住。
verses.textEnNiv: We are confident, I say, and would prefer to be away from the body and at home with the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: Yes, we are of good courage, and we would rather be away from the body and at home with the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: We are confident, yes, well pleased rather to be absent from the body and to be present with the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, we are fully confident, and we would rather be away from these earthly bodies, for then we will be at home with the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: but we are of good courage and prefer rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.
verses.textEn: We are confident, I say, and would prefer to be away from the body and at home with the Lord.

verses.textZh: 因为我们众人都必须在基督的审判台前显露出来，使各人按着本身所行的，或善或恶，受到报应。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我们众人都必须在基督的审判台前显露出来，使各人按着本身所行的，或善或恶，受到报应。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，无论是住在身内，离开身外，我们立了志向，要得主的喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: So we make it our goal to please him, whether we are at home in the body or away from it.
verses.textEnEsv: So whether we are at home or away, we make it our aim to please him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore we make it our aim, whether present or absent, to be well pleasing to Him.
verses.textEnNlt: So whether we are here in this body or away from this body, our goal is to please him.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore we also have as our ambition, whether at home or absent, to be pleasing to Him.
verses.textEn: So we make it our goal to please him, whether we are at home in the body or away from it.

verses.textZh: 我们既然知道主是可畏的，就劝勉众人。我们在神面前是显明的，我盼望在你们的良心里也是显明的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们既然知道主是可畏的，就劝勉众人。我们在神面前是显明的，我盼望在你们的良心里也是显明的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我们众人必要在基督台前显露出来，叫各人按着本身所行的，或善或恶受报。
verses.textEnNiv: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, so that each of us may receive what is due us for the things done while in the body, whether good or bad.
verses.textEnEsv: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, so that each one may receive what is due for what he has done in the body, whether good or evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, that each one may receive the things done in the body, according to what he has done, whether good or bad.
verses.textEnNlt: For we must all stand before Christ to be judged. We will each receive whatever we deserve for the good or evil we have done in this earthly body.
verses.textEnNasb: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, so that each one may receive compensation for his deeds done through the body, in accordance with what he has done, whether good or bad.
verses.textEn: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, so that each of us may receive what is due us for the things done while in the body, whether good or bad.

verses.textZh: 我们不是又再向你们推荐自己，而是给你们机会以我们为乐，使你们可以应付那些只夸外貌不夸内心的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们不是又再向你们推荐自己，而是给你们机会以我们为乐，使你们可以应付那些只夸外貌不夸内心的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们既知道主是可畏的，所以劝人。但我们在神面前是显明的，盼望在你们的良心里也是显明的。
verses.textEnNiv: Since, then, we know what it is to fear the Lord, we try to persuade others. What we are is plain to God, and I hope it is also plain to your conscience.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, knowing the fear of the Lord, we persuade others. But what we are is known to God, and I hope it is known also to your conscience.
verses.textEnNkjv: Knowing, therefore, the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are well known to God, and I also trust are well known in your consciences.
verses.textEnNlt: Because we understand our fearful responsibility to the Lord, we work hard to persuade others. God knows we are sincere, and I hope you know this, too.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, knowing the fear of the Lord, we persuade people, but we are well known to God; and I hope that we are also well known in your consciences.
verses.textEn: Since, then, we know what it is to fear the Lord, we try to persuade others. What we are is plain to God, and I hope it is also plain to your conscience.

verses.textZh: 如果我们疯狂，那是为了神；如果我们清醒，那是为了你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我们疯狂，那是为了神；如果我们清醒，那是为了你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们不是向你们再举荐自己，乃是叫你们因我们有可夸之处，好对那凭外貌不凭内心夸口的人，有言可答。
verses.textEnNiv: We are not trying to commend ourselves to you again, but are giving you an opportunity to take pride in us, so that you can answer those who take pride in what is seen rather than in what is in the heart.
verses.textEnEsv: We are not commending ourselves to you again but giving you cause to boast about us, so that you may be able to answer those who boast about outward appearance and not about what is in the heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we do not commend ourselves again to you, but give you opportunity to boast on our behalf, that you may have ananswer for those who boast in appearance and not in heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Are we commending ourselves to you again? No, we are giving you a reason to be proud of us, so you can answer those who brag about having a spectacular ministry rather than having a sincere heart.
verses.textEnNasb: We are not commending ourselves to you again, but are giving you an opportunity to be proud of us, so that you will have an answer for those who take pride in appearance and not in heart.
verses.textEn: We are not trying to commend ourselves to you again, but are giving you an opportunity to take pride in us, so that you can answer those who take pride in what is seen rather than in what is in the heart.

verses.textZh: 原来基督的爱催逼着我们，因为我们断定一个人替众人死了，众人就都死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来基督的爱催逼着我们，因为我们断定一个人替众人死了，众人就都死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若果颠狂，是为神；若果谨守，是为你们。
verses.textEnNiv: If we are "out of our mind," as some say, it is for God; if we are in our right mind, it is for you.
verses.textEnEsv: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God; if we are in our right mind, it is for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if we are beside ourselves, itis for God; or if we are of sound mind, itis for you.
verses.textEnNlt: If it seems we are crazy, it is to bring glory to God. And if we are in our right minds, it is for your benefit.
verses.textEnNasb: For if we have lost our minds, it is for God; if we are of sound mind, it is for you.
verses.textEn: If we are "out of our mind," as some say, it is for God; if we are in our right mind, it is for you.

verses.textZh: 他替众人死了，为的是要使活着的人不再为自己活着，却为那替他们死而复活的主而活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他替众人死了，为的是要使活着的人不再为自己活着，却为那替他们死而复活的主而活。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来基督的爱激励我们；因我们想，一人既替众人死，众人就都死了；
verses.textEnNiv: For Christ’s love compels us, because we are convinced that one died for all, and therefore all died.
verses.textEnEsv: For the love of Christ controls us, because we have concluded this: that one has died for all, therefore all have died;
verses.textEnNkjv: For the love of Christ compels us, because we judge thus: that if One died for all, then all died;
verses.textEnNlt: Either way, Christ’s love controls us. Since we believe that Christ died for all, we also believe that we have all died to our old life.
verses.textEnNasb: For the love of Christ controls us, having concluded this, that one died for all, therefore all died;
verses.textEn: For Christ’s love compels us, because we are convinced that one died for all, and therefore all died.

verses.textZh: 所以，从今以后，我们不再按照人的看法认识人；虽然我们曾经按照人的看法认识基督，但现在不再这样了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，从今以后，我们不再按照人的看法认识人；虽然我们曾经按照人的看法认识基督，但现在不再这样了。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且他替众人死，是叫那些活着的人不再为自己活，乃为替他们死而复活的主活。
verses.textEnNiv: And he died for all, that those who live should no longer live for themselves but for him who died for them and was raised again.
verses.textEnEsv: and he died for all, that those who live might no longer live for themselves but for him who for their sake died and was raised.
verses.textEnNkjv: and He died for all, that those who live should live no longer for themselves, but for Him who died for them and rose again.
verses.textEnNlt: He died for everyone so that those who receive his new life will no longer live for themselves. Instead, they will live for Christ, who died and was raised for them.
verses.textEnNasb: and He died for all, so that those who live would no longer live for themselves, but for Him who died and rose on their behalf.
verses.textEn: And he died for all, that those who live should no longer live for themselves but for him who died for them and was raised again.

verses.textZh: 如果有人在基督里，他就是新造的人，旧事已经过去，你看，都变成新的了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人在基督里，他就是新造的人，旧事已经过去，你看，都变成新的了！
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我们从今以后，不凭着外貌 认人了。虽然凭着外貌认过基督，如今却不再这样认他了。
verses.textEnNiv: So from now on we regard no one from a worldly point of view. Though we once regarded Christ in this way, we do so no longer.
verses.textEnEsv: From now on, therefore, we regard no one according to the flesh. Even though we once regarded Christ according to the flesh, we regard him thus no longer.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, from now on, we regard no one according to the flesh. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know Himthus no longer.
verses.textEnNlt: So we have stopped evaluating others from a human point of view. At one time we thought of Christ merely from a human point of view. How differently we know him now!
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore from now on we recognize no one by the flesh; even though we have known Christ by the flesh, yet now we know Him in this way no longer.
verses.textEn: So from now on we regard no one from a worldly point of view. Though we once regarded Christ in this way, we do so no longer.

verses.textZh: 这一切都是出于神，他借着基督使我们与他自己和好，并且把这和好的职分赐给我们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这一切都是出于神，他借着基督使我们与他自己和好，并且把这和好的职分赐给我们，
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人在基督里，他就是新造的人，旧事已过，都变成新的了。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here!
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away; behold, the new has come.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, heis a new creation; old things have passed away; behold, all things have become new.
verses.textEnNlt: This means that anyone who belongs to Christ has become a new person. The old life is gone; a new life has begun!
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, this person is a new creation; the old things passed away; behold, new things have come.
verses.textEn: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here!

verses.textZh: 就是神在基督里使世人与他自己和好，不再追究他们的过犯，并且把和好的道理托付了我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是神在基督里使世人与他自己和好，不再追究他们的过犯，并且把和好的道理托付了我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 一切都是出于神；他藉着基督使我们与他和好，又将劝人与他和好的职分赐给我们。
verses.textEnNiv: All this is from God, who reconciled us to himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation:
verses.textEnEsv: All this is from God, who through Christ reconciled us to himself and gave us the ministry of reconciliation;
verses.textEnNkjv: Now all things are of God, who has reconciled us to Himself through Jesus Christ, and has given us the ministry of reconciliation,
verses.textEnNlt: And all of this is a gift from God, who brought us back to himself through Christ. And God has given us this task of reconciling people to him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now all these things are from God, who reconciled us to Himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation,
verses.textEn: All this is from God, who reconciled us to himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation:

verses.textZh: 因此，我们就是基督的使者，神借着我们劝告世人。我们代替基督请求你们：跟神和好吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我们就是基督的使者，神借着我们劝告世人。我们代替基督请求你们：跟神和好吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 这就是神在基督里，叫世人与自己和好，不将他们的过犯归到他们身上，并且将这和好的道理托付了我们。
verses.textEnNiv: that God was reconciling the world to himself in Christ, not counting people’s sins against them. And he has committed to us the message of reconciliation.
verses.textEnEsv: that is, in Christ God was reconciling the world to himself, not counting their trespasses against them, and entrusting to us the message of reconciliation.
verses.textEnNkjv: that is, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to Himself, not imputing their trespasses to them, and has committed to us the word of reconciliation.
verses.textEnNlt: For God was in Christ, reconciling the world to himself, no longer counting people’s sins against them. And he gave us this wonderful message of reconciliation.
verses.textEnNasb: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to Himself, not counting their wrongdoings against them, and He has committed to us the word of reconciliation.
verses.textEn: that God was reconciling the world to himself in Christ, not counting people’s sins against them. And he has committed to us the message of reconciliation.

verses.textZh: 神使那无罪的替我们成为有罪的，使我们在他里面成为神的义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神使那无罪的替我们成为有罪的，使我们在他里面成为神的义。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我们作基督的使者，就好像神藉我们劝你们一般。我们替基督求你们与神和好。
verses.textEnNiv: We are therefore Christ’s ambassadors, as though God were making his appeal through us. We implore you on Christ’s behalf: Be reconciled to God.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, we are ambassadors for Christ, God making his appeal through us. We implore you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now then, we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God were pleading through us: we implore you on Christ’s behalf, be reconciled to God.
verses.textEnNlt: So we are Christ’s ambassadors; God is making his appeal through us. We speak for Christ when we plead, "Come back to God!"
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God were making an appeal through us; we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.
verses.textEn: We are therefore Christ’s ambassadors, as though God were making his appeal through us. We implore you on Christ’s behalf: Be reconciled to God.

verses.textZh: 神使那无罪 的，替我们成为罪，好叫我们在他里面成为神的义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神使那无罪 的，替我们成为罪，好叫我们在他里面成为神的义。
verses.textZhCuv: 神使那无罪 的，替我们成为罪，好叫我们在他里面成为神的义。
verses.textEnNiv: God made him who had no sin to be sin for us, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
verses.textEnEsv: For our sake he made him to be sin who knew no sin, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He made Him who knew no sin tobe sin for us, that we might become the righteousness of God in Him.
verses.textEnNlt: For God made Christ, who never sinned, to be the offering for our sin, so that we could be made right with God through Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: He made Him who knew no sin to be sin in our behalf, so that we might become the righteousness of God in Him.
verses.textEn: God made him who had no sin to be sin for us, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

verses.textZh: 我们这些与神同工的，也劝你们不要白受神的恩典。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们这些与神同工的，也劝你们不要白受神的恩典。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们与神同工的，也劝你们不可徒受他的恩典。
verses.textEnNiv: As God’s co-workers we urge you not to receive God’s grace in vain.
verses.textEnEsv: Working together with him, then, we appeal to you not to receive the grace of God in vain.
verses.textEnNkjv: We then, as workers together withHim also plead with you not to receive the grace of God in vain.
verses.textEnNlt: As God’s partners, we beg you not to accept this marvelous gift of God’s kindness and then ignore it.
verses.textEnNasb: And working together with Him, we also urge you not to receive the grace of God in vain—
verses.textEn: As God’s co-workers we urge you not to receive God’s grace in vain.

verses.textZh: 因为他说： "在悦纳的时候，我应允了你； 在拯救的日子，我帮助了你。" 看哪！现在就是悦纳的时候，现在就是拯救的日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他说： "在悦纳的时候，我应允了你； 在拯救的日子，我帮助了你。" 看哪！现在就是悦纳的时候，现在就是拯救的日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他说：「在悦纳的时候，我应允了你；在拯救的日子，我搭救了你。」看哪，现在正是悦纳的时候！现在正是拯救的日子；
verses.textEnNiv: For he says, "In the time of my favor I heard you, and in the day of salvation I helped you." I tell you, now is the time of God’s favor, now is the day of salvation.
verses.textEnEsv: For he says, "In a favorable time I listened to you, and in a day of salvation I have helped you." Behold, now is the favorable time; behold, now is the day of salvation.
verses.textEnNkjv: For He says: "In an acceptable time I have heard you, And in the day of salvation I have helped you." Behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: For God says, "At just the right time, I heard you. On the day of salvation, I helped you." Indeed, the "right time" is now. Today is the day of salvation.
verses.textEnNasb: for He says, "At a favorable time I listened to you, And on a day of salvation I helped you." Behold, now is "a favorable time," behold, now is "a day of salvation"—
verses.textEn: For he says, "In the time of my favor I heard you, and in the day of salvation I helped you." I tell you, now is the time of God’s favor, now is the day of salvation.

verses.textZh: 我们凡事都没有妨碍人，不让这职分受到毁谤，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们凡事都没有妨碍人，不让这职分受到毁谤，
verses.textZhCuv: 我们凡事都不叫人有妨碍，免得这职分被人毁谤；
verses.textEnNiv: We put no stumbling block in anyone’s path, so that our ministry will not be discredited.
verses.textEnEsv: We put no obstacle in anyone’s way, so that no fault may be found with our ministry,
verses.textEnNkjv: We give no offense in anything, that our ministry may not be blamed.
verses.textEnNlt: We live in such a way that no one will stumble because of us, and no one will find fault with our ministry.
verses.textEnNasb: giving no reason for taking offense in anything, so that the ministry will not be discredited,
verses.textEn: We put no stumbling block in anyone’s path, so that our ministry will not be discredited.

verses.textZh: 反而在各样的事上，表明自己是神的仆人，就如持久的忍耐、患难、贫乏、困苦、
verses.textZhCnvs: 反而在各样的事上，表明自己是神的仆人，就如持久的忍耐、患难、贫乏、困苦、
verses.textZhCuv: 反倒在各样的事上表明自己是神的用人，就如在许多的忍耐、患难、穷乏、困苦、
verses.textEnNiv: Rather, as servants of God we commend ourselves in every way: in great endurance; in troubles, hardships and distresses;
verses.textEnEsv: but as servants of God we commend ourselves in every way: by great endurance, in afflictions, hardships, calamities,
verses.textEnNkjv: But in all things we commend ourselves as ministers of God: in much patience, in tribulations, in needs, in distresses,
verses.textEnNlt: In everything we do, we show that we are true ministers of God. We patiently endure troubles and hardships and calamities of every kind.
verses.textEnNasb: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God, in much endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in difficulties,
verses.textEn: Rather, as servants of God we commend ourselves in every way: in great endurance; in troubles, hardships and distresses;

verses.textZh: 鞭打、监禁、扰乱、劳苦、不睡觉、禁食、
verses.textZhCnvs: 鞭打、监禁、扰乱、劳苦、不睡觉、禁食、
verses.textZhCuv: 鞭打、监禁、扰乱、勤劳、警醒、不食、
verses.textEnNiv: in beatings, imprisonments and riots; in hard work, sleepless nights and hunger;
verses.textEnEsv: beatings, imprisonments, riots, labors, sleepless nights, hunger;
verses.textEnNkjv: in stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labors, in sleeplessness, in fastings;
verses.textEnNlt: We have been beaten, been put in prison, faced angry mobs, worked to exhaustion, endured sleepless nights, and gone without food.
verses.textEnNasb: in beatings, in imprisonments, in mob attacks, in labors, in sleeplessness, in hunger,
verses.textEn: in beatings, imprisonments and riots; in hard work, sleepless nights and hunger;

verses.textZh: 纯洁、知识、容忍、恩慈、圣灵、无伪的爱心、
verses.textZhCnvs: 纯洁、知识、容忍、恩慈、圣灵、无伪的爱心、
verses.textZhCuv: 廉洁、知识、恒忍、恩慈、圣灵的感化、无伪的爱心、
verses.textEnNiv: in purity, understanding, patience and kindness; in the Holy Spirit and in sincere love;
verses.textEnEsv: by purity, knowledge, patience, kindness, the Holy Spirit, genuine love;
verses.textEnNkjv: by purity, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Spirit, by sincere love,
verses.textEnNlt: We prove ourselves by our purity, our understanding, our patience, our kindness, by the Holy Spirit within us, and by our sincere love.
verses.textEnNasb: in purity, in knowledge, in patience, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in genuine love,
verses.textEn: in purity, understanding, patience and kindness; in the Holy Spirit and in sincere love;

verses.textZh: 真理的道、神的大能等事上；并且是借着左右两手中公义的武器，
verses.textZhCnvs: 真理的道、神的大能等事上；并且是借着左右两手中公义的武器，
verses.textZhCuv: 真实的道理、神的大能；仁义的兵器在左在右；
verses.textEnNiv: in truthful speech and in the power of God; with weapons of righteousness in the right hand and in the left;
verses.textEnEsv: by truthful speech, and the power of God; with the weapons of righteousness for the right hand and for the left;
verses.textEnNkjv: by the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
verses.textEnNlt: We faithfully preach the truth. God’s power is working in us. We use the weapons of righteousness in the right hand for attack and the left hand for defense.
verses.textEnNasb: in the word of truth, and in the power of God; by the weapons of righteousness for the right hand and the left,
verses.textEn: in truthful speech and in the power of God; with weapons of righteousness in the right hand and in the left;

verses.textZh: 借着荣耀和羞辱、坏名声和好名誉。我们好象是骗人的，却是真诚的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 借着荣耀和羞辱、坏名声和好名誉。我们好象是骗人的，却是真诚的，
verses.textZhCuv: 荣耀、羞辱，恶名、美名；似乎是诱惑人的，却是诚实的；
verses.textEnNiv: through glory and dishonor, bad report and good report; genuine, yet regarded as impostors;
verses.textEnEsv: through honor and dishonor, through slander and praise. We are treated as impostors, and yet are true;
verses.textEnNkjv: by honor and dishonor, by evil report and good report; as deceivers, and yet true;
verses.textEnNlt: We serve God whether people honor us or despise us, whether they slander us or praise us. We are honest, but they call us impostors.
verses.textEnNasb: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report; regarded as deceivers and yet true;
verses.textEn: through glory and dishonor, bad report and good report; genuine, yet regarded as impostors;

verses.textZh: 好象是人所不知的，却是人所共知的；好象是必死的，你看，我们却是活着的；好象是受惩罚的，却没有处死；
verses.textZhCnvs: 好象是人所不知的，却是人所共知的；好象是必死的，你看，我们却是活着的；好象是受惩罚的，却没有处死；
verses.textZhCuv: 似乎不为人所知，却是人所共知的；似乎要死，却是活着的；似乎受责罚，却是不至丧命的；
verses.textEnNiv: known, yet regarded as unknown; dying, and yet we live on; beaten, and yet not killed;
verses.textEnEsv: as unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and behold, we live; as punished, and yet not killed;
verses.textEnNkjv: as unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and behold we live; as chastened, and yet not killed;
verses.textEnNlt: We are ignored, even though we are well known. We live close to death, but we are still alive. We have been beaten, but we have not been killed.
verses.textEnNasb: as unknown and yet well known, as dying and yet behold, we are alive; as punished and yet not put to death,
verses.textEn: known, yet regarded as unknown; dying, and yet we live on; beaten, and yet not killed;

verses.textZh: 好象忧愁，却是常常喜乐的；好象贫穷，却使很多人富足；好象是甚么都没有，却是样样都有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好象忧愁，却是常常喜乐的；好象贫穷，却使很多人富足；好象是甚么都没有，却是样样都有。
verses.textZhCuv: 似乎忧愁，却是常常快乐的；似乎贫穷，却是叫许多人富足的；似乎一无所有，却是样样都有的。
verses.textEnNiv: sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; poor, yet making many rich; having nothing, and yet possessing everything.
verses.textEnEsv: as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, yet possessing everything.
verses.textEnNkjv: as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
verses.textEnNlt: Our hearts ache, but we always have joy. We are poor, but we give spiritual riches to others. We own nothing, and yet we have everything.
verses.textEnNasb: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.
verses.textEn: sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; poor, yet making many rich; having nothing, and yet possessing everything.

verses.textZh: 哥林多人哪！我们对你们，口是坦率的，心是宽宏的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哥林多人哪！我们对你们，口是坦率的，心是宽宏的。
verses.textZhCuv: 哥林多人哪，我们向你们，口是张开的，心是宽宏的。
verses.textEnNiv: We have spoken freely to you, Corinthians, and opened wide our hearts to you.
verses.textEnEsv: We have spoken freely to you, Corinthians; our heart is wide open.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Corinthians! We have spoken openly to you, our heart is wide open.
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, dear Corinthian friends! We have spoken honestly with you, and our hearts are open to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Our mouth has spoken freely to you, you Corinthians, our heart is opened wide.
verses.textEn: We have spoken freely to you, Corinthians, and opened wide our hearts to you.

verses.textZh: 并不是我们对你们器量小，而是你们自己心胸狭窄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并不是我们对你们器量小，而是你们自己心胸狭窄。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们狭窄，原不在乎我们，是在乎自己的心肠狭窄。
verses.textEnNiv: We are not withholding our affection from you, but you are withholding yours from us.
verses.textEnEsv: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted in your own affections.
verses.textEnNkjv: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.
verses.textEnNlt: There is no lack of love on our part, but you have withheld your love from us.
verses.textEnNasb: You are not restrained by us, but you are restrained in your own affections.
verses.textEn: We are not withholding our affection from you, but you are withholding yours from us.

verses.textZh: 你们也要照样以宽宏的心对待我们，这话正像是我对儿女说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们也要照样以宽宏的心对待我们，这话正像是我对儿女说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们也要照样用宽宏的心报答我。我这话正像对自己的孩子说的。
verses.textEnNiv: As a fair exchange—I speak as to my children—open wide your hearts also.
verses.textEnEsv: In return (I speak as to children) widen your hearts also.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now in return for the same (I speak as to children), you also be open.
verses.textEnNlt: I am asking you to respond as if you were my own children. Open your hearts to us!
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the same way in exchange—I am speaking as to children—open wide your hearts to us, you as well.
verses.textEn: As a fair exchange—I speak as to my children—open wide your hearts also.

verses.textZh: 你们和不信的人不可共负一轭，义和不法有甚么相同呢？光明和黑暗怎能相通呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们和不信的人不可共负一轭，义和不法有甚么相同呢？光明和黑暗怎能相通呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们和不信的原不相配，不要同负一轭。义和不义有什么相交呢？光明和黑暗有什么相通呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be yoked together with unbelievers. For what do righteousness and wickedness have in common? Or what fellowship can light have with darkness?
verses.textEnEsv: Do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers. For what partnership has righteousness with lawlessness? Or what fellowship has light with darkness?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not be unequally yoked together with unbelievers. For what fellowship has righteousness with lawlessness? And what communion has light with darkness?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t team up with those who are unbelievers. How can righteousness be a partner with wickedness? How can light live with darkness?
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be mismatched with unbelievers; for what do righteousness and lawlessness share together, or what does light have in common with darkness?
verses.textEn: Do not be yoked together with unbelievers. For what do righteousness and wickedness have in common? Or what fellowship can light have with darkness?

verses.textZh: 基督和彼列 怎能和谐呢？信的和不信的有甚么联系呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 基督和彼列 怎能和谐呢？信的和不信的有甚么联系呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 基督和彼列 有什么相和呢？信主的和不信主的有什么相干呢？
verses.textEnNiv: What harmony is there between Christ and Belial ? Or what does a believer have in common with an unbeliever?
verses.textEnEsv: What accord has Christ with Belial? Or what portion does a believer share with an unbeliever?
verses.textEnNkjv: And what accord has Christ with Belial? Or what part has a believer with an unbeliever?
verses.textEnNlt: What harmony can there be between Christ and the devil ? How can a believer be a partner with an unbeliever?
verses.textEnNasb: Or what harmony does Christ have with Belial, or what does a believer share with an unbeliever?
verses.textEn: What harmony is there between Christ and Belial ? Or what does a believer have in common with an unbeliever?

verses.textZh: 神的殿和偶像怎能协调呢？我们就是永生神的殿，正如神说： "我要住在他们中间， 在他们中间来往； 我要作他们的神， 他们要作我的子民。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的殿和偶像怎能协调呢？我们就是永生神的殿，正如神说： "我要住在他们中间， 在他们中间来往； 我要作他们的神， 他们要作我的子民。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神的殿和偶像有什么相同呢？因为我们是永生神的殿，就如神曾说： 我要在他们中间居住， 在他们中间来往； 我要作他们的神； 他们要作我的子民。
verses.textEnNiv: What agreement is there between the temple of God and idols? For we are the temple of the living God. As God has said: "I will live with them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they will be my people."
verses.textEnEsv: What agreement has the temple of God with idols? For we are the temple of the living God; as God said, "I will make my dwelling among them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And what agreement has the temple of God with idols? For you are the temple of the living God. As God has said: "I will dwell in them And walk among them. I will be their God, And they shall be My people."
verses.textEnNlt: And what union can there be between God’s temple and idols? For we are the temple of the living God. As God said: "I will live in them and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
verses.textEnNasb: Or what agreement does the temple of God have with idols? For we are the temple of the living God; just as God said, "I will dwell among them and walk among them; And I will be their God, and they shall be My people.
verses.textEn: What agreement is there between the temple of God and idols? For we are the temple of the living God. As God has said: "I will live with them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they will be my people."

verses.textZh: 所以， "主说：你们要从他们中间出来， 和他们分开， 不可触摸不洁净的东西， 我就收纳你们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以， "主说：你们要从他们中间出来， 和他们分开， 不可触摸不洁净的东西， 我就收纳你们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：你们务要从他们中间出来， 与他们分别； 不要沾不洁净的物，我就收纳你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, "Come out from them and be separate, says the Lord. Touch no unclean thing, and I will receive you."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore go out from their midst, and be separate from them, says the Lord, and touch no unclean thing; then I will welcome you,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore "Come out from among them And be separate, says the Lord. Do not touch what is unclean, And I will receive you."
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, come out from among unbelievers, and separate yourselves from them, says the Lord . Don’t touch their filthy things, and I will welcome you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore, come out from their midst and be separate," says the Lord. "And do not touch what is unclean; And I will welcome you.
verses.textEn: Therefore, "Come out from them and be separate, says the Lord. Touch no unclean thing, and I will receive you."

verses.textZh: "我要作你们的父亲， 你们要作我的儿女。 这是全能的主说的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我要作你们的父亲， 你们要作我的儿女。 这是全能的主说的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我要作你们的父； 你们要作我的儿女。 这是全能的主说的。
verses.textEnNiv: And, "I will be a Father to you, and you will be my sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty."
verses.textEnEsv: and I will be a father to you, and you shall be sons and daughters to me, says the Lord Almighty."
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will be a Father to you, And you shall be My sons and daughters, Says the Lord Almighty."
verses.textEnNlt: And I will be your Father, and you will be my sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty. "
verses.textEnNasb: "And I will be a father to you, And you shall be sons and daughters to Me," Says the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEn: And, "I will be a Father to you, and you will be my sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty."

verses.textZh: 所以，亲爱的，我们有了这些应许，就应该洁净自己，除去身体和心灵上的一切污秽，存着敬畏神的心，达到成圣的地步。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，亲爱的，我们有了这些应许，就应该洁净自己，除去身体和心灵上的一切污秽，存着敬畏神的心，达到成圣的地步。
verses.textZhCuv: 亲爱的弟兄啊，我们既有这等应许，就当洁净自己，除去身体、灵魂一切的污秽，敬畏神，得以成圣。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, since we have these promises, dear friends, let us purify ourselves from everything that contaminates body and spirit, perfecting holiness out of reverence for God.
verses.textEnEsv: Since we have these promises, beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from every defilement of body and spirit, bringing holiness to completion in the fear of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, having these promises, beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Because we have these promises, dear friends, let us cleanse ourselves from everything that can defile our body or spirit. And let us work toward complete holiness because we fear God.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, having these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
verses.textEn: Therefore, since we have these promises, dear friends, let us purify ourselves from everything that contaminates body and spirit, perfecting holiness out of reverence for God.

verses.textZh: 你们的心要容得下我们。我们没有亏负过谁，没有损害过谁，也没有占过谁的便宜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的心要容得下我们。我们没有亏负过谁，没有损害过谁，也没有占过谁的便宜。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要心地宽大收纳我们。我们未曾亏负谁，未曾败坏谁，未曾占谁的便宜。
verses.textEnNiv: Make room for us in your hearts. We have wronged no one, we have corrupted no one, we have exploited no one.
verses.textEnEsv: Make room in your hearts for us. We have wronged no one, we have corrupted no one, we have taken advantage of no one.
verses.textEnNkjv: Open yourhearts to us. We have wronged no one, we have corrupted no one, we have cheated no one.
verses.textEnNlt: Please open your hearts to us. We have not done wrong to anyone, nor led anyone astray, nor taken advantage of anyone.
verses.textEnNasb: Make room for us in your hearts; we have wronged no one, we corrupted no one, we have taken advantage of no one.
verses.textEn: Make room for us in your hearts. We have wronged no one, we have corrupted no one, we have exploited no one.

verses.textZh: 我这样说，不是要定你们的罪，因为我从前说过，你们常在我们心里，甚至可以同生共死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我这样说，不是要定你们的罪，因为我从前说过，你们常在我们心里，甚至可以同生共死。
verses.textZhCuv: 我说这话，不是要定你们的罪。我已经说过，你们常在我们心里，情愿与你们同生同死。
verses.textEnNiv: I do not say this to condemn you; I have said before that you have such a place in our hearts that we would live or die with you.
verses.textEnEsv: I do not say this to condemn you, for I said before that you are in our hearts, to die together and to live together.
verses.textEnNkjv: I do not say this to condemn; for I have said before that you are in our hearts, to die together and to live together.
verses.textEnNlt: I’m not saying this to condemn you. I said before that you are in our hearts, and we live or die together with you.
verses.textEnNasb: I do not speak to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts, to die together and to live together.
verses.textEn: I do not say this to condemn you; I have said before that you have such a place in our hearts that we would live or die with you.

verses.textZh: 我对你们大有信心，因你们而感到十分光荣；我心里满有安慰，在我们的一切患难中，格外充满喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我对你们大有信心，因你们而感到十分光荣；我心里满有安慰，在我们的一切患难中，格外充满喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 我大大地放胆，向你们说话；我因你们多多夸口，满得安慰；我们在一切患难中分外的快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: I have spoken to you with great frankness; I take great pride in you. I am greatly encouraged; in all our troubles my joy knows no bounds.
verses.textEnEsv: I am acting with great boldness toward you; I have great pride in you; I am filled with comfort. In all our affliction, I am overflowing with joy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I am exceedingly joyful in all our tribulation.
verses.textEnNlt: I have the highest confidence in you, and I take great pride in you. You have greatly encouraged me and made me happy despite all our troubles.
verses.textEnNasb: My confidence in you is great; my boasting in your behalf is great. I am filled with comfort; I am overflowing with joy in all our affliction.
verses.textEn: I have spoken to you with great frankness; I take great pride in you. I am greatly encouraged; in all our troubles my joy knows no bounds.

verses.textZh: 我们从前到了马其顿的时候，身体一点安宁也没有，反而处处遭受患难，外面有争战，里面有恐惧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们从前到了马其顿的时候，身体一点安宁也没有，反而处处遭受患难，外面有争战，里面有恐惧。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们从前就是到了马其顿的时候，身体也不得安宁，周围遭患难，外有争战，内有惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: For when we came into Macedonia, we had no rest, but we were harassed at every turn—conflicts on the outside, fears within.
verses.textEnEsv: For even when we came into Macedonia, our bodies had no rest, but we were afflicted at every turn— fighting without and fear within.
verses.textEnNkjv: For indeed, when we came to Macedonia, our bodies had no rest, but we were troubled on every side. Outside were conflicts, inside were fears.
verses.textEnNlt: When we arrived in Macedonia, there was no rest for us. We faced conflict from every direction, with battles on the outside and fear on the inside.
verses.textEnNasb: For even when we came into Macedonia our flesh had no rest, but we were afflicted on every side: conflicts on the outside, fears inside.
verses.textEn: For when we came into Macedonia, we had no rest, but we were harassed at every turn—conflicts on the outside, fears within.

verses.textZh: 但那安慰灰心的人的神，借着提多来到，安慰了我们；
verses.textZhCnvs: 但那安慰灰心的人的神，借着提多来到，安慰了我们；
verses.textZhCuv: 但那安慰丧气之人的神藉着提多来安慰了我们；
verses.textEnNiv: But God, who comforts the downcast, comforted us by the coming of Titus,
verses.textEnEsv: But God, who comforts the downcast, comforted us by the coming of Titus,
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless God, who comforts the downcast, comforted us by the coming of Titus,
verses.textEnNlt: But God, who encourages those who are discouraged, encouraged us by the arrival of Titus.
verses.textEnNasb: But God, who comforts the discouraged, comforted us by the arrival of Titus;
verses.textEn: But God, who comforts the downcast, comforted us by the coming of Titus,

verses.textZh: 不但借着他来，也借着他从你们所得的安慰，安慰了我们。他把你们的渴望、你们的哀恸和你们对我的热诚，都告诉了我们，因此我就更加欢喜了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不但借着他来，也借着他从你们所得的安慰，安慰了我们。他把你们的渴望、你们的哀恸和你们对我的热诚，都告诉了我们，因此我就更加欢喜了。
verses.textZhCuv: 不但藉着他来，也藉着他从你们所得的安慰，安慰了我们；因他把你们的想念、哀恸，和向我的热心，都告诉了我，叫我更加欢喜。
verses.textEnNiv: and not only by his coming but also by the comfort you had given him. He told us about your longing for me, your deep sorrow, your ardent concern for me, so that my joy was greater than ever.
verses.textEnEsv: and not only by his coming but also by the comfort with which he was comforted by you, as he told us of your longing, your mourning, your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced still more.
verses.textEnNkjv: and not only by his coming, but also by the consolation with which he was comforted in you, when he told us of your earnest desire, your mourning, your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced even more.
verses.textEnNlt: His presence was a joy, but so was the news he brought of the encouragement he received from you. When he told us how much you long to see me, and how sorry you are for what happened, and how loyal you are to me, I was filled with joy!
verses.textEnNasb: and not only by his arrival, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted among you, as he reported to us your longing, your mourning, your zeal for me; so that I rejoiced even more.
verses.textEn: and not only by his coming but also by the comfort you had given him. He told us about your longing for me, your deep sorrow, your ardent concern for me, so that my joy was greater than ever.

verses.textZh: 虽然我在那封信上使你们忧伤，但我现在并不后悔；其实我曾经有点后悔，因为知道那封信使你们忧伤，虽然只是暂时的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然我在那封信上使你们忧伤，但我现在并不后悔；其实我曾经有点后悔，因为知道那封信使你们忧伤，虽然只是暂时的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我先前写信叫你们忧愁，我后来虽然懊悔，如今却不懊悔；因我知道，那信叫你们忧愁不过是暂时的。
verses.textEnNiv: Even if I caused you sorrow by my letter, I do not regret it. Though I did regret it—I see that my letter hurt you, but only for a little while—
verses.textEnEsv: For even if I made you grieve with my letter, I do not regret it—though I did regret it, for I see that that letter grieved you, though only for a while.
verses.textEnNkjv: For even if I made you sorry with my letter, I do not regret it; though I did regret it. For I perceive that the same epistle made you sorry, though only for a while.
verses.textEnNlt: I am not sorry that I sent that severe letter to you, though I was sorry at first, for I know it was painful to you for a little while.
verses.textEnNasb: For though I caused you sorrow by my letter, I do not regret it; though I did regret it—for I see that that letter caused you sorrow, though only for a while—
verses.textEn: Even if I caused you sorrow by my letter, I do not regret it. Though I did regret it—I see that my letter hurt you, but only for a little while—

verses.textZh: 现在我快乐，不是因为你们忧伤，而是因为你们的忧伤带来了悔改。你们依照神的意思忧伤，凡事就不会因我们受到亏损。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我快乐，不是因为你们忧伤，而是因为你们的忧伤带来了悔改。你们依照神的意思忧伤，凡事就不会因我们受到亏损。
verses.textZhCuv: 如今我欢喜，不是因你们忧愁，是因你们从忧愁中生出懊悔来。你们依着神的意思忧愁，凡事就不至于因我们受亏损了。
verses.textEnNiv: yet now I am happy, not because you were made sorry, but because your sorrow led you to repentance. For you became sorrowful as God intended and so were not harmed in any way by us.
verses.textEnEsv: As it is, I rejoice, not because you were grieved, but because you were grieved into repenting. For you felt a godly grief, so that you suffered no loss through us.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I rejoice, not that you were made sorry, but that your sorrow led to repentance. For you were made sorry in a godly manner, that you might suffer loss from us in nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: Now I am glad I sent it, not because it hurt you, but because the pain caused you to repent and change your ways. It was the kind of sorrow God wants his people to have, so you were not harmed by us in any way.
verses.textEnNasb: I now rejoice, not that you were made sorrowful, but that you were made sorrowful to the point of repentance; for you were made sorrowful according to the will of God, so that you might not suffer loss in anything through us.
verses.textEn: yet now I am happy, not because you were made sorry, but because your sorrow led you to repentance. For you became sorrowful as God intended and so were not harmed in any way by us.

verses.textZh: 因为依照神的意思而有的忧伤，可以生出没有懊悔的悔改，以致得救；世俗的忧伤却会招致死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为依照神的意思而有的忧伤，可以生出没有懊悔的悔改，以致得救；世俗的忧伤却会招致死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为依着神的意思忧愁，就生出没有后悔的懊悔来，以致得救；但世俗的忧愁是叫人死。
verses.textEnNiv: Godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation and leaves no regret, but worldly sorrow brings death.
verses.textEnEsv: For godly grief produces a repentance that leads to salvation without regret, whereas worldly grief produces death.
verses.textEnNkjv: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, not to be regretted; but the sorrow of the world produces death.
verses.textEnNlt: For the kind of sorrow God wants us to experience leads us away from sin and results in salvation. There’s no regret for that kind of sorrow. But worldly sorrow, which lacks repentance, results in spiritual death.
verses.textEnNasb: For the sorrow that is according to the will of God produces a repentance without regret, leading to salvation, but the sorrow of the world produces death.
verses.textEn: Godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation and leaves no regret, but worldly sorrow brings death.

verses.textZh: 看哪，你们依照神的意思忧伤，在你们中间就产生了怎样的热情、申诉、愤慨、战兢、渴望、热诚、正义；你们在各方面都表明了自己在那事上是清白的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，你们依照神的意思忧伤，在你们中间就产生了怎样的热情、申诉、愤慨、战兢、渴望、热诚、正义；你们在各方面都表明了自己在那事上是清白的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你看，你们依着神的意思忧愁，从此就生出何等的殷勤、自诉、自恨、恐惧、想念、热心、责罚 。在这一切事上，你们都表明自己是洁净的。
verses.textEnNiv: See what this godly sorrow has produced in you: what earnestness, what eagerness to clear yourselves, what indignation, what alarm, what longing, what concern, what readiness to see justice done. At every point you have proved yourselves to be innocent in this matter.
verses.textEnEsv: For see what earnestness this godly grief has produced in you, but also what eagerness to clear yourselves, what indignation, what fear, what longing, what zeal, what punishment! At every point you have proved yourselves innocent in the matter.
verses.textEnNkjv: For observe this very thing, that you sorrowed in a godly manner: What diligence it produced in you, what clearing of yourselves, what indignation, what fear, what vehement desire, what zeal, what vindication! In all things you proved yourselves to be clear in this matter.
verses.textEnNlt: Just see what this godly sorrow produced in you! Such earnestness, such concern to clear yourselves, such indignation, such alarm, such longing to see me, such zeal, and such a readiness to punish wrong. You showed that you have done everything necessary to make things right.
verses.textEnNasb: For behold what earnestness this very thing, this godly sorrow, has produced in you: what vindication of yourselves, what indignation, what fear, what longing, what zeal, what punishment of wrong! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be innocent in the matter.
verses.textEn: See what this godly sorrow has produced in you: what earnestness, what eagerness to clear yourselves, what indignation, what alarm, what longing, what concern, what readiness to see justice done. At every point you have proved yourselves to be innocent in this matter.

verses.textZh: 因此，从前我虽然写过信给你们，却不是为了那亏负人的，也不是为了那受害的，而是在神面前把你们对我们的热情，向你们显现出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，从前我虽然写过信给你们，却不是为了那亏负人的，也不是为了那受害的，而是在神面前把你们对我们的热情，向你们显现出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我虽然从前写信给你们，却不是为那亏负人的，也不是为那受人亏负的，乃要在神面前把你们顾念我们的热心表明出来。
verses.textEnNiv: So even though I wrote to you, it was neither on account of the one who did the wrong nor on account of the injured party, but rather that before God you could see for yourselves how devoted to us you are.
verses.textEnEsv: So although I wrote to you, it was not for the sake of the one who did the wrong, nor for the sake of the one who suffered the wrong, but in order that your earnestness for us might be revealed to you in the sight of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, although I wrote to you, Idid not doit for the sake of him who had done the wrong, nor for the sake of him who suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear to you.
verses.textEnNlt: My purpose, then, was not to write about who did the wrong or who was wronged. I wrote to you so that in the sight of God you could see for yourselves how loyal you are to us.
verses.textEnNasb: So although I wrote to you, it was not for the sake of the offender nor for the sake of the one offended, but that your earnestness in our behalf might be made known to you in the sight of God.
verses.textEn: So even though I wrote to you, it was neither on account of the one who did the wrong nor on account of the injured party, but rather that before God you could see for yourselves how devoted to us you are.

verses.textZh: 因此，我们得了安慰。 在这安慰之外，我们因提多的喜乐就更加欢喜，因为他的心从你们众人那里得到畅快。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我们得了安慰。 在这安慰之外，我们因提多的喜乐就更加欢喜，因为他的心从你们众人那里得到畅快。
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，我们得了安慰。 并且在安慰之中，因你们众人使提多心里畅快欢喜，我们就更加欢喜了。
verses.textEnNiv: By all this we are encouraged. In addition to our own encouragement, we were especially delighted to see how happy Titus was, because his spirit has been refreshed by all of you.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore we are comforted. And besides our own comfort, we rejoiced still more at the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore we have been comforted in your comfort. And we rejoiced exceedingly more for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.
verses.textEnNlt: We have been greatly encouraged by this. In addition to our own encouragement, we were especially delighted to see how happy Titus was about the way all of you welcomed him and set his mind at ease.
verses.textEnNasb: Because of this, we have been comforted. And besides our comfort, we rejoiced even much more for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.
verses.textEn: By all this we are encouraged. In addition to our own encouragement, we were especially delighted to see how happy Titus was, because his spirit has been refreshed by all of you.

verses.textZh: 我若对他夸奖过你们甚么，也不觉得惭愧。我们对你们所说的是真话，照样，我们在提多面前夸奖你们的也是真的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我若对他夸奖过你们甚么，也不觉得惭愧。我们对你们所说的是真话，照样，我们在提多面前夸奖你们的也是真的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我若对提多夸奖了你们什么，也觉得没有惭愧；因我对提多夸奖你们的话成了真的，正如我对你们所说的话也都是真的。
verses.textEnNiv: I had boasted to him about you, and you have not embarrassed me. But just as everything we said to you was true, so our boasting about you to Titus has proved to be true as well.
verses.textEnEsv: For whatever boasts I made to him about you, I was not put to shame. But just as everything we said to you was true, so also our boasting before Titus has proved true.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if in anything I have boasted to him about you, I am not ashamed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, even so our boasting to Titus was found true.
verses.textEnNlt: I had told him how proud I was of you—and you didn’t disappoint me. I have always told you the truth, and now my boasting to Titus has also proved true!
verses.textEnNasb: For if I have boasted to him about you regarding anything, I was not put to shame. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so also our boasting before Titus proved to be the truth.
verses.textEn: I had boasted to him about you, and you have not embarrassed me. But just as everything we said to you was true, so our boasting about you to Titus has proved to be true as well.

verses.textZh: 并且他想起你们众人的服从，怎样恐惧战兢地接待他，他怀念你们的心就更加热切了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且他想起你们众人的服从，怎样恐惧战兢地接待他，他怀念你们的心就更加热切了。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且提多想起你们众人的顺服，是怎样恐惧战兢地接待他，他爱你们的心肠就越发热了。
verses.textEnNiv: And his affection for you is all the greater when he remembers that you were all obedient, receiving him with fear and trembling.
verses.textEnEsv: And his affection for you is even greater, as he remembers the obedience of you all, how you received him with fear and trembling.
verses.textEnNkjv: And his affections are greater for you as he remembers the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling you received him.
verses.textEnNlt: Now he cares for you more than ever when he remembers the way all of you obeyed him and welcomed him with such fear and deep respect.
verses.textEnNasb: His affection abounds all the more toward you, as he remembers the obedience of you all, how you received him with fear and trembling.
verses.textEn: And his affection for you is all the greater when he remembers that you were all obedient, receiving him with fear and trembling.

verses.textZh: 现在我很欢喜，因为在一切事上我对你们都有信心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我很欢喜，因为在一切事上我对你们都有信心。
verses.textZhCuv: 我如今欢喜，能在凡事上为你们放心。
verses.textEnNiv: I am glad I can have complete confidence in you.
verses.textEnEsv: I rejoice, because I have complete confidence in you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I rejoice that I have confidence in you in everything.
verses.textEnNlt: I am very happy now because I have complete confidence in you.
verses.textEnNasb: I rejoice that in everything I have confidence in you.
verses.textEn: I am glad I can have complete confidence in you.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我现在把神赐给马其顿众教会的恩典告诉你们：
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我现在把神赐给马其顿众教会的恩典告诉你们：
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我把神赐给马其顿众教会的恩告诉你们，
verses.textEnNiv: And now, brothers and sisters, we want you to know about the grace that God has given the Macedonian churches.
verses.textEnEsv: We want you to know, brothers, about the grace of God that has been given among the churches of Macedonia,
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover, brethren, we make known to you the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia:
verses.textEnNlt: Now I want you to know, dear brothers and sisters, what God in his kindness has done through the churches in Macedonia.
verses.textEnNasb: Now, brothers and sisters, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the churches of Macedonia,
verses.textEn: And now, brothers and sisters, we want you to know about the grace that God has given the Macedonian churches.

verses.textZh: 他们在患难中受到极大的考验的时候，他们满溢的喜乐和极度的贫乏，汇流出丰厚的慷慨来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在患难中受到极大的考验的时候，他们满溢的喜乐和极度的贫乏，汇流出丰厚的慷慨来。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是他们在患难中受大试炼的时候，仍有满足的快乐，在极穷之间还格外显出他们乐捐的厚恩。
verses.textEnNiv: In the midst of a very severe trial, their overflowing joy and their extreme poverty welled up in rich generosity.
verses.textEnEsv: for in a severe test of affliction, their abundance of joy and their extreme poverty have overflowed in a wealth of generosity on their part.
verses.textEnNkjv: that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded in the riches of their liberality.
verses.textEnNlt: They are being tested by many troubles, and they are very poor. But they are also filled with abundant joy, which has overflowed in rich generosity.
verses.textEnNasb: that in a great ordeal of affliction their abundance of joy and their deep poverty overflowed in the wealth of their liberality.
verses.textEn: In the midst of a very severe trial, their overflowing joy and their extreme poverty welled up in rich generosity.

verses.textZh: 我可以作证，他们是按着能力，并且是超过了能力，自愿地
verses.textZhCnvs: 我可以作证，他们是按着能力，并且是超过了能力，自愿地
verses.textZhCuv: 我可以证明，他们是按着力量，而且也过了力量，自己甘心乐意地捐助，
verses.textEnNiv: For I testify that they gave as much as they were able, and even beyond their ability. Entirely on their own,
verses.textEnEsv: For they gave according to their means, as I can testify, and beyond their means, of their own accord,
verses.textEnNkjv: For I bear witness that according to their ability, yes, and beyond their ability, theywere freely willing,
verses.textEnNlt: For I can testify that they gave not only what they could afford, but far more. And they did it of their own free will.
verses.textEnNasb: For I testify that according to their ability, and beyond their ability, they gave voluntarily,
verses.textEn: For I testify that they gave as much as they were able, and even beyond their ability. Entirely on their own,

verses.textZh: 再三恳求我们，准许他们在供应圣徒的事上有分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 再三恳求我们，准许他们在供应圣徒的事上有分。
verses.textZhCuv: 再三地求我们，准他们在这供给圣徒的恩情上有分；
verses.textEnNiv: they urgently pleaded with us for the privilege of sharing in this service to the Lord’s people.
verses.textEnEsv: begging us earnestly for the favor of taking part in the relief of the saints—
verses.textEnNkjv: imploring us with much urgency that we would receive the gift and the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.
verses.textEnNlt: They begged us again and again for the privilege of sharing in the gift for the believers in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: begging us with much urging for the favor of participation in the support of the saints,
verses.textEn: they urgently pleaded with us for the privilege of sharing in this service to the Lord’s people.

verses.textZh: 他们超过了我们所期望的，照着神的旨意，先把自己献给主，然后献给我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们超过了我们所期望的，照着神的旨意，先把自己献给主，然后献给我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且他们所做的，不但照我们所想望的，更照神的旨意先把自己献给主，又归附了我们。
verses.textEnNiv: And they exceeded our expectations: They gave themselves first of all to the Lord, and then by the will of God also to us.
verses.textEnEsv: and this, not as we expected, but they gave themselves first to the Lord and then by the will of God to us.
verses.textEnNkjv: And not only as we had hoped, but they first gave themselves to the Lord, and then to us by the will of God.
verses.textEnNlt: They even did more than we had hoped, for their first action was to give themselves to the Lord and to us, just as God wanted them to do.
verses.textEnNasb: and this, not as we had expected, but they first gave themselves to the Lord and to us by the will of God.
verses.textEn: And they exceeded our expectations: They gave themselves first of all to the Lord, and then by the will of God also to us.

verses.textZh: 因此，我们勉励提多，既然开始了这慈善的事，就应当在你们那里把这事办好。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我们勉励提多，既然开始了这慈善的事，就应当在你们那里把这事办好。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此我劝提多，既然在你们中间开办这慈惠的事，就当办成了。
verses.textEnNiv: So we urged Titus, just as he had earlier made a beginning, to bring also to completion this act of grace on your part.
verses.textEnEsv: Accordingly, we urged Titus that as he had started, so he should complete among you this act of grace.
verses.textEnNkjv: So we urged Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also complete this grace in you as well.
verses.textEnNlt: So we have urged Titus, who encouraged your giving in the first place, to return to you and encourage you to finish this ministry of giving.
verses.textEnNasb: So we urged Titus that as he had previously made a beginning, so he would also complete in you this gracious work as well.
verses.textEn: So we urged Titus, just as he had earlier made a beginning, to bring also to completion this act of grace on your part.

verses.textZh: 你们在一切事上，就如信心、口才、知识、热情和爱我们的心，既然都是富足的，那么，在这慈善的事上，也要显出你们是富足的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们在一切事上，就如信心、口才、知识、热情和爱我们的心，既然都是富足的，那么，在这慈善的事上，也要显出你们是富足的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们既然在信心、口才、知识、热心，和待我们的爱心上，都格外显出满足来，就当在这慈惠的事上也格外显出满足来。
verses.textEnNiv: But since you excel in everything—in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in complete earnestness and in the love we have kindled in you —see that you also excel in this grace of giving.
verses.textEnEsv: But as you excel in everything—in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in all earnestness, and in our love for you — see that you excel in this act of grace also.
verses.textEnNkjv: But as you abound in everything—in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in all diligence, and in your love for us—see that you abound in this grace also.
verses.textEnNlt: Since you excel in so many ways—in your faith, your gifted speakers, your knowledge, your enthusiasm, and your love from us —I want you to excel also in this gracious act of giving.
verses.textEnNasb: But just as you excel in everything, in faith, speaking, knowledge, and in all earnestness and in the love we inspired in you, see that you also excel in this gracious work.
verses.textEn: But since you excel in everything—in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in complete earnestness and in the love we have kindled in you —see that you also excel in this grace of giving.

verses.textZh: 我这样说，不是吩咐你们，而是借着别人的热心来考验你们的爱心是否真实。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我这样说，不是吩咐你们，而是借着别人的热心来考验你们的爱心是否真实。
verses.textZhCuv: 我说这话，不是吩咐你们，乃是藉着别人的热心试验你们爱心的实在。
verses.textEnNiv: I am not commanding you, but I want to test the sincerity of your love by comparing it with the earnestness of others.
verses.textEnEsv: I say this not as a command, but to prove by the earnestness of others that your love also is genuine.
verses.textEnNkjv: I speak not by commandment, but I am testing the sincerity of your love by the diligence of others.
verses.textEnNlt: I am not commanding you to do this. But I am testing how genuine your love is by comparing it with the eagerness of the other churches.
verses.textEnNasb: I am not saying this as a command, but as proving, through the earnestness of others, the sincerity of your love as well.
verses.textEn: I am not commanding you, but I want to test the sincerity of your love by comparing it with the earnestness of others.

verses.textZh: 你们是知道我们的主耶稣基督的恩典的：他本来富足，却为你们成了贫穷，要使你们因他的贫穷成为富足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们是知道我们的主耶稣基督的恩典的：他本来富足，却为你们成了贫穷，要使你们因他的贫穷成为富足。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们知道我们主耶稣基督的恩典：他本来富足，却为你们成了贫穷，叫你们因他的贫穷，可以成为富足。
verses.textEnNiv: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sake he became poor, so that you through his poverty might become rich.
verses.textEnEsv: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sake he became poor, so that you by his poverty might become rich.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though He was rich, yet for your sakes He became poor, that you through His poverty might become rich.
verses.textEnNlt: You know the generous grace of our Lord Jesus Christ. Though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, so that by his poverty he could make you rich.
verses.textEnNasb: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though He was rich, yet for your sake He became poor, so that you through His poverty might become rich.
verses.textEn: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sake he became poor, so that you through his poverty might become rich.

verses.textZh: 我在这里表示我的意见，这对你们是有益的：你们不仅一年前就在办这事，而且早就想这样作了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在这里表示我的意见，这对你们是有益的：你们不仅一年前就在办这事，而且早就想这样作了，
verses.textZhCuv: 我在这事上把我的意见告诉你们，是与你们有益；因为你们下手办这事，而且起此心意，已经有一年了，
verses.textEnNiv: And here is my judgment about what is best for you in this matter. Last year you were the first not only to give but also to have the desire to do so.
verses.textEnEsv: And in this matter I give my judgment: this benefits you, who a year ago started not only to do this work but also to desire to do it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in this I give advice: It is to your advantage not only to be doing what you began and were desiring to do a year ago;
verses.textEnNlt: Here is my advice: It would be good for you to finish what you started a year ago. Last year you were the first who wanted to give, and you were the first to begin doing it.
verses.textEnNasb: I give my opinion in this matter, for this is to your advantage, who were the first to begin a year ago not only to do this, but also to desire to do it.
verses.textEn: And here is my judgment about what is best for you in this matter. Last year you were the first not only to give but also to have the desire to do so.

verses.textZh: 现在就应当把这事办好；这样，你们既然有愿意作的心，因着你们尽了自己所能的，就可以完成。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在就应当把这事办好；这样，你们既然有愿意作的心，因着你们尽了自己所能的，就可以完成。
verses.textZhCuv: 如今就当办成这事。既有愿做的心，也当照你们所有的去办成。
verses.textEnNiv: Now finish the work, so that your eager willingness to do it may be matched by your completion of it, according to your means.
verses.textEnEsv: So now finish doing it as well, so that your readiness in desiring it may be matched by your completing it out of what you have.
verses.textEnNkjv: but now you also must complete the doing ofit; that as therewas a readiness to desire it, so there also maybe a completion out of what you have.
verses.textEnNlt: Now you should finish what you started. Let the eagerness you showed in the beginning be matched now by your giving. Give in proportion to what you have.
verses.textEnNasb: But now finish doing it also, so that just as there was the willingness to desire it, so there may be also the completion of it by your ability.
verses.textEn: Now finish the work, so that your eager willingness to do it may be matched by your completion of it, according to your means.

verses.textZh: 因为人要是有愿意作的心，按照他所有的，必蒙悦纳，不是按照他所没有的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为人要是有愿意作的心，按照他所有的，必蒙悦纳，不是按照他所没有的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为人若有愿做的心，必蒙悦纳，乃是照他所有的，并不是照他所无的。
verses.textEnNiv: For if the willingness is there, the gift is acceptable according to what one has, not according to what one does not have.
verses.textEnEsv: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what a person has, not according to what he does not have.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if there is first a willing mind, itis accepted according to what one has, and not according to what he does not have.
verses.textEnNlt: Whatever you give is acceptable if you give it eagerly. And give according to what you have, not what you don’t have.
verses.textEnNasb: For if the willingness is present, it is acceptable according to what a person has, not according to what he does not have.
verses.textEn: For if the willingness is there, the gift is acceptable according to what one has, not according to what one does not have.

verses.textZh: 这不是要别人轻省，你们受累，而是要大家都均等。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这不是要别人轻省，你们受累，而是要大家都均等。
verses.textZhCuv: 我原不是要别人轻省，你们受累，
verses.textEnNiv: Our desire is not that others might be relieved while you are hard pressed, but that there might be equality.
verses.textEnEsv: For I do not mean that others should be eased and you burdened, but that as a matter of fairness
verses.textEnNkjv: For Ido not mean that others should be eased and you burdened;
verses.textEnNlt: Of course, I don’t mean your giving should make life easy for others and hard for yourselves. I only mean that there should be some equality.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is not for the relief of others and for your hardship, but by way of equality—
verses.textEn: Our desire is not that others might be relieved while you are hard pressed, but that there might be equality.

verses.textZh: 现在你们富裕，就要补助他们的缺乏，到了他们富裕的时候，也可以补助你们的缺乏，这样就均等了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们富裕，就要补助他们的缺乏，到了他们富裕的时候，也可以补助你们的缺乏，这样就均等了；
verses.textZhCuv: 乃要均平，就是要你们的富余，现在可以补他们的不足，使他们的富余，将来也可以补你们的不足，这就均平了。
verses.textEnNiv: At the present time your plenty will supply what they need, so that in turn their plenty will supply what you need. The goal is equality,
verses.textEnEsv: your abundance at the present time should supply their need, so that their abundance may supply your need, that there may be fairness.
verses.textEnNkjv: but by an equality, that now at this time your abundance maysupply their lack, that their abundance also may supply your lack—that there may be equality.
verses.textEnNlt: Right now you have plenty and can help those who are in need. Later, they will have plenty and can share with you when you need it. In this way, things will be equal.
verses.textEnNasb: at this present time your abundance will serve as assistance for their need, so that their abundance also may serve as assistance for your need, so that there may be equality;
verses.textEn: At the present time your plenty will supply what they need, so that in turn their plenty will supply what you need. The goal is equality,

verses.textZh: 正如经上所记： "多的，没有剩余， 少的，也不缺乏。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 正如经上所记： "多的，没有剩余， 少的，也不缺乏。"
verses.textZhCuv: 如经上所记： 多收的也没有余； 少收的也没有缺。
verses.textEnNiv: as it is written: "The one who gathered much did not have too much, and the one who gathered little did not have too little."
verses.textEnEsv: As it is written, "Whoever gathered much had nothing left over, and whoever gathered little had no lack."
verses.textEnNkjv: As it is written, "He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack."
verses.textEnNlt: As the Scriptures say, "Those who gathered a lot had nothing left over, and those who gathered only a little had enough."
verses.textEnNasb: as it is written: "The one who had gathered much did not have too much, and the one who had gathered little did not have too little."
verses.textEn: as it is written: "The one who gathered much did not have too much, and the one who gathered little did not have too little."

verses.textZh: 感谢神，他把我对你们那样的热情，放在提多的心里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 感谢神，他把我对你们那样的热情，放在提多的心里。
verses.textZhCuv: 多谢神，感动提多的心，叫他待你们殷勤，像我一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Thanks be to God, who put into the heart of Titus the same concern I have for you.
verses.textEnEsv: But thanks be to God, who put into the heart of Titus the same earnest care I have for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But thanks be to God who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.
verses.textEnNlt: But thank God! He has given Titus the same enthusiasm for you that I have.
verses.textEnNasb: But thanks be to God who puts the same earnestness in your behalf in the heart of Titus.
verses.textEn: Thanks be to God, who put into the heart of Titus the same concern I have for you.

verses.textZh: 提多一方面接受了劝勉，但他自己更加热心，自愿到你们那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 提多一方面接受了劝勉，但他自己更加热心，自愿到你们那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他固然是听了我的劝，但自己更是热心，情愿往你们那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: For Titus not only welcomed our appeal, but he is coming to you with much enthusiasm and on his own initiative.
verses.textEnEsv: For he not only accepted our appeal, but being himself very earnest he is going to you of his own accord.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he not only accepted the exhortation, but being more diligent, he went to you of his own accord.
verses.textEnNlt: Titus welcomed our request that he visit you again. In fact, he himself was very eager to go and see you.
verses.textEnNasb: For he not only accepted our appeal, but being himself very earnest, he has gone to you of his own accord.
verses.textEn: For Titus not only welcomed our appeal, but he is coming to you with much enthusiasm and on his own initiative.

verses.textZh: 我们还派了一位弟兄和他同去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们还派了一位弟兄和他同去，
verses.textZhCuv: 我们还打发一位兄弟和他同去，这人在福音上得了众教会的称赞。
verses.textEnNiv: And we are sending along with him the brother who is praised by all the churches for his service to the gospel.
verses.textEnEsv: With him we are sending the brother who is famous among all the churches for his preaching of the gospel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And we have sent with him the brother whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches,
verses.textEnNlt: We are also sending another brother with Titus. All the churches praise him as a preacher of the Good News.
verses.textEnNasb: We have sent along with him the brother whose fame in the things of the gospel has spread through all the churches;
verses.textEn: And we are sending along with him the brother who is praised by all the churches for his service to the gospel.

verses.textZh: 免得有人因为我们经管的捐款太多，就毁谤我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 免得有人因为我们经管的捐款太多，就毁谤我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 不但这样，他也被众教会挑选，和我们同行，把所托与我们的这捐资送到了，可以荣耀主，又表明我们乐意的心。
verses.textEnNiv: What is more, he was chosen by the churches to accompany us as we carry the offering, which we administer in order to honor the Lord himself and to show our eagerness to help.
verses.textEnEsv: And not only that, but he has been appointed by the churches to travel with us as we carry out this act of grace that is being ministered by us, for the glory of the Lord himself and to show our good will.
verses.textEnNkjv: and not only that, but who was also chosen by the churches to travel with us with this gift, which is administered by us to the glory of the Lord Himself and toshow your ready mind,
verses.textEnNlt: He was appointed by the churches to accompany us as we take the offering to Jerusalem —a service that glorifies the Lord and shows our eagerness to help.
verses.textEnNasb: and not only that, but he has also been appointed by the churches to travel with us in this gracious work, which is being administered by us for the glory of the Lord Himself, and to show our readiness,
verses.textEn: What is more, he was chosen by the churches to accompany us as we carry the offering, which we administer in order to honor the Lord himself and to show our eagerness to help.

verses.textZh: 因为我们努力去作的，不仅是主认为是美的事，也是众人认为是美的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我们努力去作的，不仅是主认为是美的事，也是众人认为是美的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就免得有人因我们收的捐银很多，就挑我们的不是。
verses.textEnNiv: We want to avoid any criticism of the way we administer this liberal gift.
verses.textEnEsv: We take this course so that no one should blame us about this generous gift that is being administered by us,
verses.textEnNkjv: avoiding this: that anyone should blame us in this lavish gift which is administered by us—
verses.textEnNlt: We are traveling together to guard against any criticism for the way we are handling this generous gift.
verses.textEnNasb: taking precaution so that no one will discredit us in our administration of this generous gift;
verses.textEn: We want to avoid any criticism of the way we administer this liberal gift.

verses.textZh: 我们还派了另一位弟兄与他们同去；我们在许多的事上多次考验过他，知道他很热心；现在他对你们大有信心，就更加热心了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们还派了另一位弟兄与他们同去；我们在许多的事上多次考验过他，知道他很热心；现在他对你们大有信心，就更加热心了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们留心行光明的事，不但在主面前，就在人面前也是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: For we are taking pains to do what is right, not only in the eyes of the Lord but also in the eyes of man.
verses.textEnEsv: for we aim at what is honorable not only in the Lord’s sight but also in the sight of man.
verses.textEnNkjv: providing honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
verses.textEnNlt: We are careful to be honorable before the Lord, but we also want everyone else to see that we are honorable.
verses.textEnNasb: for we have regard for what is honorable, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of other people.
verses.textEn: For we are taking pains to do what is right, not only in the eyes of the Lord but also in the eyes of man.

verses.textZh: 至于提多，他是我的同伴，为你们的缘故作了我的同工；还有我们那两位弟兄，他们是众教会所派的，是基督的荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于提多，他是我的同伴，为你们的缘故作了我的同工；还有我们那两位弟兄，他们是众教会所派的，是基督的荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们又打发一位兄弟同去；这人的热心，我们在许多事上屡次试验过。现在他因为深信你们，就更加热心了。
verses.textEnNiv: In addition, we are sending with them our brother who has often proved to us in many ways that he is zealous, and now even more so because of his great confidence in you.
verses.textEnEsv: And with them we are sending our brother whom we have often tested and found earnest in many matters, but who is now more earnest than ever because of his great confidence in you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And we have sent with them our brother whom we have often proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, because of the great confidence which wehave in you.
verses.textEnNlt: We are also sending with them another of our brothers who has proven himself many times and has shown on many occasions how eager he is. He is now even more enthusiastic because of his great confidence in you.
verses.textEnNasb: We have sent with them our brother, whom we have often tested and found diligent in many things, but now even more diligent because of his great confidence in you.
verses.textEn: In addition, we are sending with them our brother who has often proved to us in many ways that he is zealous, and now even more so because of his great confidence in you.

verses.textZh: 所以，你们要在众教会面前，向他们证明你们的爱心和我们所夸耀你们的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，你们要在众教会面前，向他们证明你们的爱心和我们所夸耀你们的。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到提多，他是我的同伴，一同为你们劳碌的。论到那两位兄弟，他们是众教会的使者，是基督的荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: As for Titus, he is my partner and co-worker among you; as for our brothers, they are representatives of the churches and an honor to Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for your benefit. And as for our brothers, they are messengers of the churches, the glory of Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: If anyoneinquires about Titus, heis my partner and fellow worker concerning you. Or if our brethren areinquiredabout, they are messengers of the churches, the glory of Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: If anyone asks about Titus, say that he is my partner who works with me to help you. And the brothers with him have been sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker among you; as for our brothers, they are messengers of the churches, a glory to Christ.
verses.textEn: As for Titus, he is my partner and co-worker among you; as for our brothers, they are representatives of the churches and an honor to Christ.

verses.textZh: 所以，你们务要在众教会面前显明你们爱心的凭据，并我所夸奖你们的凭据。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，你们务要在众教会面前显明你们爱心的凭据，并我所夸奖你们的凭据。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们务要在众教会面前显明你们爱心的凭据，并我所夸奖你们的凭据。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore show these men the proof of your love and the reason for our pride in you, so that the churches can see it.
verses.textEnEsv: So give proof before the churches of your love and of our boasting about you to these men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore show to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love and of our boasting on your behalf.
verses.textEnNlt: So show them your love, and prove to all the churches that our boasting about you is justified.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, openly before the churches, show them the proof of your love and of our reason for boasting about you.
verses.textEn: Therefore show these men the proof of your love and the reason for our pride in you, so that the churches can see it.

verses.textZh: 关于供应圣徒的事，我本来没有写信给你们的必要，
verses.textZhCnvs: 关于供应圣徒的事，我本来没有写信给你们的必要，
verses.textZhCuv: 论到供给圣徒的事，我不必写信给你们；
verses.textEnNiv: There is no need for me to write to you about this service to the Lord’s people.
verses.textEnEsv: Now it is superfluous for me to write to you about the ministry for the saints,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now concerning the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you;
