verses.textEnNlt: I really don’t need to write to you about this ministry of giving for the believers in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: For it is superfluous for me to write to you about this ministry to the saints;
verses.textEn: There is no need for me to write to you about this service to the Lord’s people.

verses.textZh: 因为我知道你们有这个心愿。我对马其顿人称赞你们，说："亚该亚人去年已经预备好了。"你们的热心就激励了许多的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我知道你们有这个心愿。我对马其顿人称赞你们，说："亚该亚人去年已经预备好了。"你们的热心就激励了许多的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我知道你们乐意的心，常对马其顿人夸奖你们，说亚该亚人预备好了，已经有一年了；并且你们的热心激动了许多人。
verses.textEnNiv: For I know your eagerness to help, and I have been boasting about it to the Macedonians, telling them that since last year you in Achaia were ready to give; and your enthusiasm has stirred most of them to action.
verses.textEnEsv: for I know your readiness, of which I boast about you to the people of Macedonia, saying that Achaia has been ready since last year. And your zeal has stirred up most of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: for I know your willingness, about which I boast of you to the Macedonians, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal has stirred up the majority.
verses.textEnNlt: For I know how eager you are to help, and I have been boasting to the churches in Macedonia that you in Greece were ready to send an offering a year ago. In fact, it was your enthusiasm that stirred up many of the Macedonian believers to begin giving.
verses.textEnNasb: for I know your willingness, of which I boast about you to the Macedonians, namely, that Achaia has been prepared since last year, and your zeal has stirred up most of them.
verses.textEn: For I know your eagerness to help, and I have been boasting about it to the Macedonians, telling them that since last year you in Achaia were ready to give; and your enthusiasm has stirred most of them to action.

verses.textZh: 我派了那几位弟兄前来，为了要使我们在这事上对你们的称赞不至落空，好让你们可以照着我所说的准备妥当，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我派了那几位弟兄前来，为了要使我们在这事上对你们的称赞不至落空，好让你们可以照着我所说的准备妥当，
verses.textZhCuv: 但我打发那几位弟兄去，要叫你们照我的话预备妥当，免得我们在这事上夸奖你们的话落了空。
verses.textEnNiv: But I am sending the brothers in order that our boasting about you in this matter should not prove hollow, but that you may be ready, as I said you would be.
verses.textEnEsv: But I am sending the brothers so that our boasting about you may not prove empty in this matter, so that you may be ready, as I said you would be.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet I have sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this respect, that, as I said, you may be ready;
verses.textEnNlt: But I am sending these brothers to be sure you really are ready, as I have been telling them, and that your money is all collected. I don’t want to be wrong in my boasting about you.
verses.textEnNasb: But I have sent the brothers, in order that our boasting about you may not prove empty in this case, so that, as I was saying, you will be prepared;
verses.textEn: But I am sending the brothers in order that our boasting about you in this matter should not prove hollow, but that you may be ready, as I said you would be.

verses.textZh: 免得一旦马其顿人和我一同来到的时候，见你们还没有准备好，我们就因为这样信任你们而感到羞愧，你们就更不用说了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 免得一旦马其顿人和我一同来到的时候，见你们还没有准备好，我们就因为这样信任你们而感到羞愧，你们就更不用说了。
verses.textZhCuv: 万一有马其顿人与我同去，见你们没有预备，就叫我们所确信的，反成了羞愧；你们羞愧，更不用说了。
verses.textEnNiv: For if any Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we—not to say anything about you—would be ashamed of having been so confident.
verses.textEnEsv: Otherwise, if some Macedonians come with me and find that you are not ready, we would be humiliated—to say nothing of you—for being so confident.
verses.textEnNkjv: lest if some Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we (not to mention you!) should be ashamed of this confident boasting.
verses.textEnNlt: We would be embarrassed—not to mention your own embarrassment—if some Macedonian believers came with me and found that you weren’t ready after all I had told them!
verses.textEnNasb: otherwise, if any Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we—not to mention you—would be put to shame by this confidence.
verses.textEn: For if any Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we—not to say anything about you—would be ashamed of having been so confident.

verses.textZh: 因此，我认为必须劝那几位弟兄先到你们那里去，使你们事先筹足从前所答应的捐款。那么，你们这样的准备，就是出于乐意的，不是勉强的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我认为必须劝那几位弟兄先到你们那里去，使你们事先筹足从前所答应的捐款。那么，你们这样的准备，就是出于乐意的，不是勉强的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，我想不得不求那几位弟兄先到你们那里去，把从前所应许的捐资预备妥当，就显出你们所捐的是出于乐意，不是出于勉强。
verses.textEnNiv: So I thought it necessary to urge the brothers to visit you in advance and finish the arrangements for the generous gift you had promised. Then it will be ready as a generous gift, not as one grudgingly given.
verses.textEnEsv: So I thought it necessary to urge the brothers to go on ahead to you and arrange in advance for the gift you have promised, so that it may be ready as a willing gift, not as an exaction.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren to go to you ahead of time, and prepare your generous gift beforehand, which youhad previously promised, that it may be ready as amatterof generosity and not as a grudging obligation.
verses.textEnNlt: So I thought I should send these brothers ahead of me to make sure the gift you promised is ready. But I want it to be a willing gift, not one given grudgingly.
verses.textEnNasb: So I considered it necessary to urge the brothers that they go on ahead to you and arrange in advance your previously promised generous gift, that the same would be ready as a generous gift, and not as one grudgingly given due to greediness.
verses.textEn: So I thought it necessary to urge the brothers to visit you in advance and finish the arrangements for the generous gift you had promised. Then it will be ready as a generous gift, not as one grudgingly given.

verses.textZh: 还有，少种的少收，多种的多收。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有，少种的少收，多种的多收。
verses.textZhCuv: 「少种的少收，多种的多收」，这话是真的。
verses.textEnNiv: Remember this: Whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and whoever sows generously will also reap generously.
verses.textEnEsv: The point is this: whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and whoever sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.
verses.textEnNkjv: But this Isay: He who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and he who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember this—a farmer who plants only a few seeds will get a small crop. But the one who plants generously will get a generous crop.
verses.textEnNasb: Now I say this: the one who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and the one who sows generously will also reap generously.
verses.textEn: Remember this: Whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and whoever sows generously will also reap generously.

verses.textZh: 各人要照着心里所决定的捐输，不要为难，不必勉强，因为捐得乐意的人，是神所喜爱的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 各人要照着心里所决定的捐输，不要为难，不必勉强，因为捐得乐意的人，是神所喜爱的。
verses.textZhCuv: 各人要随本心所酌定的，不要作难，不要勉强，因为捐得乐意的人是神所喜爱的。
verses.textEnNiv: Each of you should give what you have decided in your heart to give, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
verses.textEnEsv: Each one must give as he has decided in his heart, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
verses.textEnNkjv: Solet each one give as he purposes in his heart, not grudgingly or of necessity; for God loves a cheerful giver.
verses.textEnNlt: You must each decide in your heart how much to give. And don’t give reluctantly or in response to pressure. "For God loves a person who gives cheerfully."
verses.textEnNasb: Each one must do just as he has decided in his heart, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
verses.textEn: Each of you should give what you have decided in your heart to give, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

verses.textZh: 神能把各样的恩惠多多地加给你们，使你们凡事常常充足，多作各样的善事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神能把各样的恩惠多多地加给你们，使你们凡事常常充足，多作各样的善事。
verses.textZhCuv: 神能将各样的恩惠多多地加给你们，使你们凡事常常充足，能多行各样善事。
verses.textEnNiv: And God is able to bless you abundantly, so that in all things at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.
verses.textEnEsv: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, so that having all sufficiency in all things at all times, you may abound in every good work.
verses.textEnNkjv: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you, that you, always having all sufficiency in all things, may have an abundance for every good work.
verses.textEnNlt: And God will generously provide all you need. Then you will always have everything you need and plenty left over to share with others.
verses.textEnNasb: And God is able to make all grace overflow to you, so that, always having all sufficiency in everything, you may have an abundance for every good deed;
verses.textEn: And God is able to bless you abundantly, so that in all things at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.

verses.textZh: 如经上所说： "他广施钱财，赒济穷人； 他的仁义，存到永远。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如经上所说： "他广施钱财，赒济穷人； 他的仁义，存到永远。"
verses.textZhCuv: 如经上所记： 他施舍钱财，周济贫穷； 他的仁义存到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: As it is written: "They have freely scattered their gifts to the poor; their righteousness endures forever."
verses.textEnEsv: As it is written, "He has distributed freely, he has given to the poor; his righteousness endures forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: As it is written: "He has dispersed abroad, He has given to the poor; His righteousness endures forever."
verses.textEnNlt: As the Scriptures say, "They share freely and give generously to the poor. Their good deeds will be remembered forever."
verses.textEnNasb: as it is written: "He scattered abroad, he gave to the poor, His righteousness endures forever."
verses.textEn: As it is written: "They have freely scattered their gifts to the poor; their righteousness endures forever."

verses.textZh: 但那赐种子给撒种的，又赐食物给人吃的神，必定把种子加倍地供给你们，也必增添你们的义果。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但那赐种子给撒种的，又赐食物给人吃的神，必定把种子加倍地供给你们，也必增添你们的义果。
verses.textZhCuv: 那赐种给撒种的，赐粮给人吃的，必多多加给你们种地的种子，又增添你们仁义的果子；
verses.textEnNiv: Now he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will also supply and increase your store of seed and will enlarge the harvest of your righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: He who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your seed for sowing and increase the harvest of your righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now may He who supplies seed to the sower, and bread for food, supply and multiply the seed you have sown and increase the fruits of your righteousness,
verses.textEnNlt: For God is the one who provides seed for the farmer and then bread to eat. In the same way, he will provide and increase your resources and then produce a great harvest of generosity in you.
verses.textEnNasb: Now He who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your seed for sowing and increase the harvest of your righteousness;
verses.textEn: Now he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will also supply and increase your store of seed and will enlarge the harvest of your righteousness.

verses.textZh: 你们既然凡事富裕，就可以慷慨地捐输，使众人借着我们，对神生出感谢的心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们既然凡事富裕，就可以慷慨地捐输，使众人借着我们，对神生出感谢的心。
verses.textZhCuv: 叫你们凡事富足，可以多多施舍，就藉着我们使感谢归于神。
verses.textEnNiv: You will be enriched in every way so that you can be generous on every occasion, and through us your generosity will result in thanksgiving to God.
verses.textEnEsv: You will be enriched in every way to be generous in every way, which through us will produce thanksgiving to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: while youare enriched in everything for all liberality, which causes thanksgiving through us to God.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, you will be enriched in every way so that you can always be generous. And when we take your gifts to those who need them, they will thank God.
verses.textEnNasb: you will be enriched in everything for all liberality, which through us is producing thanksgiving to God.
verses.textEn: You will be enriched in every way so that you can be generous on every occasion, and through us your generosity will result in thanksgiving to God.

verses.textZh: 因为这供应的事，不仅补足了圣徒的缺乏，也使许多人对神感谢的心格外增多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为这供应的事，不仅补足了圣徒的缺乏，也使许多人对神感谢的心格外增多。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为办这供给的事，不但补圣徒的缺乏，而且叫许多人越发感谢神。
verses.textEnNiv: This service that you perform is not only supplying the needs of the Lord’s people but is also overflowing in many expressions of thanks to God.
verses.textEnEsv: For the ministry of this service is not only supplying the needs of the saints but is also overflowing in many thanksgivings to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the administration of this service not only supplies the needs of the saints, but also is abounding through many thanksgivings to God,
verses.textEnNlt: So two good things will result from this ministry of giving—the needs of the believers in Jerusalem will be met, and they will joyfully express their thanks to God.
verses.textEnNasb: For the ministry of this service is not only fully supplying the needs of the saints, but is also overflowing through many thanksgivings to God.
verses.textEn: This service that you perform is not only supplying the needs of the Lord’s people but is also overflowing in many expressions of thanks to God.

verses.textZh: 众圣徒因为你们承认和服从了基督的福音，并且慷慨地捐输给他们和众人，借着你们在这供应的事上所得的凭据，就把荣耀归给神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众圣徒因为你们承认和服从了基督的福音，并且慷慨地捐输给他们和众人，借着你们在这供应的事上所得的凭据，就把荣耀归给神。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们从这供给的事上得了凭据，知道你们承认基督顺服他的福音，多多地捐钱给他们和众人，便将荣耀归与神。
verses.textEnNiv: Because of the service by which you have proved yourselves, others will praise God for the obedience that accompanies your confession of the gospel of Christ, and for your generosity in sharing with them and with everyone else.
verses.textEnEsv: By their approval of this service, they will glorify God because of your submission that comes from your confession of the gospel of Christ, and the generosity of your contribution for them and for all others,
verses.textEnNkjv: while, through the proof of this ministry, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal sharing with them and all men,
verses.textEnNlt: As a result of your ministry, they will give glory to God. For your generosity to them and to all believers will prove that you are obedient to the Good News of Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: Because of the proof given by this ministry, they will glorify God for your obedience to your confession of the gospel of Christ and for the liberality of your contribution to them and to all,
verses.textEn: Because of the service by which you have proved yourselves, others will praise God for the obedience that accompanies your confession of the gospel of Christ, and for your generosity in sharing with them and with everyone else.

verses.textZh: 因着神在你们身上的厚恩，他们就为你们祷告，切切地想念你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着神在你们身上的厚恩，他们就为你们祷告，切切地想念你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们也因神极大的恩赐显在你们心里，就切切地想念你们，为你们祈祷。
verses.textEnNiv: And in their prayers for you their hearts will go out to you, because of the surpassing grace God has given you.
verses.textEnEsv: while they long for you and pray for you, because of the surpassing grace of God upon you.
verses.textEnNkjv: and by their prayer for you, who long for you because of the exceeding grace of God in you.
verses.textEnNlt: And they will pray for you with deep affection because of the overflowing grace God has given to you.
verses.textEnNasb: while they also, by prayer on your behalf, yearn for you because of the surpassing grace of God in you.
verses.textEn: And in their prayers for you their hearts will go out to you, because of the surpassing grace God has given you.

verses.textZh: 感谢神，他的恩赐难以形容。
verses.textZhCnvs: 感谢神，他的恩赐难以形容。
verses.textZhCuv: 感谢神，因他有说不尽的恩赐！
verses.textEnNiv: Thanks be to God for his indescribable gift!
verses.textEnEsv: Thanks be to God for his inexpressible gift!
verses.textEnNkjv: Thanks be to God for His indescribable gift!
verses.textEnNlt: Thank God for this gift too wonderful for words!
verses.textEnNasb: Thanks be to God for His indescribable gift!
verses.textEn: Thanks be to God for his indescribable gift!

verses.textZh: 我保罗与你们见面的时候是谦卑的，不在你们那里的时候，却是放胆的。现在我亲自以基督的谦逊温柔劝你们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我保罗与你们见面的时候是谦卑的，不在你们那里的时候，却是放胆的。现在我亲自以基督的谦逊温柔劝你们，
verses.textZhCuv: 我－保罗，就是与你们见面的时候是谦卑的，不在你们那里的时候向你们是勇敢的，如今亲自藉着基督的温柔、和平劝你们。
verses.textEnNiv: By the humility and gentleness of Christ, I appeal to you—I, Paul, who am "timid" when face to face with you, but "bold" toward you when away!
verses.textEnEsv: I, Paul, myself entreat you, by the meekness and gentleness of Christ—I who am humble when face to face with you, but bold toward you when I am away!—
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I, Paul, myself am pleading with you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ— who in presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.
verses.textEnNlt: Now I, Paul, appeal to you with the gentleness and kindness of Christ—though I realize you think I am timid in person and bold only when I write from far away.
verses.textEnNasb: Now I, Paul, myself urge you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ—I who am meek when face to face with you, but bold toward you when absent!
verses.textEn: By the humility and gentleness of Christ, I appeal to you—I, Paul, who am "timid" when face to face with you, but "bold" toward you when away!

verses.textZh: 求你们使我在你们那里的时候，不要满有自信地放胆对你们，我认为要以这样的自信，勇敢地对付那些以为我们是照着世俗的标准 行事的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你们使我在你们那里的时候，不要满有自信地放胆对你们，我认为要以这样的自信，勇敢地对付那些以为我们是照着世俗的标准 行事的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人以为我是凭着血气行事，我也以为必须用勇敢待这等人；求你们不要叫我在你们那里的时候，有这样的勇敢。
verses.textEnNiv: I beg you that when I come I may not have to be as bold as I expect to be toward some people who think that we live by the standards of this world.
verses.textEnEsv: I beg of you that when I am present I may not have to show boldness with such confidence as I count on showing against some who suspect us of walking according to the flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I beg you that when I am present I may not be bold with that confidence by which I intend to be bold against some, who think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: Well, I am begging you now so that when I come I won’t have to be bold with those who think we act from human motives.
verses.textEnNasb: I ask that when I am present I need not be bold with the confidence with which I intend to be courageous against some, who regard us as if we walked according to the flesh.
verses.textEn: I beg you that when I come I may not have to be as bold as I expect to be toward some people who think that we live by the standards of this world.

verses.textZh: 我们虽然在世上行事，却不是按照世俗的方式作战，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们虽然在世上行事，却不是按照世俗的方式作战，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我们虽然在血气中行事，却不凭着血气争战。
verses.textEnNiv: For though we live in the world, we do not wage war as the world does.
verses.textEnEsv: For though we walk in the flesh, we are not waging war according to the flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war according to the flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: We are human, but we don’t wage war as humans do.
verses.textEnNasb: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not wage battle according to the flesh,
verses.textEn: For though we live in the world, we do not wage war as the world does.

verses.textZh: 因为我们作战所用的兵器，不是属于这世界的，而是在神面前有能力的，可以攻陷坚固的堡垒，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我们作战所用的兵器，不是属于这世界的，而是在神面前有能力的，可以攻陷坚固的堡垒，
verses.textZhCuv: 我们争战的兵器本不是属血气的，乃是在神面前有能力，可以攻破坚固的营垒，
verses.textEnNiv: The weapons we fight with are not the weapons of the world. On the contrary, they have divine power to demolish strongholds.
verses.textEnEsv: For the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh but have divine power to destroy strongholds.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal but mighty in God for pulling down strongholds,
verses.textEnNlt: We use God’s mighty weapons, not worldly weapons, to knock down the strongholds of human reasoning and to destroy false arguments.
verses.textEnNasb: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but divinely powerful for the destruction of fortresses.
verses.textEn: The weapons we fight with are not the weapons of the world. On the contrary, they have divine power to demolish strongholds.

verses.textZh: 攻破诡辩，和做来阻挡人认识神的一切高墙，并且把一切心意夺回来，顺服基督。
verses.textZhCnvs: 攻破诡辩，和做来阻挡人认识神的一切高墙，并且把一切心意夺回来，顺服基督。
verses.textZhCuv: 将各样的计谋，各样拦阻人认识神的那些自高之事，一概攻破了，又将人所有的心意夺回，使他都顺服基督。
verses.textEnNiv: We demolish arguments and every pretension that sets itself up against the knowledge of God, and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: We destroy arguments and every lofty opinion raised against the knowledge of God, and take every thought captive to obey Christ,
verses.textEnNkjv: casting down arguments and every high thing that exalts itself against the knowledge of God, bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,
verses.textEnNlt: We destroy every proud obstacle that keeps people from knowing God. We capture their rebellious thoughts and teach them to obey Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: We are destroying arguments and all arrogance raised against the knowledge of God, and we are taking every thought captive to the obedience of Christ,
verses.textEn: We demolish arguments and every pretension that sets itself up against the knowledge of God, and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.

verses.textZh: 我们已经准备好了，等你们完全顺服的时候，就惩罚所有不顺从的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们已经准备好了，等你们完全顺服的时候，就惩罚所有不顺从的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且我已经预备好了，等你们十分顺服的时候，要责罚那一切不顺服的人。
verses.textEnNiv: And we will be ready to punish every act of disobedience, once your obedience is complete.
verses.textEnEsv: being ready to punish every disobedience, when your obedience is complete.
verses.textEnNkjv: and being ready to punish all disobedience when your obedience is fulfilled.
verses.textEnNlt: And after you have become fully obedient, we will punish everyone who remains disobedient.
verses.textEnNasb: and we are ready to punish all disobedience, whenever your obedience is complete.
verses.textEn: And we will be ready to punish every act of disobedience, once your obedience is complete.

verses.textZh: 你们看事情，只看表面。如果有人自信是属于基督的，他就应该再想一想：他是属于基督的，同样，我们也是属于基督的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们看事情，只看表面。如果有人自信是属于基督的，他就应该再想一想：他是属于基督的，同样，我们也是属于基督的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们是看眼前的吗？倘若有人自信是属基督的，他要再想想，他如何属基督，我们也是如何属基督的。
verses.textEnNiv: You are judging by appearances. If anyone is confident that they belong to Christ, they should consider again that we belong to Christ just as much as they do.
verses.textEnEsv: Look at what is before your eyes. If anyone is confident that he is Christ’s, let him remind himself that just as he is Christ’s, so also are we.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you look at things according to the outward appearance? If anyone is convinced in himself that he is Christ’s, let him again consider this in himself, that just as he is Christ’s, even so we are Christ’s.
verses.textEnNlt: Look at the obvious facts. Those who say they belong to Christ must recognize that we belong to Christ as much as they do.
verses.textEnNasb: You are looking at things as they are outwardly. If anyone is confident in himself that he is Christ’s, have him consider this again within himself, that just as he is Christ’s, so too are we.
verses.textEn: You are judging by appearances. If anyone is confident that they belong to Christ, they should consider again that we belong to Christ just as much as they do.

verses.textZh: 主把权柄赐给我们，是为了要造就你们，不是要破坏你们，就算我为这权柄夸口过分了一点，也不会觉得惭愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主把权柄赐给我们，是为了要造就你们，不是要破坏你们，就算我为这权柄夸口过分了一点，也不会觉得惭愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 主赐给我们权柄，是要造就你们，并不是要败坏你们；我就是为这权柄稍微夸口，也不至于惭愧。
verses.textEnNiv: So even if I boast somewhat freely about the authority the Lord gave us for building you up rather than tearing you down, I will not be ashamed of it.
verses.textEnEsv: For even if I boast a little too much of our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for destroying you, I will not be ashamed.
verses.textEnNkjv: For even if I should boast somewhat more about our authority, which the Lord gave us for edification and not for your destruction, I shall not be ashamed—
verses.textEnNlt: I may seem to be boasting too much about the authority given to us by the Lord. But our authority builds you up; it doesn’t tear you down. So I will not be ashamed of using my authority.
verses.textEnNasb: For if I boast somewhat more about our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for destroying you, I will not be put to shame,
verses.textEn: So even if I boast somewhat freely about the authority the Lord gave us for building you up rather than tearing you down, I will not be ashamed of it.

verses.textZh: 不要以为我写信是用来吓你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要以为我写信是用来吓你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我说这话，免得你们以为我写信是要威吓你们；
verses.textEnNiv: I do not want to seem to be trying to frighten you with my letters.
verses.textEnEsv: I do not want to appear to be frightening you with my letters.
verses.textEnNkjv: lest I seem to terrify you by letters.
verses.textEnNlt: I’m not trying to frighten you by my letters.
verses.textEnNasb: for I do not want to seem as if I would terrify you by my letters.
verses.textEn: I do not want to seem to be trying to frighten you with my letters.

verses.textZh: 因为有人说："他的信又严厉又强硬，他本人却其貌不扬，言语粗俗。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为有人说："他的信又严厉又强硬，他本人却其貌不扬，言语粗俗。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为有人说：「他的信又沉重又厉害，及至见面，却是气貌不扬，言语粗俗的。」
verses.textEnNiv: For some say, "His letters are weighty and forceful, but in person he is unimpressive and his speaking amounts to nothing."
verses.textEnEsv: For they say, "His letters are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech of no account."
verses.textEnNkjv: "For his letters," they say, "are weighty and powerful, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible."
verses.textEnNlt: For some say, "Paul’s letters are demanding and forceful, but in person he is weak, and his speeches are worthless!"
verses.textEnNasb: For they say, "His letters are weighty and strong, but his personal presence is unimpressive and his speech contemptible."
verses.textEn: For some say, "His letters are weighty and forceful, but in person he is unimpressive and his speaking amounts to nothing."

verses.textZh: 说这话的人要想一想，我们不在你们那里的时候，信上怎样写，我们来到的时候也会怎样作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说这话的人要想一想，我们不在你们那里的时候，信上怎样写，我们来到的时候也会怎样作。
verses.textZhCuv: 这等人当想，我们不在那里的时候，信上的言语如何，见面的时候，行事也必如何。
verses.textEnNiv: Such people should realize that what we are in our letters when we are absent, we will be in our actions when we are present.
verses.textEnEsv: Let such a person understand that what we say by letter when absent, we do when present.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such wewill also be in deed when we are present.
verses.textEnNlt: Those people should realize that our actions when we arrive in person will be as forceful as what we say in our letters from far away.
verses.textEnNasb: Have such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when absent, such persons we are also in deed when present.
verses.textEn: Such people should realize that what we are in our letters when we are absent, we will be in our actions when we are present.

verses.textZh: 我们不敢和那些自我推荐的人相提并论；他们拿自己来量自己，拿自己来比自己，实在不大聪明。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们不敢和那些自我推荐的人相提并论；他们拿自己来量自己，拿自己来比自己，实在不大聪明。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我们不敢将自己和那自荐的人同列相比。他们用自己度量自己，用自己比较自己，乃是不通达的。
verses.textEnNiv: We do not dare to classify or compare ourselves with some who commend themselves. When they measure themselves by themselves and compare themselves with themselves, they are not wise.
verses.textEnEsv: Not that we dare to classify or compare ourselves with some of those who are commending themselves. But when they measure themselves by one another and compare themselves with one another, they are without understanding.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we dare not class ourselves or compare ourselves with those who commend themselves. But they, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, don’t worry; we wouldn’t dare say that we are as wonderful as these other men who tell you how important they are! But they are only comparing themselves with each other, using themselves as the standard of measurement. How ignorant!
verses.textEnNasb: For we do not presume to rank or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves; but when they measure themselves by themselves and compare themselves with themselves, they have no understanding.
verses.textEn: We do not dare to classify or compare ourselves with some who commend themselves. When they measure themselves by themselves and compare themselves with themselves, they are not wise.

verses.textZh: 我们所夸的，并没有越过范围，而是在神量给我们的界限之内；这界限一直延伸到你们那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们所夸的，并没有越过范围，而是在神量给我们的界限之内；这界限一直延伸到你们那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们不愿意分外夸口，只要照神所量给我们的界限搆到你们那里。
verses.textEnNiv: We, however, will not boast beyond proper limits, but will confine our boasting to the sphere of service God himself has assigned to us, a sphere that also includes you.
verses.textEnEsv: But we will not boast beyond limits, but will boast only with regard to the area of influence God assigned to us, to reach even to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: We, however, will not boast beyond measure, but within the limits of the sphere which God appointed us—a sphere which especially includes you.
verses.textEnNlt: We will not boast about things done outside our area of authority. We will boast only about what has happened within the boundaries of the work God has given us, which includes our working with you.
verses.textEnNasb: But we will not boast beyond our measure, but within the measure of the domain which God assigned to us as a measure, to reach even as far as you.
verses.textEn: We, however, will not boast beyond proper limits, but will confine our boasting to the sphere of service God himself has assigned to us, a sphere that also includes you.

verses.textZh: 如果我们没有到过你们那里，现在就自夸得过分了；但事实上，我们早就把基督的福音传到你们那里了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我们没有到过你们那里，现在就自夸得过分了；但事实上，我们早就把基督的福音传到你们那里了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们并非过了自己的界限，好像搆不到你们那里；因为我们早到你们那里，传了基督的福音。
verses.textEnNiv: We are not going too far in our boasting, as would be the case if we had not come to you, for we did get as far as you with the gospel of Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: For we are not overextending ourselves, as though we did not reach you. For we were the first to come all the way to you with the gospel of Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we are not overextending ourselves (as though ourauthority did not extend to you), for it was to you that we came with the gospel of Christ;
verses.textEnNlt: We are not reaching beyond these boundaries when we claim authority over you, as if we had never visited you. For we were the first to travel all the way to Corinth with the Good News of Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: For we are not overextending ourselves, as if we did not reach to you, for we were the first to come even as far as you in the gospel of Christ;
verses.textEn: We are not going too far in our boasting, as would be the case if we had not come to you, for we did get as far as you with the gospel of Christ.

verses.textZh: 我们并没有越过范围，拿别人的劳苦来夸口。我们盼望随着你们信心的增长，我们的界限就因你们而大大扩展，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们并没有越过范围，拿别人的劳苦来夸口。我们盼望随着你们信心的增长，我们的界限就因你们而大大扩展，
verses.textZhCuv: 我们不仗着别人所劳碌的，分外夸口；但指望你们信心增长的时候，所量给我们的界限，就可以因着你们更加开展，
verses.textEnNiv: Neither do we go beyond our limits by boasting of work done by others. Our hope is that, as your faith continues to grow, our sphere of activity among you will greatly expand,
verses.textEnEsv: We do not boast beyond limit in the labors of others. But our hope is that as your faith increases, our area of influence among you may be greatly enlarged,
verses.textEnNkjv: not boasting of things beyond measure, thatis, in other men’s labors, but having hope, that as your faith is increased, we shall be greatly enlarged by you in our sphere,
verses.textEnNlt: Nor do we boast and claim credit for the work someone else has done. Instead, we hope that your faith will grow so that the boundaries of our work among you will be extended.
verses.textEnNasb: not boasting beyond our measure, that is, in other people’s labors, but with the hope that as your faith grows, we will be, within our domain, enlarged even more by you,
verses.textEn: Neither do we go beyond our limits by boasting of work done by others. Our hope is that, as your faith continues to grow, our sphere of activity among you will greatly expand,

verses.textZh: 使我们可以把福音传到你们以外的地方。别人在他的界限以内所完成的工作，我们不会拿来夸口的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使我们可以把福音传到你们以外的地方。别人在他的界限以内所完成的工作，我们不会拿来夸口的。
verses.textZhCuv: 得以将福音传到你们以外的地方；并不是在别人界限之内，藉着他现成的事夸口。
verses.textEnNiv: so that we can preach the gospel in the regions beyond you. For we do not want to boast about work already done in someone else’s territory.
verses.textEnEsv: so that we may preach the gospel in lands beyond you, without boasting of work already done in another’s area of influence.
verses.textEnNkjv: to preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man’s sphere of accomplishment.
verses.textEnNlt: Then we will be able to go and preach the Good News in other places far beyond you, where no one else is working. Then there will be no question of our boasting about work done in someone else’s territory.
verses.textEnNasb: so as to preach the gospel even to the regions beyond you, and not to boast in what has been accomplished in the domain of another.
verses.textEn: so that we can preach the gospel in the regions beyond you. For we do not want to boast about work already done in someone else’s territory.

verses.textZh: 夸口的应当靠着主夸口，
verses.textZhCnvs: 夸口的应当靠着主夸口，
verses.textZhCuv: 但夸口的，当指着主夸口。
verses.textEnNiv: But, "Let the one who boasts boast in the Lord."
verses.textEnEsv: "Let the one who boasts, boast in the Lord."
verses.textEnNkjv: But "he who glories, let him glory in the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: As the Scriptures say, "If you want to boast, boast only about the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: But the one who boasts is to boast in the Lord.
verses.textEn: But, "Let the one who boasts boast in the Lord."

verses.textZh: 因为蒙悦纳的，不是自我推荐的人，而是主所推荐的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为蒙悦纳的，不是自我推荐的人，而是主所推荐的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为蒙悦纳的，不是自己称许的，乃是主所称许的。
verses.textEnNiv: For it is not the one who commends himself who is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.
verses.textEnEsv: For it is not the one who commends himself who is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.
verses.textEnNkjv: For not he who commends himself is approved, but whom the Lord commends.
verses.textEnNlt: When people commend themselves, it doesn’t count for much. The important thing is for the Lord to commend them.
verses.textEnNasb: For it is not the one who commends himself that is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.
verses.textEn: For it is not the one who commends himself who is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.

verses.textZh: 请你们容忍我这一点点的愚昧，其实你们本来就是容忍我的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 请你们容忍我这一点点的愚昧，其实你们本来就是容忍我的。
verses.textZhCuv: 但愿你们宽容我这一点愚妄，其实你们原是宽容我的。
verses.textEnNiv: I hope you will put up with me in a little foolishness. Yes, please put up with me!
verses.textEnEsv: I wish you would bear with me in a little foolishness. Do bear with me!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, that you would bear with me in a little folly—and indeed you do bear with me.
verses.textEnNlt: I hope you will put up with a little more of my foolishness. Please bear with me.
verses.textEnNasb: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness; but indeed you are bearing with me.
verses.textEn: I hope you will put up with me in a little foolishness. Yes, please put up with me!

verses.textZh: 我以神的热爱爱你们，因为我把你们献给基督，好象把贞洁的童女许配给一个丈夫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我以神的热爱爱你们，因为我把你们献给基督，好象把贞洁的童女许配给一个丈夫。
verses.textZhCuv: 我为你们起的愤恨，原是神那样的愤恨。因为我曾把你们许配一个丈夫，要把你们如同贞洁的童女，献给基督。
verses.textEnNiv: I am jealous for you with a godly jealousy. I promised you to one husband, to Christ, so that I might present you as a pure virgin to him.
verses.textEnEsv: For I feel a divine jealousy for you, since I betrothed you to one husband, to present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I am jealous for you with godly jealousy. For I have betrothed you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: For I am jealous for you with the jealousy of God himself. I promised you as a pure bride to one husband—Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: For I am jealous for you with a godly jealousy; for I betrothed you to one husband, to present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
verses.textEn: I am jealous for you with a godly jealousy. I promised you to one husband, to Christ, so that I might present you as a pure virgin to him.

verses.textZh: 我只怕你们的心受到引诱，失去对基督的单纯和贞洁，好象蛇用诡计骗了夏娃一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我只怕你们的心受到引诱，失去对基督的单纯和贞洁，好象蛇用诡计骗了夏娃一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我只怕你们的心或偏于邪，失去那向基督所存纯一清洁的心，就像蛇用诡诈诱惑了夏娃一样。
verses.textEnNiv: But I am afraid that just as Eve was deceived by the serpent’s cunning, your minds may somehow be led astray from your sincere and pure devotion to Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: But I am afraid that as the serpent deceived Eve by his cunning, your thoughts will be led astray from a sincere and pure devotion to Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I fear, lest somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve by his craftiness, so your minds may be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: But I fear that somehow your pure and undivided devotion to Christ will be corrupted, just as Eve was deceived by the cunning ways of the serpent.
verses.textEnNasb: But I am afraid that, as the serpent deceived Eve by his trickery, your minds will be led astray from sincere and pure devotion to Christ.
verses.textEn: But I am afraid that just as Eve was deceived by the serpent’s cunning, your minds may somehow be led astray from your sincere and pure devotion to Christ.

verses.textZh: 如果有人来传讲另一位耶稣，不是我们传过的，或者你们接受另一个不同的灵，不是你们领受过的，又或者接受另一个不同的福音，不是你们接受过的，你们倒可以容忍得下！
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人来传讲另一位耶稣，不是我们传过的，或者你们接受另一个不同的灵，不是你们领受过的，又或者接受另一个不同的福音，不是你们接受过的，你们倒可以容忍得下！
verses.textZhCuv: 假如有人来另传一个耶稣，不是我们所传过的；或者你们另受一个灵，不是你们所受过的；或者另得一个福音，不是你们所得过的；你们容让他也就罢了。
verses.textEnNiv: For if someone comes to you and preaches a Jesus other than the Jesus we preached, or if you receive a different spirit from the Spirit you received, or a different gospel from the one you accepted, you put up with it easily enough.
verses.textEnEsv: For if someone comes and proclaims another Jesus than the one we proclaimed, or if you receive a different spirit from the one you received, or if you accept a different gospel from the one you accepted, you put up with it readily enough.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we have not preached, or if you receive a different spirit which you have not received, or a different gospel which you have not accepted—you may well put up with it!
verses.textEnNlt: You happily put up with whatever anyone tells you, even if they preach a different Jesus than the one we preach, or a different kind of Spirit than the one you received, or a different kind of gospel than the one you believed.
verses.textEnNasb: For if one comes and preaches another Jesus whom we have not preached, or you receive a different spirit which you have not received, or a different gospel which you have not accepted, this you tolerate very well!
verses.textEn: For if someone comes to you and preaches a Jesus other than the Jesus we preached, or if you receive a different spirit from the Spirit you received, or a different gospel from the one you accepted, you put up with it easily enough.

verses.textZh: 但我认为自己没有一点比不上那些"超等使徒"；
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我认为自己没有一点比不上那些"超等使徒"；
verses.textZhCuv: 但我想，我一点不在那些最大的使徒以下。
verses.textEnNiv: I do not think I am in the least inferior to those "super-apostles."
verses.textEnEsv: Indeed, I consider that I am not in the least inferior to these super-apostles.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I consider that I am not at all inferior to the most eminent apostles.
verses.textEnNlt: But I don’t consider myself inferior in any way to these "super apostles" who teach such things.
verses.textEnNasb: For I consider myself not in the least inferior to the most eminent apostles.
verses.textEn: I do not think I am in the least inferior to those "super-apostles."

verses.textZh: 虽然我不善于辞令，却是有学问的，我们在各方面，已经向你们清楚显明了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然我不善于辞令，却是有学问的，我们在各方面，已经向你们清楚显明了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的言语虽然粗俗，我的知识却不粗俗。这是我们在凡事上向你们众人显明出来的。
verses.textEnNiv: I may indeed be untrained as a speaker, but I do have knowledge. We have made this perfectly clear to you in every way.
verses.textEnEsv: Even if I am unskilled in speaking, I am not so in knowledge; indeed, in every way we have made this plain to you in all things.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even though Iam untrained in speech, yet Iam not in knowledge. But we have been thoroughly manifested among you in all things.
verses.textEnNlt: I may be unskilled as a speaker, but I’m not lacking in knowledge. We have made this clear to you in every possible way.
verses.textEnNasb: But even if I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not so in knowledge; in fact, in every way we have made this evident to you in all things.
verses.textEn: I may indeed be untrained as a speaker, but I do have knowledge. We have made this perfectly clear to you in every way.

verses.textZh: 我贬低自己，使你们高升，把神的福音白白地传给你们，我这样是犯罪吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我贬低自己，使你们高升，把神的福音白白地传给你们，我这样是犯罪吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我因为白白传神的福音给你们，就自居卑微，叫你们高升，这算是我犯罪吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Was it a sin for me to lower myself in order to elevate you by preaching the gospel of God to you free of charge?
verses.textEnEsv: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself so that you might be exalted, because I preached God’s gospel to you free of charge?
verses.textEnNkjv: Did I commit sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached the gospel of God to you free of charge?
verses.textEnNlt: Was I wrong when I humbled myself and honored you by preaching God’s Good News to you without expecting anything in return?
verses.textEnNasb: Or did I commit a sin by humbling myself so that you might be exalted, because I preached the gospel of God to you without charge?
verses.textEn: Was it a sin for me to lower myself in order to elevate you by preaching the gospel of God to you free of charge?

verses.textZh: 我为了服事你们，就接受了别的教会的供应，也可以说是剥削了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我为了服事你们，就接受了别的教会的供应，也可以说是剥削了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我亏负了别的教会，向他们取了工价来给你们效力。
verses.textEnNiv: I robbed other churches by receiving support from them so as to serve you.
verses.textEnEsv: I robbed other churches by accepting support from them in order to serve you.
verses.textEnNkjv: I robbed other churches, taking wages fromthem to minister to you.
verses.textEnNlt: I "robbed" other churches by accepting their contributions so I could serve you at no cost.
verses.textEnNasb: I robbed other churches by taking wages from them to serve you;
verses.textEn: I robbed other churches by receiving support from them so as to serve you.

verses.textZh: 我在你们那里有缺乏的时候，并没有连累任何人，因为从马其顿来的弟兄们，补足了我的缺乏。我在各方面都不让自己成为你们的重担，将来也是一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在你们那里有缺乏的时候，并没有连累任何人，因为从马其顿来的弟兄们，补足了我的缺乏。我在各方面都不让自己成为你们的重担，将来也是一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在你们那里缺乏的时候，并没有累着你们一个人；因我所缺乏的，那从马其顿来的弟兄们都补足了。我向来凡事谨守，后来也必谨守，总不至于累着你们。
verses.textEnNiv: And when I was with you and needed something, I was not a burden to anyone, for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied what I needed. I have kept myself from being a burden to you in any way, and will continue to do so.
verses.textEnEsv: And when I was with you and was in need, I did not burden anyone, for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied my need. So I refrained and will refrain from burdening you in any way.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when I was present with you, and in need, I was a burden to no one, for what I lacked the brethren who came from Macedonia supplied. And in everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and so I will keep myself.
verses.textEnNlt: And when I was with you and didn’t have enough to live on, I did not become a financial burden to anyone. For the brothers who came from Macedonia brought me all that I needed. I have never been a burden to you, and I never will be.
verses.textEnNasb: and when I was present with you and was in need, I was not a burden to anyone; for when the brothers came from Macedonia they fully supplied my need, and in everything I kept myself from being a burden to you, and will continue to do so.
verses.textEn: And when I was with you and needed something, I was not a burden to anyone, for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied what I needed. I have kept myself from being a burden to you in any way, and will continue to do so.

verses.textZh: 我有基督的真理在我里面，在亚该亚一带没有人能阻止我这样夸口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我有基督的真理在我里面，在亚该亚一带没有人能阻止我这样夸口。
verses.textZhCuv: 既有基督的诚实在我里面，就无人能在亚该亚一带地方阻挡我这自夸。
verses.textEnNiv: As surely as the truth of Christ is in me, nobody in the regions of Achaia will stop this boasting of mine.
verses.textEnEsv: As the truth of Christ is in me, this boasting of mine will not be silenced in the regions of Achaia.
verses.textEnNkjv: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one shall stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
verses.textEnNlt: As surely as the truth of Christ is in me, no one in all of Greece will ever stop me from boasting about this.
verses.textEnNasb: As the truth of Christ is in me, this boasting of mine will not be stopped in the regions of Achaia.
verses.textEn: As surely as the truth of Christ is in me, nobody in the regions of Achaia will stop this boasting of mine.

verses.textZh: 为甚么呢？是我不爱你们吗？神是知道的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为甚么呢？是我不爱你们吗？神是知道的。
verses.textZhCuv: 为什么呢？是因我不爱你们吗？这有神知道。
verses.textEnNiv: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows I do!
verses.textEnEsv: And why? Because I do not love you? God knows I do!
verses.textEnNkjv: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows!
verses.textEnNlt: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows that I do.
verses.textEnNasb: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows that I do!
verses.textEn: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows I do!

verses.textZh: 我现在所作的，将来还要作，为了要断绝那些投机分子的机会，不让他们在所夸的事上，被人认为是跟我们一样的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我现在所作的，将来还要作，为了要断绝那些投机分子的机会，不让他们在所夸的事上，被人认为是跟我们一样的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我现在所做的，后来还要做，为要断绝那些寻机会人的机会，使他们在所夸的事上也不过与我们一样。
verses.textEnNiv: And I will keep on doing what I am doing in order to cut the ground from under those who want an opportunity to be considered equal with us in the things they boast about.
verses.textEnEsv: And what I am doing I will continue to do, in order to undermine the claim of those who would like to claim that in their boasted mission they work on the same terms as we do.
verses.textEnNkjv: But what I do, I will also continue to do, that I may cut off the opportunity from those who desire an opportunity to be regarded just as we are in the things of which they boast.
verses.textEnNlt: But I will continue doing what I have always done. This will undercut those who are looking for an opportunity to boast that their work is just like ours.
verses.textEnNasb: But what I am doing I will also continue to do, so that I may eliminate the opportunity from those who want an opportunity to be regarded just as we are in the matter about which they are boasting.
verses.textEn: And I will keep on doing what I am doing in order to cut the ground from under those who want an opportunity to be considered equal with us in the things they boast about.

verses.textZh: 这样的人是假使徒，是诡诈的工人，装成基督的使徒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样的人是假使徒，是诡诈的工人，装成基督的使徒。
verses.textZhCuv: 那等人是假使徒，行事诡诈，装作基督使徒的模样。
verses.textEnNiv: For such people are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as apostles of Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workmen, disguising themselves as apostles of Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into apostles of Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: These people are false apostles. They are deceitful workers who disguise themselves as apostles of Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, disguising themselves as apostles of Christ.
verses.textEn: For such people are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as apostles of Christ.

verses.textZh: 这并不希奇，因为撒但自己也装作光明的天使，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这并不希奇，因为撒但自己也装作光明的天使，
verses.textZhCuv: 这也不足为怪，因为连撒但也装作光明的天使。
verses.textEnNiv: And no wonder, for Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light.
verses.textEnEsv: And no wonder, for even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light.
verses.textEnNkjv: And no wonder! For Satan himself transforms himself into an angel of light.
verses.textEnNlt: But I am not surprised! Even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light.
verses.textEnNasb: No wonder, for even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light.
verses.textEn: And no wonder, for Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light.

verses.textZh: 所以，撒但的仆役装成公义的仆役，也不必大惊小怪。他们的结局必按他们所作的而定。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，撒但的仆役装成公义的仆役，也不必大惊小怪。他们的结局必按他们所作的而定。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以他的差役，若装作仁义的差役，也不算希奇。他们的结局必然照着他们的行为。
verses.textEnNiv: It is not surprising, then, if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness. Their end will be what their actions deserve.
verses.textEnEsv: So it is no surprise if his servants, also, disguise themselves as servants of righteousness. Their end will correspond to their deeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also transform themselves into ministers of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.
verses.textEnNlt: So it is no wonder that his servants also disguise themselves as servants of righteousness. In the end they will get the punishment their wicked deeds deserve.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore it is not surprising if his servants also disguise themselves as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their deeds.
verses.textEn: It is not surprising, then, if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness. Their end will be what their actions deserve.

verses.textZh: 我再说，谁也不要以为我是愚昧的；就算这样，也要接纳我这个愚昧的人，使我可以稍微地夸口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我再说，谁也不要以为我是愚昧的；就算这样，也要接纳我这个愚昧的人，使我可以稍微地夸口。
verses.textZhCuv: 我再说，人不可把我看作愚妄的。纵然如此，也要把我当作愚妄人接纳，叫我可以略略自夸。
verses.textEnNiv: I repeat: Let no one take me for a fool. But if you do, then tolerate me just as you would a fool, so that I may do a little boasting.
verses.textEnEsv: I repeat, let no one think me foolish. But even if you do, accept me as a fool, so that I too may boast a little.
verses.textEnNkjv: I say again, let no one think me a fool. If otherwise, at least receive me as a fool, that I also may boast a little.
verses.textEnNlt: Again I say, don’t think that I am a fool to talk like this. But even if you do, listen to me, as you would to a foolish person, while I also boast a little.
verses.textEnNasb: Again I say, let no one think me foolish; but if you do, receive me even as foolish, so that I also may boast a little.
verses.textEn: I repeat: Let no one take me for a fool. But if you do, then tolerate me just as you would a fool, so that I may do a little boasting.

verses.textZh: 我这样满有自信地夸口，不是照着主所吩咐的，而是好象愚昧人在说话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我这样满有自信地夸口，不是照着主所吩咐的，而是好象愚昧人在说话。
verses.textZhCuv: 我说的话不是奉主命说的，乃是像愚妄人放胆自夸；
verses.textEnNiv: In this self-confident boasting I am not talking as the Lord would, but as a fool.
verses.textEnEsv: What I am saying with this boastful confidence, I say not as the Lord would but as a fool.
verses.textEnNkjv: What I speak, I speak not according to the Lord, but as it were, foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
verses.textEnNlt: Such boasting is not from the Lord, but I am acting like a fool.
verses.textEnNasb: What I am saying, I am not saying as the Lord would, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.
verses.textEn: In this self-confident boasting I am not talking as the Lord would, but as a fool.

verses.textZh: 既然有许多人按着世俗的标准夸口，我也要夸口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 既然有许多人按着世俗的标准夸口，我也要夸口。
verses.textZhCuv: 既有好些人凭着血气自夸，我也要自夸了。
verses.textEnNiv: Since many are boasting in the way the world does, I too will boast.
verses.textEnEsv: Since many boast according to the flesh, I too will boast.
verses.textEnNkjv: Seeing that many boast according to the flesh, I also will boast.
verses.textEnNlt: And since others boast about their human achievements, I will, too.
verses.textEnNasb: Since many boast according to the flesh, I will boast also.
verses.textEn: Since many are boasting in the way the world does, I too will boast.

verses.textZh: 你们那么精明，竟然乐意容忍愚昧的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们那么精明，竟然乐意容忍愚昧的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们既是精明人，就能甘心忍耐愚妄人。
verses.textEnNiv: You gladly put up with fools since you are so wise!
verses.textEnEsv: For you gladly bear with fools, being wise yourselves!
verses.textEnNkjv: For you put up with fools gladly, since you yourselves are wise!
verses.textEnNlt: After all, you think you are so wise, but you enjoy putting up with fools!
verses.textEnNasb: For you, being so wise, tolerate the foolish gladly.
verses.textEn: You gladly put up with fools since you are so wise!

verses.textZh: 如果有人奴役你们，侵吞、榨取你们，向你们趾高气扬，打你们的脸，你们就容忍吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有人奴役你们，侵吞、榨取你们，向你们趾高气扬，打你们的脸，你们就容忍吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 假若有人强你们作奴仆，或侵吞你们，或掳掠你们，或侮慢你们，或打你们的脸，你们都能忍耐他。
verses.textEnNiv: In fact, you even put up with anyone who enslaves you or exploits you or takes advantage of you or puts on airs or slaps you in the face.
verses.textEnEsv: For you bear it if someone makes slaves of you, or devours you, or takes advantage of you, or puts on airs, or strikes you in the face.
verses.textEnNkjv: For you put up with it if one brings you into bondage, if one devours you, if one takes fromyou, if one exalts himself, if one strikes you on the face.
verses.textEnNlt: You put up with it when someone enslaves you, takes everything you have, takes advantage of you, takes control of everything, and slaps you in the face.
verses.textEnNasb: For you tolerate it if anyone enslaves you, if anyone devours you, if anyone takes advantage of you, if anyone exalts himself, if anyone hits you in the face.
verses.textEn: In fact, you even put up with anyone who enslaves you or exploits you or takes advantage of you or puts on airs or slaps you in the face.

verses.textZh: 说来惭愧，我们太软弱了。说句愚昧的话，如果有人在甚么事上是勇敢的，我也是勇敢的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说来惭愧，我们太软弱了。说句愚昧的话，如果有人在甚么事上是勇敢的，我也是勇敢的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我说这话是羞辱自己，好像我们从前是软弱的。然而，人在何事上勇敢，（我说句愚妄话，）我也勇敢。
verses.textEnNiv: To my shame I admit that we were too weak for that! Whatever anyone else dares to boast about—I am speaking as a fool—I also dare to boast about.
verses.textEnEsv: To my shame, I must say, we were too weak for that! But whatever anyone else dares to boast of—I am speaking as a fool—I also dare to boast of that.
verses.textEnNkjv: To our shame I say that we were too weak for that! But in whatever anyone is bold—I speak foolishly—I am bold also.
verses.textEnNlt: I’m ashamed to say that we’ve been too "weak" to do that! But whatever they dare to boast about—I’m talking like a fool again—I dare to boast about it, too.
verses.textEnNasb: To my shame I must say that we have been weak by comparison. But in whatever respect anyone else is bold—I am speaking in foolishness—I too am bold.
verses.textEn: To my shame I admit that we were too weak for that! Whatever anyone else dares to boast about—I am speaking as a fool—I also dare to boast about.

verses.textZh: 他们是希伯来人吗？我也是。他们是以色列人吗？我也是。他们是亚伯拉罕的后裔吗？我也是。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们是希伯来人吗？我也是。他们是以色列人吗？我也是。他们是亚伯拉罕的后裔吗？我也是。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们是希伯来人吗？我也是。他们是以色列人吗？我也是。他们是亚伯拉罕的后裔吗？我也是。
verses.textEnNiv: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they Abraham’s descendants? So am I.
verses.textEnEsv: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they offspring of Abraham? So am I.
verses.textEnNkjv: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? So am I.
verses.textEnNlt: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they descendants of Abraham? So am I.
verses.textEnNasb: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they descendants of Abraham? So am I.
verses.textEn: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they Abraham’s descendants? So am I.

verses.textZh: 他们是基督的仆人吗？说句狂话，我更是。我受更多的劳苦，更多的坐监，受了过量的鞭打，常常有生命的危险。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们是基督的仆人吗？说句狂话，我更是。我受更多的劳苦，更多的坐监，受了过量的鞭打，常常有生命的危险。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们是基督的仆人吗？（我说句狂话，）我更是。我比他们多受劳苦，多下监牢，受鞭打是过重的，冒死是屡次有的。
verses.textEnNiv: Are they servants of Christ? (I am out of my mind to talk like this.) I am more. I have worked much harder, been in prison more frequently, been flogged more severely, and been exposed to death again and again.
verses.textEnEsv: Are they servants of Christ? I am a better one—I am talking like a madman—with far greater labors, far more imprisonments, with countless beatings, and often near death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Are they ministers of Christ?—I speak as a fool—I am more: in labors more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequently, in deaths often.
verses.textEnNlt: Are they servants of Christ? I know I sound like a madman, but I have served him far more! I have worked harder, been put in prison more often, been whipped times without number, and faced death again and again.
verses.textEnNasb: Are they servants of Christ?—I am speaking as if insane—I more so; in far more labors, in far more imprisonments, beaten times without number, often in danger of death.
verses.textEn: Are they servants of Christ? (I am out of my mind to talk like this.) I am more. I have worked much harder, been in prison more frequently, been flogged more severely, and been exposed to death again and again.

verses.textZh: 我被犹太人打过五次，每次四十下减去一下，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我被犹太人打过五次，每次四十下减去一下，
verses.textZhCuv: 被犹太人鞭打五次，每次四十减去一下；
verses.textEnNiv: Five times I received from the Jews the forty lashes minus one.
verses.textEnEsv: Five times I received at the hands of the Jews the forty lashes less one.
verses.textEnNkjv: From the Jews five times I received forty stripes minus one.
verses.textEnNlt: Five different times the Jewish leaders gave me thirty-nine lashes.
verses.textEnNasb: Five times I received from the Jews thirty-nine lashes.
verses.textEn: Five times I received from the Jews the forty lashes minus one.

verses.textZh: 被棍打过三次，被石头打过一次，三次遇着船坏，在深海里飘了一昼一夜；
verses.textZhCnvs: 被棍打过三次，被石头打过一次，三次遇着船坏，在深海里飘了一昼一夜；
verses.textZhCuv: 被棍打了三次；被石头打了一次；遇着船坏三次，一昼一夜在深海里。
verses.textEnNiv: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was pelted with stones, three times I was shipwrecked, I spent a night and a day in the open sea,
verses.textEnEsv: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I was shipwrecked; a night and a day I was adrift at sea;
verses.textEnNkjv: Three times I was beaten with rods; once I was stoned; three times I was shipwrecked; a night and a day I have been in the deep;
verses.textEnNlt: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I was shipwrecked. Once I spent a whole night and a day adrift at sea.
verses.textEnNasb: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was stoned, three times I was shipwrecked, a night and a day I have spent adrift at sea.
verses.textEn: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was pelted with stones, three times I was shipwrecked, I spent a night and a day in the open sea,

verses.textZh: 多次行远路，遇着江河的危险、强盗的危险、同族的危险、外族的危险、城中的危险、旷野的危险、海上的危险、假弟兄的危险；
verses.textZhCnvs: 多次行远路，遇着江河的危险、强盗的危险、同族的危险、外族的危险、城中的危险、旷野的危险、海上的危险、假弟兄的危险；
verses.textZhCuv: 又屡次行远路，遭江河的危险、盗贼的危险、同族的危险、外邦人的危险、城里的危险、旷野的危险、海中的危险、假弟兄的危险。
verses.textEnNiv: I have been constantly on the move. I have been in danger from rivers, in danger from bandits, in danger from my fellow Jews, in danger from Gentiles; in danger in the city, in danger in the country, in danger at sea; and in danger from false believers.
verses.textEnEsv: on frequent journeys, in danger from rivers, danger from robbers, danger from my own people, danger from Gentiles, danger in the city, danger in the wilderness, danger at sea, danger from false brothers;
verses.textEnNkjv: in journeys often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils of myown countrymen, in perils of the Gentiles, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;
verses.textEnNlt: I have traveled on many long journeys. I have faced danger from rivers and from robbers. I have faced danger from my own people, the Jews, as well as from the Gentiles. I have faced danger in the cities, in the deserts, and on the seas. And I have faced danger from men who claim to be believers but are not.
verses.textEnNasb: I have been on frequent journeys, in dangers from rivers, dangers from robbers, dangers from my countrymen, dangers from the Gentiles, dangers in the city, dangers in the wilderness, dangers at sea, dangers among false brothers;
verses.textEn: I have been constantly on the move. I have been in danger from rivers, in danger from bandits, in danger from my fellow Jews, in danger from Gentiles; in danger in the city, in danger in the country, in danger at sea; and in danger from false believers.

verses.textZh: 劳碌辛苦，多次不得睡觉，又饥又渴，多次缺粮，赤身挨冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 劳碌辛苦，多次不得睡觉，又饥又渴，多次缺粮，赤身挨冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 受劳碌、受困苦，多次不得睡，又饥又渴，多次不得食，受寒冷，赤身露体。
verses.textEnNiv: I have labored and toiled and have often gone without sleep; I have known hunger and thirst and have often gone without food; I have been cold and naked.
verses.textEnEsv: in toil and hardship, through many a sleepless night, in hunger and thirst, often without food, in cold and exposure.
verses.textEnNkjv: in weariness and toil, in sleeplessness often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness—
verses.textEnNlt: I have worked hard and long, enduring many sleepless nights. I have been hungry and thirsty and have often gone without food. I have shivered in the cold, without enough clothing to keep me warm.
verses.textEnNasb: I have been in labor and hardship, through many sleepless nights, in hunger and thirst, often without food, in cold and exposure.
verses.textEn: I have labored and toiled and have often gone without sleep; I have known hunger and thirst and have often gone without food; I have been cold and naked.

verses.textZh: 除了这些外面的事，还有为各教会挂心的事，天天压在我的身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 除了这些外面的事，还有为各教会挂心的事，天天压在我的身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 除了这外面的事，还有为众教会挂心的事，天天压在我身上。
verses.textEnNiv: Besides everything else, I face daily the pressure of my concern for all the churches.
verses.textEnEsv: And, apart from other things, there is the daily pressure on me of my anxiety for all the churches.
verses.textEnNkjv: besides the other things, what comes upon me daily: my deep concern for all the churches.
verses.textEnNlt: Then, besides all this, I have the daily burden of my concern for all the churches.
verses.textEnNasb: Apart from such external things, there is the daily pressure on me of concern for all the churches.
verses.textEn: Besides everything else, I face daily the pressure of my concern for all the churches.

verses.textZh: 有谁软弱，我不软弱呢？有谁陷在罪里，我不焦急呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 有谁软弱，我不软弱呢？有谁陷在罪里，我不焦急呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 有谁软弱，我不软弱呢？有谁跌倒，我不焦急呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Who is weak, and I do not feel weak? Who is led into sin, and I do not inwardly burn?
verses.textEnEsv: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is made to fall, and I am not indignant?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is made to stumble, and I do not burn withindignation?
verses.textEnNlt: Who is weak without my feeling that weakness? Who is led astray, and I do not burn with anger?
verses.textEnNasb: Who is weak without my being weak? Who is led into sin without my intense concern?
verses.textEn: Who is weak, and I do not feel weak? Who is led into sin, and I do not inwardly burn?

verses.textZh: 如果必须夸口，我就夸自己的弱点。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果必须夸口，我就夸自己的弱点。
verses.textZhCuv: 我若必须自夸，就夸那关乎我软弱的事便了。
verses.textEnNiv: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that show my weakness.
verses.textEnEsv: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that show my weakness.
verses.textEnNkjv: If I must boast, I will boast in the things which concern my infirmity.
verses.textEnNlt: If I must boast, I would rather boast about the things that show how weak I am.
verses.textEnNasb: If I have to boast, I will boast of what pertains to my weakness.
verses.textEn: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that show my weakness.

verses.textZh: 主耶稣的父神是应当永远受称颂的，他知道我没有说谎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶稣的父神是应当永远受称颂的，他知道我没有说谎。
verses.textZhCuv: 那永远可称颂之主耶稣的父神知道我不说谎。
verses.textEnNiv: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, who is to be praised forever, knows that I am not lying.
verses.textEnEsv: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, he who is blessed forever, knows that I am not lying.
verses.textEnNkjv: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who is blessed forever, knows that I am not lying.
verses.textEnNlt: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, who is worthy of eternal praise, knows I am not lying.
verses.textEnNasb: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, He who is blessed forever, knows that I am not lying.
verses.textEn: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, who is to be praised forever, knows that I am not lying.

verses.textZh: 在大马士革，亚里达王手下的总督把守着大马士革城，要拘捕我，
verses.textZhCnvs: 在大马士革，亚里达王手下的总督把守着大马士革城，要拘捕我，
verses.textZhCuv: 在大马士革的亚哩达王手下的提督把守大马士革城，要捉拿我，
verses.textEnNiv: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas had the city of the Damascenes guarded in order to arrest me.
verses.textEnEsv: At Damascus, the governor under King Aretas was guarding the city of Damascus in order to seize me,
verses.textEnNkjv: In Damascus the governor, under Aretas the king, was guarding the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desiring to arrest me;
verses.textEnNlt: When I was in Damascus, the governor under King Aretas kept guards at the city gates to catch me.
verses.textEnNasb: In Damascus the ethnarch under Aretas the king was guarding the city of the Damascenes in order to seize me,
verses.textEn: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas had the city of the Damascenes guarded in order to arrest me.

verses.textZh: 我就被人放在一个大篮子里，从城墙的窗户缒下来，逃脱了他的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就被人放在一个大篮子里，从城墙的窗户缒下来，逃脱了他的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就从窗户中，在筐子里，从城墙上被人缒下去，脱离了他的手。
verses.textEnNiv: But I was lowered in a basket from a window in the wall and slipped through his hands.
verses.textEnEsv: but I was let down in a basket through a window in the wall and escaped his hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: but I was let down in a basket through a window in the wall, and escaped from his hands.
verses.textEnNlt: I had to be lowered in a basket through a window in the city wall to escape from him.
verses.textEnNasb: and I was let down in a basket through a window in the wall, and so escaped his hands.
verses.textEn: But I was lowered in a basket from a window in the wall and slipped through his hands.

verses.textZh: 夸口固然无益，却也是必要的。现在我要说说主的异象和启示。
verses.textZhCnvs: 夸口固然无益，却也是必要的。现在我要说说主的异象和启示。
verses.textZhCuv: 我自夸固然无益，但我是不得已的。如今我要说到主的显现和启示。
verses.textEnNiv: I must go on boasting. Although there is nothing to be gained, I will go on to visions and revelations from the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: I must go on boasting. Though there is nothing to be gained by it, I will go on to visions and revelations of the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord:
verses.textEnNlt: This boasting will do no good, but I must go on. I will reluctantly tell about visions and revelations from the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: Boasting is necessary, though it is not beneficial; but I will go on to visions and revelations of the Lord.
verses.textEn: I must go on boasting. Although there is nothing to be gained, I will go on to visions and revelations from the Lord.

verses.textZh: 我认识一个在基督里的人，他十四年前被提到第三层天上去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我认识一个在基督里的人，他十四年前被提到第三层天上去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我认得一个在基督里的人，他前十四年被提到第三层天上去；（或在身内，我不知道；或在身外，我也不知道；只有神知道。）
verses.textEnNiv: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven. Whether it was in the body or out of the body I do not know—God knows.
verses.textEnEsv: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven—whether in the body or out of the body I do not know, God knows.
verses.textEnNkjv: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago—whether in the body I do not know, or whether out of the body I do not know, God knows—such a one was caught up to the third heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: I was caught up to the third heaven fourteen years ago. Whether I was in my body or out of my body, I don’t know—only God knows.
verses.textEnNasb: I know a man in Christ, who fourteen years ago—whether in the body I do not know, or out of the body I do not know, God knows—such a man was caught up to the third heaven.
verses.textEn: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven. Whether it was in the body or out of the body I do not know—God knows.

verses.textZh: 我认识这个人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我认识这个人，
verses.textZhCuv: 我认得这人；（或在身内，或在身外，我都不知道，只有神知道。）
verses.textEnNiv: And I know that this man—whether in the body or apart from the body I do not know, but God knows—
verses.textEnEsv: And I know that this man was caught up into paradise—whether in the body or out of the body I do not know, God knows—
verses.textEnNkjv: And I know such a man—whether in the body or out of the body I do not know, God knows—
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, only God knows whether I was in my body or outside my body. But I do know
verses.textEnNasb: And I know how such a man—whether in the body or apart from the body I do not know, God knows—
verses.textEn: And I know that this man—whether in the body or apart from the body I do not know, but God knows—

verses.textZh: 他被提到乐园里去，听见了难以言喻的话，那是人不可以说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他被提到乐园里去，听见了难以言喻的话，那是人不可以说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他被提到乐园里，听见隐秘的言语，是人不可说的。
verses.textEnNiv: was caught up to paradise and heard inexpressible things, things that no one is permitted to tell.
verses.textEnEsv: and he heard things that cannot be told, which man may not utter.
verses.textEnNkjv: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard inexpressible words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
verses.textEnNlt: that I was caught up to paradise and heard things so astounding that they cannot be expressed in words, things no human is allowed to tell.
verses.textEnNasb: was caught up into Paradise and heard inexpressible words, which a man is not permitted to speak.
verses.textEn: was caught up to paradise and heard inexpressible things, things that no one is permitted to tell.

verses.textZh: 为了这个人，我要夸口，但为了我自己，除了我的软弱以外，我没有可夸的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了这个人，我要夸口，但为了我自己，除了我的软弱以外，我没有可夸的。
verses.textZhCuv: 为这人，我要夸口；但是为我自己，除了我的软弱以外，我并不夸口。
verses.textEnNiv: I will boast about a man like that, but I will not boast about myself, except about my weaknesses.
verses.textEnEsv: On behalf of this man I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except of my weaknesses—
verses.textEnNkjv: Of such a one I will boast; yet of myself I will not boast, except in my infirmities.
verses.textEnNlt: That experience is worth boasting about, but I’m not going to do it. I will boast only about my weaknesses.
verses.textEnNasb: In behalf of such a man I will boast; but in my own behalf I will not boast, except regarding my weaknesses.
verses.textEn: I will boast about a man like that, but I will not boast about myself, except about my weaknesses.

verses.textZh: 即使我想夸口，也不算愚妄，因为我要说的是真话。但我闭口不提，免得有人把我看得太高，过于他在我身上所见所闻的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 即使我想夸口，也不算愚妄，因为我要说的是真话。但我闭口不提，免得有人把我看得太高，过于他在我身上所见所闻的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就是愿意夸口也不算狂，因为我必说实话；只是我禁止不说，恐怕有人把我看高了，过于他在我身上所看见所听见的。
verses.textEnNiv: Even if I should choose to boast, I would not be a fool, because I would be speaking the truth. But I refrain, so no one will think more of me than is warranted by what I do or say,
verses.textEnEsv: though if I should wish to boast, I would not be a fool, for I would be speaking the truth; but I refrain from it, so that no one may think more of me than he sees in me or hears from me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For though I might desire to boast, I will not be a fool; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, lest anyone should think of me above what he sees me tobe or hears from me.
verses.textEnNlt: If I wanted to boast, I would be no fool in doing so, because I would be telling the truth. But I won’t do it, because I don’t want anyone to give me credit beyond what they can see in my life or hear in my message,
verses.textEnNasb: For if I do wish to boast I will not be foolish, for I will be speaking the truth; but I refrain from this, so that no one will credit me with more than he sees in me or hears from me.
verses.textEn: Even if I should choose to boast, I would not be a fool, because I would be speaking the truth. But I refrain, so no one will think more of me than is warranted by what I do or say,

verses.textZh: 又因为我所得的启示太大，恐怕会高抬自己，所以就有一根刺加在我的身上，就是撒但的差役来攻击我，免得我高抬自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又因为我所得的启示太大，恐怕会高抬自己，所以就有一根刺加在我的身上，就是撒但的差役来攻击我，免得我高抬自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 又恐怕我因所得的启示甚大，就过于自高，所以有一根刺加在我肉体上，就是撒但的差役要攻击我，免得我过于自高。
verses.textEnNiv: or because of these surpassingly great revelations. Therefore, in order to keep me from becoming conceited, I was given a thorn in my flesh, a messenger of Satan, to torment me.
verses.textEnEsv: So to keep me from becoming conceited because of the surpassing greatness of the revelations, a thorn was given me in the flesh, a messenger of Satan to harass me, to keep me from becoming conceited.
verses.textEnNkjv: And lest I should be exalted above measure by the abundance of the revelations, a thorn in the flesh was given to me, a messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I be exalted above measure.
verses.textEnNlt: even though I have received such wonderful revelations from God. So to keep me from becoming proud, I was given a thorn in my flesh, a messenger from Satan to torment me and keep me from becoming proud.
verses.textEnNasb: Because of the extraordinary greatness of the revelations, for this reason, to keep me from exalting myself, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, a messenger of Satan to torment me—to keep me from exalting myself!
verses.textEn: or because of these surpassingly great revelations. Therefore, in order to keep me from becoming conceited, I was given a thorn in my flesh, a messenger of Satan, to torment me.

verses.textZh: 为了这事，我曾经三次求主，使这根刺离开我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了这事，我曾经三次求主，使这根刺离开我。
verses.textZhCuv: 为这事，我三次求过主，叫这刺离开我。
verses.textEnNiv: Three times I pleaded with the Lord to take it away from me.
verses.textEnEsv: Three times I pleaded with the Lord about this, that it should leave me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Concerning this thing I pleaded with the Lord three times that it might depart from me.
verses.textEnNlt: Three different times I begged the Lord to take it away.
verses.textEnNasb: Concerning this I pleaded with the Lord three times that it might leave me.
verses.textEn: Three times I pleaded with the Lord to take it away from me.

verses.textZh: 他却对我说："<red>我的恩典是够你用的，因为我的能力在人的软弱上显得完全。</red>"所以，我更喜欢夸自己的软弱，好让基督的能力临到我的身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他却对我说："<red>我的恩典是够你用的，因为我的能力在人的软弱上显得完全。</red>"所以，我更喜欢夸自己的软弱，好让基督的能力临到我的身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「<red>我的恩典够你用的，因为我的能力是在人的软弱上显得完全。</red>」所以，我更喜欢夸自己的软弱，好叫基督的能力覆庇我。
verses.textEnNiv: But he said to me, <red>“My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.”</red> Therefore I will boast all the more gladly about my weaknesses, so that Christ’s power may rest on me.
verses.textEnEsv: But he said to me, "My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness." Therefore I will boast all the more gladly of my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to me, "My grace is sufficient for you, for My strength is made perfect in weakness." Therefore most gladly I will rather boast in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
verses.textEnNlt: Each time he said, "My grace is all you need. My power works best in weakness." So now I am glad to boast about my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ can work through me.
verses.textEnNasb: And He has said to me, "My grace is sufficient for you, for power is perfected in weakness." Most gladly, therefore, I will rather boast about my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may dwell in me.
verses.textEn: But he said to me, <red>“My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.”</red> Therefore I will boast all the more gladly about my weaknesses, so that Christ’s power may rest on me.

verses.textZh: 因此，我为基督的缘故，就以软弱、凌辱、艰难、迫害、困苦为喜乐，因为我甚么时候软弱，甚么时候就刚强了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我为基督的缘故，就以软弱、凌辱、艰难、迫害、困苦为喜乐，因为我甚么时候软弱，甚么时候就刚强了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我为基督的缘故，就以软弱、凌辱、急难、逼迫、困苦为可喜乐的；因我什么时候软弱，什么时候就刚强了。
verses.textEnNiv: That is why, for Christ’s sake, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.
verses.textEnEsv: For the sake of Christ, then, I am content with weaknesses, insults, hardships, persecutions, and calamities. For when I am weak, then I am strong.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in needs, in persecutions, in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then I am strong.
verses.textEnNlt: That’s why I take pleasure in my weaknesses, and in the insults, hardships, persecutions, and troubles that I suffer for Christ. For when I am weak, then I am strong.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in distresses, in persecutions, in difficulties, in behalf of Christ; for when I am weak, then I am strong.
verses.textEn: That is why, for Christ’s sake, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.

verses.textZh: 我成了愚妄的人，是你们逼成的。其实你们应该称赞我，因为我虽然算不得甚么，却没有一点比不上那些"超等使徒"。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我成了愚妄的人，是你们逼成的。其实你们应该称赞我，因为我虽然算不得甚么，却没有一点比不上那些"超等使徒"。
verses.textZhCuv: 我成了愚妄人，是被你们强逼的。我本该被你们称许才是。我虽算不了什么，却没有一件事在那些最大的使徒以下。
verses.textEnNiv: I have made a fool of myself, but you drove me to it. I ought to have been commended by you, for I am not in the least inferior to the "super-apostles," even though I am nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: I have been a fool! You forced me to it, for I ought to have been commended by you. For I was not at all inferior to these super-apostles, even though I am nothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have become a fool in boasting; you have compelled me. For I ought to have been commended by you; for in nothing was I behind the most eminent apostles, though I am nothing.
verses.textEnNlt: You have made me act like a fool. You ought to be writing commendations for me, for I am not at all inferior to these "super apostles," even though I am nothing at all.
verses.textEnNasb: I have become foolish; you yourselves compelled me. Actually I should have been commended by you, since I was in no respect inferior to the most eminent apostles, even though I am a nobody.
verses.textEn: I have made a fool of myself, but you drove me to it. I ought to have been commended by you, for I am not in the least inferior to the "super-apostles," even though I am nothing.

verses.textZh: 我在你们中间，以各种忍耐，用神迹、奇事和大能，作为使徒的凭据。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在你们中间，以各种忍耐，用神迹、奇事和大能，作为使徒的凭据。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在你们中间，用百般的忍耐，藉着神迹、奇事、异能显出使徒的凭据来。
verses.textEnNiv: I persevered in demonstrating among you the marks of a true apostle, including signs, wonders and miracles.
