verses.textEnEsv: The signs of a true apostle were performed among you with utmost patience, with signs and wonders and mighty works.
verses.textEnNkjv: Truly the signs of an apostle were accomplished among you with all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty deeds.
verses.textEnNlt: When I was with you, I certainly gave you proof that I am an apostle. For I patiently did many signs and wonders and miracles among you.
verses.textEnNasb: The distinguishing marks of a true apostle were performed among you with all perseverance, by signs, wonders, and miracles.
verses.textEn: I persevered in demonstrating among you the marks of a true apostle, including signs, wonders and miracles.

verses.textZh: 除了我自己没有成为你们的重担以外，你们还有甚么比不上别的教会呢？这一点委屈，请原谅我吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 除了我自己没有成为你们的重担以外，你们还有甚么比不上别的教会呢？这一点委屈，请原谅我吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 除了我不累着你们这一件事，你们还有什么事不及别的教会呢？这不公之处，求你们饶恕我吧。
verses.textEnNiv: How were you inferior to the other churches, except that I was never a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!
verses.textEnEsv: For in what were you less favored than the rest of the churches, except that I myself did not burden you? Forgive me this wrong!
verses.textEnNkjv: For what is it in which you were inferior to other churches, except that I myself was not burdensome to you? Forgive me this wrong!
verses.textEnNlt: The only thing I failed to do, which I do in the other churches, was to become a financial burden to you. Please forgive me for this wrong!
verses.textEnNasb: For in what respect were you treated as inferior to the rest of the churches, except that I myself did not become a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!
verses.textEn: How were you inferior to the other churches, except that I was never a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

verses.textZh: 好了，我打算第三次到你们那里去，这一次也不会成为你们的重担，因为我所要的不是你们的东西，而是你们自己。儿女不需要为父母积财，父母却应该为儿女积财。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好了，我打算第三次到你们那里去，这一次也不会成为你们的重担，因为我所要的不是你们的东西，而是你们自己。儿女不需要为父母积财，父母却应该为儿女积财。
verses.textZhCuv: 如今，我打算第三次到你们那里去，也必不累着你们；因我所求的是你们，不是你们的财物。儿女不该为父母积财，父母该为儿女积财。
verses.textEnNiv: Now I am ready to visit you for the third time, and I will not be a burden to you, because what I want is not your possessions but you. After all, children should not have to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.
verses.textEnEsv: Here for the third time I am ready to come to you. And I will not be a burden, for I seek not what is yours but you. For children are not obligated to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now for the third time I am ready to come to you. And I will not be burdensome to you; for I do not seek yours, but you. For the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
verses.textEnNlt: Now I am coming to you for the third time, and I will not be a burden to you. I don’t want what you have—I want you. After all, children don’t provide for their parents. Rather, parents provide for their children.
verses.textEnNasb: Here for this third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I do not seek what is yours, but you; for children are not responsible to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.
verses.textEn: Now I am ready to visit you for the third time, and I will not be a burden to you, because what I want is not your possessions but you. After all, children should not have to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我甘心乐意为你们的灵魂付上一切，鞠躬尽瘁。难道我越爱你们，就越得不到你们的爱吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我甘心乐意为你们的灵魂付上一切，鞠躬尽瘁。难道我越爱你们，就越得不到你们的爱吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我也甘心乐意为你们的灵魂费财费力。难道我越发爱你们，就越发少得你们的爱吗？
verses.textEnNiv: So I will very gladly spend for you everything I have and expend myself as well. If I love you more, will you love me less?
verses.textEnEsv: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more, am I to be loved less?
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for your souls; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I am loved.
verses.textEnNlt: I will gladly spend myself and all I have for you, even though it seems that the more I love you, the less you love me.
verses.textEnNasb: I will most gladly spend and be expended for your souls. If I love you more, am I to be loved less?
verses.textEn: So I will very gladly spend for you everything I have and expend myself as well. If I love you more, will you love me less?

verses.textZh: 算了！我没有成为你们的重担，却是个狡猾的人，用诡计牢笼你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 算了！我没有成为你们的重担，却是个狡猾的人，用诡计牢笼你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 罢了，我自己并没有累着你们，你们却有人说，我是诡诈，用心计牢笼你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Be that as it may, I have not been a burden to you. Yet, crafty fellow that I am, I caught you by trickery!
verses.textEnEsv: But granting that I myself did not burden you, I was crafty, you say, and got the better of you by deceit.
verses.textEnNkjv: But be that asitmay, I did not burden you. Nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you by cunning!
verses.textEnNlt: Some of you admit I was not a burden to you. But others still think I was sneaky and took advantage of you by trickery.
verses.textEnNasb: But be that as it may, I did not burden you myself; nevertheless, devious person that I am, I took you in by deceit.
verses.textEn: Be that as it may, I have not been a burden to you. Yet, crafty fellow that I am, I caught you by trickery!

verses.textZh: 我派到你们那里去的人，我借着谁占过你们的便宜？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我派到你们那里去的人，我借着谁占过你们的便宜？
verses.textZhCuv: 我所差到你们那里去的人，我藉着他们一个人占过你们的便宜吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Did I exploit you through any of the men I sent to you?
verses.textEnEsv: Did I take advantage of you through any of those whom I sent to you?
verses.textEnNkjv: Did I take advantage of you by any of those whom I sent to you?
verses.textEnNlt: But how? Did any of the men I sent to you take advantage of you?
verses.textEnNasb: Certainly I have not taken advantage of you through any of those whom I have sent to you, have I?
verses.textEn: Did I exploit you through any of the men I sent to you?

verses.textZh: 我劝提多到你们那里去，又派了那位弟兄一同去。提多占过你们的便宜吗？我们行事，不是同一个心灵吗？不是同样的步伐吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我劝提多到你们那里去，又派了那位弟兄一同去。提多占过你们的便宜吗？我们行事，不是同一个心灵吗？不是同样的步伐吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我劝了提多到你们那里去，又差那位兄弟与他同去。提多占过你们的便宜吗？我们行事，不同是一个心灵 吗？不同是一个脚踪吗？
verses.textEnNiv: I urged Titus to go to you and I sent our brother with him. Titus did not exploit you, did he? Did we not walk in the same footsteps by the same Spirit?
verses.textEnEsv: I urged Titus to go, and sent the brother with him. Did Titus take advantage of you? Did we not act in the same spirit? Did we not take the same steps?
verses.textEnNkjv: I urged Titus, and sent our brother with him. Did Titus take advantage of you? Did we not walk in the same spirit? Did we not walk in the same steps?
verses.textEnNlt: When I urged Titus to visit you and sent our other brother with him, did Titus take advantage of you? No! For we have the same spirit and walk in each other’s steps, doing things the same way.
verses.textEnNasb: I urged Titus to go, and I sent the brother with him. Titus did not take any advantage of you, did he? Did we not conduct ourselves in the same spirit and walk in the same steps?
verses.textEn: I urged Titus to go to you and I sent our brother with him. Titus did not exploit you, did he? Did we not walk in the same footsteps by the same Spirit?

verses.textZh: 你们一直以为我们是在向你们申辩吗？我们是在基督里，当着神面前说话的。亲爱的，一切事都是为了建立你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们一直以为我们是在向你们申辩吗？我们是在基督里，当着神面前说话的。亲爱的，一切事都是为了建立你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们到如今，还想我们是向你们分诉；我们本是在基督里当神面前说话。亲爱的弟兄啊，一切的事都是为造就你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? We have been speaking in the sight of God as those in Christ; and everything we do, dear friends, is for your strengthening.
verses.textEnEsv: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? It is in the sight of God that we have been speaking in Christ, and all for your upbuilding, beloved.
verses.textEnNkjv: Again, do you think that we excuse ourselves to you? We speak before God in Christ. But wedo all things, beloved, for your edification.
verses.textEnNlt: Perhaps you think we’re saying these things just to defend ourselves. No, we tell you this as Christ’s servants, and with God as our witness. Everything we do, dear friends, is to strengthen you.
verses.textEnNasb: All this time you have been thinking that we are defending ourselves to you. Actually, it is in the sight of God that we have been speaking in Christ; and all for building you up, beloved.
verses.textEn: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? We have been speaking in the sight of God as those in Christ; and everything we do, dear friends, is for your strengthening.

verses.textZh: 我怕我来的时候，见你们不如我所想的，你们见我也不如你们所想的。又怕有纷争、嫉妒、恼怒、自私、毁谤、谗言、狂傲、混乱的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我怕我来的时候，见你们不如我所想的，你们见我也不如你们所想的。又怕有纷争、嫉妒、恼怒、自私、毁谤、谗言、狂傲、混乱的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 我怕我再来的时候，见你们不合我所想望的，你们见我也不合你们所想望的；又怕有纷争、嫉妒、恼怒、结党、毁谤、谗言、狂傲、混乱的事。
verses.textEnNiv: For I am afraid that when I come I may not find you as I want you to be, and you may not find me as you want me to be. I fear that there may be discord, jealousy, fits of rage, selfish ambition, slander, gossip, arrogance and disorder.
verses.textEnEsv: For I fear that perhaps when I come I may find you not as I wish, and that you may find me not as you wish—that perhaps there may be quarreling, jealousy, anger, hostility, slander, gossip, conceit, and disorder.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I fear lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I wish, and that I shall be found by you such as you do not wish; lest therebe contentions, jealousies, outbursts of wrath, selfish ambitions, backbitings, whisperings, conceits, tumults;
verses.textEnNlt: For I am afraid that when I come I won’t like what I find, and you won’t like my response. I am afraid that I will find quarreling, jealousy, anger, selfishness, slander, gossip, arrogance, and disorderly behavior.
verses.textEnNasb: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come I may find you to be not what I wish, and may be found by you to be not what you wish; that perhaps there will be strife, jealousy, angry tempers, selfishness, slanders, gossip, arrogance, disturbances;
verses.textEn: For I am afraid that when I come I may not find you as I want you to be, and you may not find me as you want me to be. I fear that there may be discord, jealousy, fits of rage, selfish ambition, slander, gossip, arrogance and disorder.

verses.textZh: 又怕我再来的时候，我的神使我在你们面前羞愧；并且我要为许多从前犯罪的人哀痛，因为他们行了污秽、奸淫、邪荡的事，却不肯悔改。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又怕我再来的时候，我的神使我在你们面前羞愧；并且我要为许多从前犯罪的人哀痛，因为他们行了污秽、奸淫、邪荡的事，却不肯悔改。
verses.textZhCuv: 且怕我来的时候，我的神叫我在你们面前惭愧，又因许多人从前犯罪，行污秽、奸淫、邪荡的事不肯悔改，我就忧愁。
verses.textEnNiv: I am afraid that when I come again my God will humble me before you, and I will be grieved over many who have sinned earlier and have not repented of the impurity, sexual sin and debauchery in which they have indulged.
verses.textEnEsv: I fear that when I come again my God may humble me before you, and I may have to mourn over many of those who sinned earlier and have not repented of the impurity, sexual immorality, and sensuality that they have practiced.
verses.textEnNkjv: lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and I shall mourn for many who have sinned before and have not repented of the uncleanness, fornication, and lewdness which they have practiced.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I am afraid that when I come again, God will humble me in your presence. And I will be grieved because many of you have not given up your old sins. You have not repented of your impurity, sexual immorality, and eagerness for lustful pleasure.
verses.textEnNasb: I am afraid that when I come again my God may humiliate me before you, and I may mourn over many of those who have sinned in the past and not repented of the impurity, sexual immorality, and indecent behavior which they have practiced.
verses.textEn: I am afraid that when I come again my God will humble me before you, and I will be grieved over many who have sinned earlier and have not repented of the impurity, sexual sin and debauchery in which they have indulged.

verses.textZh: 这是我第三次到你们那里去，各样事情必须凭两三个证人的口，才能确定。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是我第三次到你们那里去，各样事情必须凭两三个证人的口，才能确定。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是我第三次要到你们那里去。「凭两三个人的口作见证，句句都要定准。」
verses.textEnNiv: This will be my third visit to you. "Every matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses."
verses.textEnEsv: This is the third time I am coming to you. Every charge must be established by the evidence of two or three witnesses.
verses.textEnNkjv: This willbe the third time I am coming to you. "By the mouth of two or three witnesses every word shall be established."
verses.textEnNlt: This is the third time I am coming to visit you (and as the Scriptures say, "The facts of every case must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses" ).
verses.textEnNasb: This is the third time that I am coming to you. On the testimony of two or three witnesses every matter shall be confirmed.
verses.textEn: This will be my third visit to you. "Every matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses."

verses.textZh: 我第二次到你们那里去的时候说过，现今不在你们那里，再预先对那些从前犯了罪的和其余的人说：我若再来，必不宽容，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我第二次到你们那里去的时候说过，现今不在你们那里，再预先对那些从前犯了罪的和其余的人说：我若再来，必不宽容，
verses.textZhCuv: 我从前说过，如今不在你们那里又说，正如我第二次见你们的时候所说的一样，就是对那犯了罪的和其余的人说：「我若再来，必不宽容。」
verses.textEnNiv: I already gave you a warning when I was with you the second time. I now repeat it while absent: On my return I will not spare those who sinned earlier or any of the others,
verses.textEnEsv: I warned those who sinned before and all the others, and I warn them now while absent, as I did when present on my second visit, that if I come again I will not spare them—
verses.textEnNkjv: I have told you before, and foretell as if I were present the second time, and now being absent I write to those who have sinned before, and to all the rest, that if I come again I will not spare—
verses.textEnNlt: I have already warned those who had been sinning when I was there on my second visit. Now I again warn them and all others, just as I did before, that next time I will not spare them.
verses.textEnNasb: I have previously said when I was present the second time, and though now absent I say in advance to those who have sinned in the past and to all the rest as well, that if I come again I will not spare anyone,
verses.textEn: I already gave you a warning when I was with you the second time. I now repeat it while absent: On my return I will not spare those who sinned earlier or any of the others,

verses.textZh: 因为你们在找基督借着我说话的凭据。基督对你们不是软弱的，相反地，在你们身上是有能力的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们在找基督借着我说话的凭据。基督对你们不是软弱的，相反地，在你们身上是有能力的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们既然寻求基督在我里面说话的凭据，我必不宽容。因为，基督在你们身上不是软弱的，在你们里面是有大能的。
verses.textEnNiv: since you are demanding proof that Christ is speaking through me. He is not weak in dealing with you, but is powerful among you.
verses.textEnEsv: since you seek proof that Christ is speaking in me. He is not weak in dealing with you, but is powerful among you.
verses.textEnNkjv: since you seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, who is not weak toward you, but mighty in you.
verses.textEnNlt: I will give you all the proof you want that Christ speaks through me. Christ is not weak when he deals with you; he is powerful among you.
verses.textEnNasb: since you are seeking proof of the Christ who speaks in me, who is not weak toward you, but mighty in you.
verses.textEn: since you are demanding proof that Christ is speaking through me. He is not weak in dealing with you, but is powerful among you.

verses.textZh: 他因着软弱被钉死了，却靠着神的大能活着。我们在他里面也是软弱的，但靠着神向你们所显的大能，也必与他一同活着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他因着软弱被钉死了，却靠着神的大能活着。我们在他里面也是软弱的，但靠着神向你们所显的大能，也必与他一同活着。
verses.textZhCuv: 他因软弱被钉在十字架上，却因神的大能仍然活着。我们也是这样同他软弱，但因神向你们所显的大能，也必与他同活。
verses.textEnNiv: For to be sure, he was crucified in weakness, yet he lives by God’s power. Likewise, we are weak in him, yet by God’s power we will live with him in our dealing with you.
verses.textEnEsv: For he was crucified in weakness, but lives by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but in dealing with you we will live with him by the power of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For though He was crucified in weakness, yet He lives by the power of God. For we also are weak in Him, but we shall live with Him by the power of God toward you.
verses.textEnNlt: Although he was crucified in weakness, he now lives by the power of God. We, too, are weak, just as Christ was, but when we deal with you we will be alive with him and will have God’s power.
verses.textEnNasb: For indeed He was crucified because of weakness, yet He lives because of the power of God. For we too are weak in Him, yet we will live with Him because of the power of God directed toward you.
verses.textEn: For to be sure, he was crucified in weakness, yet he lives by God’s power. Likewise, we are weak in him, yet by God’s power we will live with him in our dealing with you.

verses.textZh: 你们应当察验自己是不是持守着信仰，也应当考验自己。难道不晓得基督耶稣是在你们里面吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们应当察验自己是不是持守着信仰，也应当考验自己。难道不晓得基督耶稣是在你们里面吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们总要自己省察有信心没有，也要自己试验。岂不知你们若不是可弃绝的，就有耶稣基督在你们心里吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves. Do you not realize that Christ Jesus is in you—unless, of course, you fail the test?
verses.textEnEsv: Examine yourselves, to see whether you are in the faith. Test yourselves. Or do you not realize this about yourselves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you fail to meet the test!
verses.textEnNkjv: Examine yourselves asto whether you are in the faith. Test yourselves. Do you not know yourselves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.
verses.textEnNlt: Examine yourselves to see if your faith is genuine. Test yourselves. Surely you know that Jesus Christ is among you ; if not, you have failed the test of genuine faith.
verses.textEnNasb: Test yourselves to see if you are in the faith; examine yourselves! Or do you not recognize this about yourselves, that Jesus Christ is in you—unless indeed you fail the test?
verses.textEn: Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves. Do you not realize that Christ Jesus is in you—unless, of course, you fail the test?

verses.textZh: 我盼望你们晓得，我们不是经不起考验的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我盼望你们晓得，我们不是经不起考验的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我却盼望你们晓得，我们不是可弃绝的人。
verses.textEnNiv: And I trust that you will discover that we have not failed the test.
verses.textEnEsv: I hope you will find out that we have not failed the test.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I trust that you will know that we are not disqualified.
verses.textEnNlt: As you test yourselves, I hope you will recognize that we have not failed the test of apostolic authority.
verses.textEnNasb: But I expect that you will realize that we ourselves do not fail the test.
verses.textEn: And I trust that you will discover that we have not failed the test.

verses.textZh: 我们祈求神，使你们不作甚么恶事。这并不是要显明我们是经得起考验的，而是要你们行善；我们呢，就让我们作经不起考验的人好了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们祈求神，使你们不作甚么恶事。这并不是要显明我们是经得起考验的，而是要你们行善；我们呢，就让我们作经不起考验的人好了！
verses.textZhCuv: 我们求神，叫你们一件恶事都不做；这不是要显明我们是蒙悦纳的，是要你们行事端正，任凭人看我们是被弃绝的吧！
verses.textEnNiv: Now we pray to God that you will not do anything wrong—not so that people will see that we have stood the test but so that you will do what is right even though we may seem to have failed.
verses.textEnEsv: But we pray to God that you may not do wrong—not that we may appear to have met the test, but that you may do what is right, though we may seem to have failed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I pray to God that you do no evil, not that we should appear approved, but that you should do what is honorable, though we may seem disqualified.
verses.textEnNlt: We pray to God that you will not do what is wrong by refusing our correction. I hope we won’t need to demonstrate our authority when we arrive. Do the right thing before we come—even if that makes it look like we have failed to demonstrate our authority.
verses.textEnNasb: Now we pray to God that you do nothing wrong; not so that we ourselves may appear approved, but that you may do what is right, though we may appear unapproved.
verses.textEn: Now we pray to God that you will not do anything wrong—not so that people will see that we have stood the test but so that you will do what is right even though we may seem to have failed.

verses.textZh: 我们不能作甚么事违背真理，只能维护真理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们不能作甚么事违背真理，只能维护真理。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们凡事不能敌挡真理，只能扶助真理。
verses.textEnNiv: For we cannot do anything against the truth, but only for the truth.
verses.textEnEsv: For we cannot do anything against the truth, but only for the truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
verses.textEnNlt: For we cannot oppose the truth, but must always stand for the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: For we cannot do anything against the truth, but only for the truth.
verses.textEn: For we cannot do anything against the truth, but only for the truth.

verses.textZh: 当我们软弱、你们刚强的时候，我们就欢喜；我们所求的，就是要你们完全。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当我们软弱、你们刚强的时候，我们就欢喜；我们所求的，就是要你们完全。
verses.textZhCuv: 即便我们软弱，你们刚强，我们也欢喜；并且我们所求的，就是你们作完全人。
verses.textEnNiv: We are glad whenever we are weak but you are strong; and our prayer is that you may be fully restored.
verses.textEnEsv: For we are glad when we are weak and you are strong. Your restoration is what we pray for.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we are glad when we are weak and you are strong. And this also we pray, that you may be made complete.
verses.textEnNlt: We are glad to seem weak if it helps show that you are actually strong. We pray that you will become mature.
verses.textEnNasb: For we rejoice when we ourselves are weak, but you are strong; this we also pray for, that you become mature.
verses.textEn: We are glad whenever we are weak but you are strong; and our prayer is that you may be fully restored.

verses.textZh: 因此，我趁着不在你们那里的时候，把这些话写给你们，到我来了，就不必凭着主所给我的权柄严厉地对待你们。这权柄不是要拆毁你们，而是要建立你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我趁着不在你们那里的时候，把这些话写给你们，到我来了，就不必凭着主所给我的权柄严厉地对待你们。这权柄不是要拆毁你们，而是要建立你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我不在你们那里的时候，把这话写给你们，好叫我见你们的时候，不用照主所给我的权柄严厉地待你们。这权柄原是为造就人，并不是为败坏人。
verses.textEnNiv: This is why I write these things when I am absent, that when I come I may not have to be harsh in my use of authority—the authority the Lord gave me for building you up, not for tearing you down.
verses.textEnEsv: For this reason I write these things while I am away from you, that when I come I may not have to be severe in my use of the authority that the Lord has given me for building up and not for tearing down.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the authority which the Lord has given me for edification and not for destruction.
verses.textEnNlt: I am writing this to you before I come, hoping that I won’t need to deal severely with you when I do come. For I want to use the authority the Lord has given me to strengthen you, not to tear you down.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason I am writing these things while absent, so that when present I need not use severity, in accordance with the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.
verses.textEn: This is why I write these things when I am absent, that when I come I may not have to be harsh in my use of authority—the authority the Lord gave me for building you up, not for tearing you down.

verses.textZh: 最后，弟兄们，你们要喜乐，要完全，要受安慰，要同心，要和睦。这样，施慈爱赐平安的神必与你们同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 最后，弟兄们，你们要喜乐，要完全，要受安慰，要同心，要和睦。这样，施慈爱赐平安的神必与你们同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 还有末了的话：愿弟兄们都喜乐。要作完全人；要受安慰；要同心合意；要彼此和睦。如此，仁爱和平的神必常与你们同在。
verses.textEnNiv: Finally, brothers and sisters, rejoice! Strive for full restoration, encourage one another, be of one mind, live in peace. And the God of love and peace will be with you.
verses.textEnEsv: Finally, brothers, rejoice. Aim for restoration, comfort one another, agree with one another, live in peace; and the God of love and peace will be with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Finally, brethren, farewell. Become complete. Be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace will be with you.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear brothers and sisters, I close my letter with these last words: Be joyful. Grow to maturity. Encourage each other. Live in harmony and peace. Then the God of love and peace will be with you.
verses.textEnNasb: Finally, brothers and sisters, rejoice, mend your ways, be comforted, be like-minded, live in peace; and the God of love and peace will be with you.
verses.textEn: Finally, brothers and sisters, rejoice! Strive for full restoration, encourage one another, be of one mind, live in peace. And the God of love and peace will be with you.

verses.textZh: 你们要用圣洁的亲吻彼此问安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要用圣洁的亲吻彼此问安。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们亲嘴问安，彼此务要圣洁。
verses.textEnNiv: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
verses.textEnEsv: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
verses.textEnNkjv: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
verses.textEnNlt: Greet each other with a sacred kiss.
verses.textEnNasb: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
verses.textEn: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

verses.textZh: 众圣徒都问候你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众圣徒都问候你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 众圣徒都问你们安。
verses.textEnNiv: All God’s people here send their greetings.
verses.textEnEsv: All the saints greet you.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the saints greet you.
verses.textEnNlt: All of God’s people here send you their greetings.
verses.textEnNasb: All the saints greet you.
verses.textEn: All God’s people here send their greetings.

verses.textZh: 愿主耶稣基督的恩惠，神的慈爱，圣灵的契通，常与你们众人同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿主耶稣基督的恩惠，神的慈爱，圣灵的契通，常与你们众人同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿主耶稣基督的恩惠、神的慈爱、圣灵的感动常与你们众人同在！
verses.textEnNiv: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.
verses.textEnEsv: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ and the love of God and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.
verses.textEnNkjv: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.
verses.textEnNasb: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit, be with you all.
verses.textEn: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.
